items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou wast nailed to the tree of the Cross, from Thy most pure side Thou didst pour forth life-giving blood, and Hades then was slain; and they that were put to death cried aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Врата вѣчнаа испровергъ х̃е, и пръвоꙁданнаго претрътъгъ ꙋꙁы · текъ глїю тлѣнномоу а́дїе въстани · мнѣ ꙁижитель въпїа ѡ̃ц̃ь нашихъ бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having overthrown the eternal gates, O Christ, and broken the bonds of the first-fashioned, Thou didst run, saying unto the corrupt one: "Arise straightway, crying unto Me, the Creator: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

items.slavonic_text: Не раꙁлоучаемьни въ трехъ лищехь · е̃диныи соуществомь ꙁна́емы вѣрнїи · ѡ̃ч̃е е̃ слово · беꙁлѣтныи сн̃е · д̃ше же прѣстыи · ѡ̃ц̃ь наши̃ бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion to the Trinity:* Undivided in three Persons, known by the faithful as One in essence: O Father, Word, timeless Son, and Most Holy Spirit: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Зрак нощнїа́ ꙗко вь ѡ́у̃бѡ, ꙗковъ гаданїика · въплъщена же ѡ́у̃бѡ ѡ̃ тебе, свѣтлостыю ꙗвлше аполоющимь прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃ц̃ь н̃ши̃ бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 7, Heirmos: The same as to the Cross.*

items.slavonic_text: Съѡ́браꙁнаꙗ же въ тебѣ · неизьреченнаго проꙗвлѣе спатїа · съ ꙗ́ко во̃мь боретсѧ · и́ иже волею съвъкоупи сѧ ч̃лкѡмь · прѣбг̃ест̃вныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Jacob indeed beheld Thee as in a nocturnal vision of riddles; but from Thee He was truly manifested in the flesh with radiant brightness unto them that sing: O transcendent God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Prefiguring in Thee the image of ineffable salvation, He wrestled with Jacob, He Who by His own will united Himself unto men: O transcendent God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Driving away the abominable ignorance of the Gentiles, and with unhesitating faith crying out unto the thrice-hymned Trinity: O transcendent God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: The furnace of fire once in Babylon divided its operation by the divine decree,[^61] consuming the Chaldeans, but cooling the faithful, who sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; hymn and exalt Him above all forever!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the garment of Thy flesh crimsoned with Thy Blood, O Christ, the angelic ranks marveled with trembling at Thy longsuffering, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst clothe Thyself in mortality, and through Thy Resurrection Thou didst grant immortality unto all; therefore, praising Thee, we hymn Thee, an elect people, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having conceived without seed and ineffably given birth unto Him Who is inseparable from the Father, Who dwelt godworthily in Thy womb, O most pure Birthgiver of God: therefore we praise Thee as salvation unto us all.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Ode 8, Heirmos: In the light-bearing furnace...*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst descend into Hades by Thy power, O Savior, and seizing the plunder of the all-destroying beast, Thou didst raise up together all who were awaiting Thee, who shared the likeness of Adam in captivity, ceaselessly crying: Bless the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having risen with boldness, the angel proclaimed with a most radiant voice unto those held in bondage, and brought transcendent joy to the holy ones, the glad tidings unto the Apostles: "Rejoice!" crying: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all forever!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion to the Trinity:* A Unity in three Hypostases, O Most Holy consubstantial Trinity, we have recognized Thee as God: the divine source, divinely budding, perfect, undivided: Father, Son, and Spirit worshipped by all!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [O Father, Son, and Spirit worshipped by all!]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 8, Heirmos: To the same.*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He appeared on earth for the sake of the people, and dwelt with men through ineffable goodness and power; unto Him all we faithful sing, crying: Let all creation hymn Him Who gave it being, and exalt Him above all forever!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Truly proclaiming Thee as the Birthgiver of God, O pure one, we glorify Thee; for Thou didst give birth to the One of the Trinity incarnate, Whom together with the Father and the Spirit we all hymn: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto ages!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beyond all word, Him Who was begotten of the Father before the ages, Thou hast ineffably given birth unto Him incarnate for us, O all-hymned Virgin, Whom we hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The Son of the unoriginate Begetter, God and Lord,[^62] incarnate of the Virgin has appeared unto us, to enlighten them that are in darkness, and to gather together them that are scattered; therefore, O all-hymned Birthgiver of God, we magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Planted at the extremity of the ages, O Christ, the thrice-radiant tree of Thy precious Cross, watered with water and divine blood as from a fountain of Thy divine side, has blossomed forth life!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having been crucified as all-powerful, Thou didst destroy the mighty one who held sway below in the stronghold of Hades, and having raised human nature, Thou didst seat it upon the Father's throne; therefore, worshipping Thee as Thou comest, we magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O ever-Virgin, who didst give birth unto the Savior: grant peace unto us, Thy servants; grant mercy unto Thy people and steadfast love, and establish Thy servants in eternal rest, O most pure one.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [and establish Thy servants in eternal rest, O most pure one.]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross and Resurrection. Ode 9, Heirmos: What is this Thy grandeur...*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast gloriously promised from of old, whereas formerly the wretched one tasted of the figure, yet now the sinner has communion in the renewed life, not being consumed; continually we magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let all us faithful sing a triumphal hymn: Having risen by divine power, destroying the dominion of death and striking down the Ishmaelite enemy,[^63] grant unto Thy servants victories over our adversaries!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Birthgiver of God, great refuge of Christians: we flee unto Thy protection and Thy fervent intercession; receive us into the satiety of divine gladness, O pure one, that we the faithful, ceaselessly praising Thee, may magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 9, Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A rod of strength was given unto corruptible nature: the Word of God within Thy womb, O pure one; and He raised it up when it had slipped into Hades; therefore, as the Birthgiver of God, we all magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even as Thou wast well pleased, O Master, receive mercifully the prayer of Thy Mother; for through Thy bounty all things are filled, that we all may magnify Thee as Benefactor.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks, O most pure one, ceaselessly glorify Thy childbearing; standing in their ranks and gazing with fear, filled with His gladness, we ceaselessly magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [filled with His gladness, we ceaselessly magnify Thee.]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Then the Resurrection Exapostilarion. The appointed Resurrection Stichera at the Praises, Tone 2:[^64]*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let every breath and all creation glorify Thee, O Lord; for by the Cross Thou hast abolished death, that Thou mightest manifest unto men Thy Resurrection from the dead, as the only good One and Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let the Jews tell how the soldiers lost the King whom they guarded; why did the stone not preserve the Rock of life? Either let them surrender Him that was buried, or worship Him that is risen, saying with us: Glory to the multitude of Thy compassions; O our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Rejoice, ye peoples, and be glad! For an angel sat upon the stone of the tomb, and he brought us the glad tidings, saying: "Christ is risen from the dead, the Savior of the world, and He has filled all things with fragrance; rejoice, ye peoples, and be glad!"

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let the gentile peoples praise Christ our God, Who willingly endured the Cross for our sake, and spent three days in Hades; let them worship Thy Resurrection from the dead, through which the ends of the whole world have been enlightened.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The women poured out myrrh with tears upon Thy tomb, and their mouths were filled with joy when it was said unto them: "The Lord is risen!"

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou wast nailed to the Cross by the lawless, O Christ, and numbered among the dead, O immortal Word; and Thou didst rise on the third day as God in glory, granting unto the whole world eternal life and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [and Thou didst rise on the third day as God in glory, granting unto the whole world eternal life and great mercy.]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Truly, O ye lawless ones, in sealing the stone ye made us worthy of a greater wonder; the guard has understanding: today He came forth from the tomb! They said: "Say that while we were sleeping His disciples came and stole Him." And who would steal a dead man, especially one anointed and naked? And He rose by His own authority as God, leaving His grave-clothes in the tomb. Come, behold, O ye Jews, how He did not break the seals, having trampled down death, and granted life and great mercy unto the human race!

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let us offer radiant adoration unto Him Who is risen from the dead and has enlightened all things from the corruption of Hades through His three-day Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Glory... The appointed Evangelical Sticheron. On Sunday at the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 2:[^65]*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Remember us, O merciful Savior, even as Thou didst remember the thief in the Kingdom of heaven.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Through a tree Adam was driven out of Paradise, but through the Cross Christ brought the thief into the Kingdom of heaven.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast despoiled Hades through the Cross, O Christ, and unto the dead Thou hast granted life and the Kingdom of heaven.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The tomb received Thee, O Savior, Who didst empty the tombs and pour forth unto the dead the inexhaustible fountain of incorruptible life.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Rising from the tomb by divine power, as God Thou didst return all unto the heavenly Kingdom; Thou didst resurrect all the dead who glorify Thy Resurrection, O heavenly King.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [Thou didst resurrect all the dead who glorify Thy Resurrection, O heavenly King.]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion to the Trinity:* Let us glorify the divine Trinity, hymning one Godhead in three Persons.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* All generations bless Thee, O pure one; for without seed Thou didst bear in the flesh the heavenly King.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *On Sunday, the Apostle to the Corinthians [sic, recte: Romans, pericope 116].[^66] Prokeimenon: The Lord is my strength and my song, and He is become my salvation (Psalm 117:14 LXX). Verse: Unto Thee, O Lord, will I cry (Psalm 27:1 LXX):*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: Brethren, being made free from sin, become servants of righteousness. I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness. For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness. What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death. But now being made free from sin, become servants unto the Lord, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life (Romans 6:18–22).

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Gospel according to Matthew (Matthew 8:23–27):*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: At that time, when Jesus was entered into a ship, His disciples followed Him. And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves; but He was asleep. And His disciples came to Him, and awoke Him, saying: "Lord, save us, lest we perish!" And He said unto them: "Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith?" Then He arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm. But the men marveled, saying: "What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?"

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [that even the winds and the sea obey Him?]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *On the same Sunday evening, Penitential Stichera, Tone 2.*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Possessing a fountain of tender compassion, an unsearchable abyss of mercies, and streams of bounties: O all-good Father, O Word and Son of the Father, and O Holy Spirit, uncreated Nature: receive our supplication and our prayer, granting forgiveness unto all of us who are in sins, as Thou art a compassionate God and Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou hast by nature, as God, a heart of compassion and a wealth of goodness; therefore we pray Thee, O Christ our Savior, and falling down we ever cry out, saying: Grant unto Thy servants remission of their many transgressions, and forgiveness of those sins which we all have committed, as Thou art a compassionate God and Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Desiring to save all, O Savior, as God, for whose sake Thou didst appear as man unto men: save us who bow down before Thy commandments; for Thou camest not, O Lover of mankind, to save the righteous, but to loose those bound in transgressions and burdened with sins, by the grace of divine baptism, as Thou art a compassionate God and Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Bodiless Powers:*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thrones, Cherubim, Seraphim, Dominions, Powers, and Authorities, Angels, Archangels, and Principalities: they who were brought into being by the incorruptible Godhead, sing with unceasing harmony, teaching all to honor the one essence of the Trinity in three Persons, undivided and unconfused.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The incorporeal ranks of the immaterial choirs, overcome by the direct rays of the divine Princeliness, impart divine splendors unto the lower ranks according to their order, and offer them by the law of love according to their worthiness and the purity of each with diligence.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: [and offer them by the law of love according to their worthiness and the purity of each with diligence.]

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Directing the soul on high to the heights, having the eye of the heart and mind stretched out with divine love in our souls at all times, that being illuminated by the rays from thence, we may escape the darkness of the passions, and learn to stand with fear before the throne with the angels unto the Creator, and be transfigured with light in this age.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The multitude of angels, O most pure one, praises Thy throne; for as it is fire-fashioned, it burns the inhabited world; Thou art the divine bridge that leads from earth ever unto Him, crying unto Thee: "Rejoice, full of grace!" with Archangel Gabriel in harmony, for Thou didst give birth unto the fountain of joy.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera:[^68]*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* I have sinned against Thee, O Christ Savior, like the prodigal son; receive me who am running back, and have mercy on me, O God.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the publican: Be merciful unto me, even as unto him, and have mercy on me.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Martyrion:* The passion-bearers, having loved none of earthly pleasures, were made worthy of heavenly good things and became fellow citizens of the angels: O Lord, by their prayers have mercy on us and save us.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, Mary, Birthgiver of God, invincible temple, yea, holy one, as the prophet sings: "Holy is Thy temple, wonderful in righteousness" (Psalm 64:5 LXX).

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 3, automela:[^69]*

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, the dominion of death was destroyed, and the deception of the devil was abolished; and the human race, saved by faith, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* All things were enlightened by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and paradise was opened again; and all creation praising Thee, ever offers a hymn unto Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* I glorify the Father and the power of the Son, and I hymn the authority of the Holy Spirit: the undivided, uncreated Godhead, the consubstantial Trinity, reigning unto ages of ages.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* We bow down before Thy precious Cross, O Christ, and we hymn and glorify Thy Resurrection; for by Thy wound we all were healed.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* We hymn the Savior Who was incarnate of the Virgin; for He was crucified for our sake, and rose on the third day, granting unto us great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Descending unto them that were in Hades, Christ proclaimed the glad tidings, saying with boldness: "Be of good courage, now have I conquered! I am the Resurrection, I will bring you forth, having destroyed the gates of death!"

items.slavonic_text: Мръꙁокыи же непровѣдꙋ ꙗ е̃диного д̃бы ꙗ̃ сна · ѡ̃ прѣпѣтыꙗ тр̃ца · и́ несꙋмѣнною вѣрою е̃ꙁыкѡмь въпїа · прѣбж̃твъныи ѡ̃це̃мь бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Standing unworthily in Thy most pure house, we send up an evening hymn, crying out from the depths: O Christ God, Who hast enlightened the world by Thy Resurrection...

items.slavonic_text: иꙁьми люди твоꙗ · иꙁ роукы вра твоихь ч̃лколюбче :~
items.english_text: [deliver Thy people from the hand of Thine enemies, O Lover of mankind!]

items.slavonic_text: е̃диноу · повтори · слава · і н̃ынѣ б̃ѡ · Како не дивнм сѧ бг̃омꙋжномꙋ рожествоу твое̃мꙋ прѣчистаа · и́скоушенїꙗ бо мꙋжеска не приемши всенепорочнаа · родила е̃си б̃еꙁь ѡ̃ц̃а плътъю · и́иже прежде вѣкь ѡ̃ ѡ̃ца рождена беꙁь м̃тре · никакоже притрътпѣвша иꙁмѣненїа · и́ли смѣшенїа · и́ли раꙁдѣленїа · и́ въ ѡ́боемь сѫщьствѣ · свои̃ство цѣло съхраньшатъи же м̃ти д̃во вл̃ч̃це · того моли сп̃сти сѧ д̃шамь нашимь · и́ же православно богородицоу и́сповѣдающих тѧ :~
items.english_text: *Sing once; repeat; Glory... Both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon), Tone 3:[^70]*

items.slavonic_text: Страстїю твое̃ю х̃е · ѡ́мрачившы не лънце · и́ свѣтѡ твоего въскръсенїа · просвѣщїи въсе̃ч̃ьскаа · приими нашꙋ вечернѫѩ пѣень ч̃ловѣколюбче :~
items.english_text: How shall we not marvel at thy theandric giving birth, O all-pure one? For without having accepted the temptation of man, O all-blameless one, thou didst bear in the flesh without father Him Who was begotten of the Father without mother before all ages, Who underwent no manner of change, nor mingling, nor division, but preserved the property of each essence intact. Therefore, O Virgin Mother and Lady, entreat Him that our souls may be saved, who in Orthodox manner confess thee to be the Birthgiver of God.

items.slavonic_text: Живодавное тн въстанїе г̃и · въселенѫѩ въсꙗ просвѣти · и́ свое съꙁданїе истлѣвшее приꙁва · тѣмь же клатвы а̃дамѡвы въси иꙁбывьше сѧ въпїемь · въсесилне г̃и слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 3:[^71]*

items.slavonic_text: Б̃ъ сыи неиꙁмѣнень · плътнꙗ стражда иꙁмѣнисѧ · е̃гоже тварь не тръпѧщи висѧща ꙁърѣти · съ страхѡмь прѣкланѧшесѧ · истонѫщи поетъ твое длъготрътпѣнїе · съшѣ же въ а̃дь · тридневновъскръсл е̃си · и́ жиꙁнь дароуꙗ мирови и́ велїꙗ мл̃ть :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* By Thy Passion, O Christ, Thou didst darken the sun, and by the light of Thy Resurrection Thou hast enlightened all things: receive our evening hymn, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thy life-giving Resurrection, O Lord, enlightened the whole universe, and recalled Thine own creation that was corrupted; therefore, having all been delivered from the curse of Adam, we cry aloud: O almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Being God changeless, Thou wast changed by suffering in the flesh; and creation, unable to bear seeing Thee hanging upon the Cross, bowed down in fear, and groaning, praised Thy long-suffering; and having descended into Hades, Thou didst rise on the third day, granting life unto the world and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* That Thou mightest deliver our race from death, O Christ, Thou didst endure death; and having become the first-born

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: from the dead, Thou didst raise with Thyself them that have acknowledged Thee as God; and Thou hast enlightened us: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Without seed, from the Holy Spirit, by the will of the Father, thou didst conceive the Son of God, Who was before all ages from the Father without mother; and for our sake, having come from thee without father, thou didst bear Him in the flesh and feed Him as an infant with milk; therefore pray without ceasing, that our souls may be delivered from dangers.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Resurrection Troparion, Tone 3:[^72]* Let the heavens be glad, and let the earthly rejoice; for the Lord has shown strength with His arm: He has trampled down death by death, and become the first-born from the dead; He has delivered us from the belly of Hades, and granted great mercy unto the world.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Twice. Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thee who didst mediate salvation for our race, we hymn, O Virgin Birthgiver of God; for having accepted the suffering of the Cross in the flesh assumed from thee, Thy Son and our God has delivered us from corruption, as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, Tone 3. Ode 1. Heirmos: He Who of old gathered the waters...[^73]*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Incomprehensible sole Sovereign Dominion, unoriginate, eternal, all-seeing God: make us worthy of the thrice-radiant shining of Thy glory, that angels and men may now magnify Thee and unceasingly hymn Thee with thrice-holy songs from angelic mouths.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sacredly the ranks of bodiless powers hymn Thee as creative and authorial cause, O thrice-radiant Unity and most luminous Light; with them in harmony sing

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: the assemblies of mankind, and faithfully glorify Thee with faithful mouths.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Mind, Word, and Spirit: the theologians mystically depict in personal images the passionless generation, knowing the Word to be co-unoriginate from the unbegotten Father, the divine sole origin of all things, together with the divine procession of the Spirit.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As Lover of mankind by nature, having assumed human nature, God the Word, the all-beginning Trinity, light of sole origin, glorified everywhere in the one Godhead, revealed Himself in thee who didst bear Him, O undefiled Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who brought all things out of nothing...*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: He Who of old commanded the universe to be established from non-being, having instructed us typologically, prefigured the Trinitarian hypostasis of the sole Godhead, the Sovereign Dominion.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Corruptible nature of earth hymns Thee, the one thrice-radiant ineffable Creator, crying aloud: O Master, deliver me who am wholly afflicted!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In harmony following the words of the prophets, and the renowned apostles, preachers of the faith, the faithful glorify Thee, the equally operating Trinity, unto ages of ages.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Descending from the high throne, elevating man as Lover of mankind, through thee, O most pure one, the Trinitarian light has shone upon the world.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: those who glorify Thy dominion, as Thou alone art merciful, knowing the weakness of our heart.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Twice. Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The incomprehensible, uncircumscribed, and consubstantial Word of the invisible Father, thou didst mystically contain within thy womb; through thy birthgiving we have known how to glorify in the world the one and undivided Godhead of the Trinity; therefore with thanksgiving we cry unto thee: Rejoice, full of grace, the Lord is with thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou hast set firm love toward us: the...* [^75]

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A twofold-numbered shoot from the Father as from a root, the Son sprouted forth, and the upright Spirit; undivided sproutings planted by God and flowers equal in power, as three-hypostatic divine luminaries.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The assemblies of noetic beings unceasingly hymn Thee, the uncircumscribed God; with them we also glorify Thee, saying: O supersubstantial Trinity, preserve Thy servants, as Thou art merciful!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast drawn us unto Thy love, O only merciful One, O Word of God, Who for our sake wast ineffably incarnate; having mystically received the one thrice-radiant Godhead, therefore we glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Look down upon me who am infirm, O undefiled one, and destroy my grievous and incurable passions, that I may magnify thee who hast magnified all mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: As Isaiah saw typologically God upon a throne high and lifted up, receiving gifts of glory from angels, "O wretched me!" he cried aloud: "I have foreseen God becoming incarnate, the unwaning Light, ruling over the world!"

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Isaiah saw in unison the Sovereign Origin, God glorified in three persons by the most pure voices of the seraphim; and he was sent to proclaim the true thrice-radiant essence, the three-personal unity.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou Who before didst bring forth from non-being all visible and invisible nature, O thrice-sunned Trinity: hymning Thee as the one God, deliver the faithful from every temptation, and make us worthy of Thy glory!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O light-bearing bridal chamber of God, having come forth from the pure Virgin, we hymn with love and bless Christ Who was born of thee in two essences and wills, One of the Trinity unto glory.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Abraham, being a stranger, was made worthy typologically to receive God in three hypostases under the forms of men.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Direct the hands of Thy servants toward the unapproachable Light, O Trinity, unwaning Sun; and grant the illumination of Thy glory unto our souls, as far as it is possible to behold Thine ineffable glory.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the Father, and the Son, and the divine Spirit we the faithful bow down, unto the uncreated Trinity in three persons; and in one Godhead ever without beginning, in three hypostases, we faithfully glorify.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast opened the gates unto the Light Who was born of thy womb, that seeing the all-radiant

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: ray of the Godhead, all may glorify thee, the all-hymned Lady.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3 (sung twice):[^77]* When Thou comest, O God, upon earth to judge all, have compassion, as Thou art merciful, upon those whom Thou didst fashion from earth after Thine own image, and deliver all from righteous condemnation, and send us not into the fire of Gehenna, for Thou alone art Christ, the only merciful One.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Grant me sighing, O Lady, as unto the publican, and tears as unto the harlot, that offering these unto thee, I may cry aloud: Have mercy on me, O all-merciful one, and drive away my affliction by thy goodness, and grant me showers of compunction; for unto thee have I fled, O all-merciful one!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Show me to be a temple of Thy thrice-radiant and all-luminous Godhead, O Master, free from evil sinful darkening and passions, O Light-giver, truly with us: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We proclaim the one radiance of the Godhead in three hypostases, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, in undivided properties: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst appear upon earth, having become man, the Creator of all, in a manner befitting God, having come forth from the pure Virgin, from her most pure womb, and Thou hast deified us: Blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From the unoriginate Father as from a root, the Word and the Spirit, being co-unoriginate, having appeared as the sproutings of the supersubstantial divine Origin, reveal the Trinity: one glory and power,

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: which we hymn and glorify unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou dost order by Thine unfeared commands the heavenly ranks to hymn Thee unceasingly with thrice-holy divine songs, O Father, Word of like image, and Spirit, thrice-radiant sole dominion of power: with them we hymn Thee unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The foretold prophetic riddles, having seen thy giving birth from afar, glorify Thee, O Birthgiver of God; for without seed, beyond nature, Thou didst give birth, O Lady; and in harmony we hymn Him, glorifying the Lord Who was born of Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the thrice-radiant glory, the God-beholding bodiless ranks, as they soar with wings desiring the heights, and as they fan around the unapproachable Light, cry unceasingly; with them we also glorify in harmony: O sole Trinity, we glorify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With unchanging love, having received from Thee upon earth an intelligent and rational soul, hymning Thee, O Master, God Almighty, one essential nature in truth, and in three persons: as many as praise Thee, preserve this soul from the whole heart, O Merciful One, as Thou art almighty!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having proclaimed to the world the Trinity, one in essence in three hypostases, and having driven away the deception of polytheism from the earth, having taught men to glorify without deception the Trinity...

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Show me to be a temple of the divine light-vision of the divine Origin, and to serve purely the Creator of all, a noetic beholder of ineffable glory, by the prayers of the Mother of the Only-begotten, whom we worthily ever magnify.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Rubric:* Then: *It is truly meet...* and the rest, as indicated in Tone 1, after the Canon.[^79]

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *On Sunday, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 3:* *Let the heavens be glad...* twice; *Both now...* Theotokion: written backwards (see fol. 62r). After the first Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Christ is risen from the dead, He has become the first-fruits of them that slept, and the first-born of creation, and the Creator of all things that have come to be: He has renewed in Himself the corrupted nature of our race; no longer dost thou rule, O death, for the Master of all has destroyed thy dominion.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Twice. Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The heavenly rejoiced with love, and the earthly trembled with fear, when the most pure voice came upon thee, O Birthgiver of God; for one festival was made for both, when the Bodiless One brought joy unto thee; therefore with the angel we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O pure one, dwelling place of God!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* Having tasted death in the flesh, O Lord, Thou didst cut short the bitterness of death by Thy Resurrection; Thou didst strengthen man again by victory over the first curse:

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: O Defender, Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Twice. Glory... Both now... Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Ypakoe:* Astonishing by his appearance, refreshing with his words, the radiant angel said unto the myrrh-bearing women: "Why seek ye the Living One in the tomb? He is risen, emptying the tombs! Understand Him Who changes corruption to be changeless; say unto God: How awesome are Thy works, for Thou hast saved the human race!"

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou didst deliver the captivity of Zion from Babylon: lead me also from the passions unto life, O Word!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* They that sow in the south with divine tears shall reap ears of life ever with joy.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Unto the Holy Spirit:* Unto the Holy Spirit all thanksgiving shines forth, even as unto the Father and the Son, in Whom all things live and move.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Except the Lord build the house of virtues, in vain do we labor; but if He shelter the soul, no one shall destroy our city.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Through the Spirit the fruit of the womb is fashioned by the mercy of the saints, as they are holy fathers at all times.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Unto the Holy Spirit:* By the Holy Spirit every holiness and wisdom is foreseen; for He enriches

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: every creature: let us serve Him, for He is God, even as the Father and the Word.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Blessed are they that fear the Lord; walking in the way of the commandments, they shall eat every living fruit.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Round about thy table be glad, O Chief Shepherd, beholding thine offspring bearing branches of good deeds.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Unto the Holy Spirit:* By the Holy Spirit is every wealth of glory; from Him is grace and life unto all creation: for He is hymned together with the Father and with the Word.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3:* Say among the nations: The Lord reigns! (Psalm 95:10 LXX)

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us bow down...*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Singing one by one, or as the superior commands to do, with refrains.*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *On Sunday, Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 3. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: He Who of old by divine beckoning gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: He is our God, most glorious; unto Him alone let us sing, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having condemned the earth to bring forth thorns unto the transgressor in sweat, this our God in the flesh received a crown of thorns from the hand of lawless men; and having dissolved the curse, He glorified it.

items.slavonic_text: Да ро̃дъ нашь христе ѡ̃ съдъръти и́ꙁбавиши · съмерътъ, прѣтрътпѣлъ е̃си · и́ первъкѣнець
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A Victor over death by overcoming, He Who appeared overcome by death; for having accepted the passion of an animate flesh, this our God...

items.slavonic_text: мꙋ́чителемь · всѧ въскр̃се · ꙗ́ко прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: [He grappled with the tyrant, and] raised all: for He is glorified![^82]

items.slavonic_text: И́стиннꙋю бц̃ю вьсїи́ ꙗ́ꙁы́ци славѧть · та́ и́же бесѣмени ро́ждешѧ · въшедїе бо въ оу́тробꙋ твою ѡ̃с̃щеннꙋю · съ б̃ъ нашь · и́же по нась ѡсоуществовасѧ · б̃ъ и́ чл̃къ и́с тебе роди сѧ :~
items.english_text: All nations glorify thee as the true Birthgiver of God, who didst bear without seed; for having entered into thy sanctified womb, this our God, Who took substance according to our likeness, was born of thee as God and man.

items.slavonic_text: і́нь · кр̃тоу · і́ р̃мо · прѣдѣлаемоу мѡ́рю же :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Heirmos: Even as the divided sea...*

items.slavonic_text: Оу́даренїе мене ради прїꙗ́тъ вл̃ко · сво́божьденїе пиша повинны · и́ бѡ ꙁелинны ѡ̃т кр̃ве сво́боженныхъ · ѡ̃ сего ради поемь пѣень · чюдномоу б̃ꙋ нашемꙋ · ꙗ́ко прослави :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst accept buffeting for my sake, O Master, procuring freedom for the guilty, and redemption through Thy blood for the liberated; therefore we sing a hymn unto our marvelous God, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Почто живаго ꙗ́ко мр̃тва · на гро́бѣ а̃гг̃ль къ спїа́ше жена · что прїидосте и́скати сѐ въскре х̃с · сего ради въспиемь пѣ́ · чюдномоу б̃ꙋ нашемꙋ ꙗ́ про́ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Why seek ye the Living One as dead at the tomb?" the angel cried unto the women: "Why have ye come seeking? Behold, Christ is risen!" Therefore let us sing a hymn unto our marvelous God, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Чт̃ѫꙗ́ и́ нетлѣ́ннꙋю по ро̃жтвѣ ро́жешꙋ ꙗ́же беꙁ мꙋ́жа · дв̃ꙋ б̃голѣпно пѣ́ли въ́рнїи почтѣ · б̃цю тѧ мо́лїно намїно хвалѧщїи тѧ вѣрою :~
items.english_text: Let us faithful piously hymn and honor the pure Virgin who after childbirth remained incorrupt, having borne without man, entreating thee, the Birthgiver of God, who praise thee with faith.

items.slavonic_text: і́нь · к̃ · а̃ · прест̃ѣи б̃ци · і́ р̃ то · Колѣ́на прекланꙗ́е всѧ́ко е̃ст̃во к̃ нѣны б̃ко · и́ въпло́щшемꙋ и́с тебе · съ ꙁемны́ми и́ д̃шлѣпно и́ прене̃спонѣꙗ́ · ꙗ́ прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon, Ode 1, to the Most Holy Birthgiver of God. Heirmos: The same, Podoben: "Every nature bends the knee" (Всяко естество):*

items.slavonic_text: Съ прелѣ́ненїи къ тебе бл̃гы́ · и́ бо неꙁавистно подате́къ · д̃хъ б̃ж̃твеныі да вь на · пло̃ ѡ̃ тебе ѡтрокови́це прїꙗ́ть · ꙗ́ про :~
items.english_text: Every nature bends the knee, O immaculate Lady, unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, together with earthly beings, both noetically and super-cosmically: for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Равно дѣ́телѧ ро̃шомꙋ · родила е̃се ло́ · ѡ́бжнивша чл̃чьское е̃с̃щество · томоу по мл̃и · не долгые леналꙗ́ и́ꙁ немогша · крѣпцы коꙁнь ми · бж̃твеныимь оу́тѣшенїе побѣждати тѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy good pleasure toward thee, O Good One, for without envy the Giver, the Divine Spirit, came upon thee, and the Word took flesh from thee, O Maiden: for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast borne the Word, Co-worker with Him that begot Him, Who deified human nature; entreat Him on our behalf, that we who have grown weak through long-standing sins may conquer the strong wiles of the enemy through divine consolation.

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who brought all things out of nothing...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...fashioned by the Word, and perfected by the Spirit, O Almighty Most High: establish us in Thy love![^83]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By meekness the impious one was put to shame, when he fell into the pit that he had made; and by Thy Resurrection, O Christ, Thou hast exalted the horn of the humble.

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The preaching of piety has covered the nations, as the water covers the sea, O Master: having risen from the tomb, Thou hast revealed unto us the Trinitarian Light.

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O animate city of the ever-reigning King; for through thee, O Lady, He has dwelt with earthly beings.

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy mystery...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Coming upon earth in the likeness of flesh without sin, Thou didst condemn the ancient slaying by the tree of corrupting knowledge, O Master!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Crucified for our sake and numbered among the dead, willingly enduring three days' burial, O Lord and Savior, by Thy rising Thou didst grant resurrection unto the world, as Good and the Lover of mankind: glorified!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: May thy pure prayer be our confirmation and consolation, O undefiled and pure Virgin after childbirth: pray, O most pure one, send consolation unto the world through thy prayers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 3. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a rod from the root of Jesse, prophetically budding forth, O Virgin, the flower Christ has shone forth from thee: Holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That Thou mightest make earth-born men partakers of the divine nature, Thou wast clothed in flesh from the Virgin; for Thou didst condescend without change, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the Divine Word beyond speech, Who has loosed the irrationality of man: entreat Him diligently, that I who am enslaved to irrational...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...passions may be set free, O only Ever-Virgin![^84]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Thou hast placed toward us steadfast love, O Lord, for Thou didst give Thine Only-begotten Son unto death for our sake; therefore, praising Thee, we cry aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In Thy mercy, O Christ, Thou didst endure wounds and stripes, and in Thy longsuffering Thou didst suffer reproach and buffeting, enduring also spitting, whereby Thou hast wrought salvation, O Christ: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With a mortal body, O Life, Thou wast numbered among the dead, for the misery of the poor and the groaning of the needy: destroying the corrupter, Thou hast gloriously raised all with Thyself!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Remember, O Christ, the flock which Thou didst purchase with Thy Passion: receiving the merciful prayers of Thy glorious Mother, visit our affliction and deliver us by Thy power!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 4. Heirmos: It covered...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast suspended upon the Tree, Who didst suspend the earth upon the waters, O Creator of all; and Thy side being pierced with a spear, Thou didst pour forth blood and water, redemption and cleansing for all!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy side being pierced healed my wounds; struck by the hand, Thou didst obtain freedom for me; tasting gall, Thou didst deliver me from the wounding of the deceiver, O Christ!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: The Most High was incarnate from thy pure blood: beholding Him unrighteously exalted upon the Tree, O most pure one, weeping with tears and groaning, she magnified His tender mercy!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 4. Heirmos: The same (He Who set the mountains in the scales):*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...by the measure...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...of divine wisdom, Thou, the Stone cut without hands from the Virgin: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind![^85]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast healed our diseased nature, O Master, by the most swift uniting from the Virgin, O Son and Word, through Thy precious Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Participating in our nature, O Lord, having united the desired inheritance, the Word from the Virgin brought to pass the bodily composition.

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Unto Thee I rise early, the Creator of all, Who exceedest every mind in peace; for Thy commandments are light: guide me in them!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Betrayed by Hebrew envy unto an unjust judge, the All-seeing One, Who judgest all the earth righteously, delivered ancient Adam from condemnation!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant Thy peace unto Thy churches, O Christ, by the unconquerable power of Thy Cross, Thou Who art risen from the dead: save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Holy Tabernacle broader than all creation, for thou didst receive within thee the incomprehensible Word, O only manifested Ever-Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 5. Heirmos: Upon earth...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pierced in Thy divine side with a spear, O Christ, finding fashioned man, through whom perdition had come unto all men, Thou didst become an Intercessor and set him free from corruption!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Equal to the Father in essence, O Savior, Thou didst raise up the sanctified temple of Thy assumed and all-pure body from the dead, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Corrupted before through transgression, our nature, having incorruptibly borne Christ, thou hast renewed, O most pure Lady, Protectress of our souls![^86]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 5. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Word of God is thy Son, O Virgin, the Creator of the first-fashioned Adam, not a creation; although He took flesh endowed with a rational soul from thee!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Equal to the Father is thy Son, O Virgin, the Word of God, perfect in hypostasis in two natures, and He became perfect man!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth after childbirth without corruption, for God was born of thee as man: beholding Him crucified, unable to bear maternal grief, thou didst cry aloud!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: The lowest abyss of sins has encompassed me, and my spirit faints; but stretching forth Thy high arm, O Master, save me, O Helmsman, as Thou didst Peter!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The abyss of mercy and compassions has encompassed me, O compassionate Savior: for having become incarnate, O Master, and taking the form of a servant, Thou didst deify it and glorify it with Thyself!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He Who put death to death received slaying; making alive him that was slain, through the expectation of Thy Resurrection, O Son of God, He conquered the enemy!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: O most pure one, who alone beyond understanding didst mediate between the Creator and mankind: entreat thy Son to be merciful unto thy sinful servants and to be their Defender!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 6. Heirmos: Lead up from corruption...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Who didst endure crucifixion and death, and didst rise on the third day from the tomb: humble the arrogance of the adversary...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...and guide my life, O Merciful One![^87]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Exalting me who had fallen, O Christ Lover of mankind, Thou Who didst rise from the dead on the third day: revive me who am afflicted and grievously corrupted, and direct my life, O Lord Merciful!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Our hope and confirmation: guide and direct the faithful people upon the path of life, O Lady, who piously praise and ever honor thee!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Birthgiver of God. Ode 6. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Formed in our likeness from the incorrupt Virgin is He Who is inseparable in form from the Father, becoming an image in reality, the changeless God and Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The timeless Word, having received a birth in time, O Christ, delivered Adam from the curse, descending into extreme poverty, desiring to save the straying nations through the birthgiving of the blameless Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Deliver me, O most pure one, from the abyss of sins and the assaults of passions: for thou art a harbor and an abyss of wonders unto them that flee unto thee in faith!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Even as of old Thou didst bedew the three pious children in the Chaldean furnace, with the radiant fire of Thy Godhead enlighten us also who cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The radiant veil of the temple was rent at the crucifixion of the Creator, revealing the hidden scripture in truth unto the faithful who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From Thy pierced side, drops of life-creating blood pouring forth by Thy dispensation upon the earth, Thou hast renewed those upon the earth...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^88]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Let us glorify the Good Spirit together with the Father and with the Only-begotten Son, honoring, O ye faithful, one Principle in three Hypostases, one Godhead, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 7. Heirmos: The rod and the fire...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy Passion Thou hast restored Adam's nature upon the Tree: led as a sheep to the slaughter, O Christ, for them that cry: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Numbered among the dead and laid in the tomb, Thou didst raise up all the dead of Hades, O Master, who hymn Thee with songs: O God, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: As many of the faithful as have learned to honor the one undivided Godhead in three Persons, consubstantial and the same, we cry in faith: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 7. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord of glory and Sovereign of the heavenly hosts, Who sits with the Father, was borne by virginal hands: bless, O blessed Virgin, thy childbearing!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast destroyed the deadly poison through conversation with the Virgin, becoming divinely constituted flesh: Blessed art Thou, we cry unto Thee, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: We all know thee to be the Birthgiver of God, who didst bear God, One of the Trinity incarnate: blessed, O most pure one, is the fruit...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...of thy womb![^89]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: United in the unendurable fire, the youths who stood for piety, unharmed by the flame, sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The temple's splendor was rent when Thy Cross was erected on Golgotha, and creation bowed down, singing with fear: Bless the Lord, all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Christ is risen from the tomb, and by divine power Thou hast restored him that fell through the ancient deception, who cries and says: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Thou hast been revealed as an animate temple of God, a receptacle and ark, containing the Creator of all mankind, O most pure Mother of God; and worthily all works glorify thee, who wast preserved a Virgin after childbirth!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 8. Heirmos: Serving Him that lived...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, and pierced in the side by lawless men, Thou didst pour forth the fountain of incorruption unto us; and having become partakers of life: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* To anoint Thee as dead, the myrrh-bearing women came early in the morning, and offered weeping instead of myrrh; unto whom He Who Himself said "Rejoice!" commanded them to announce joy unto the disciples: Bless all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Behold, the pure Virgin conceives in her womb, as the radiant Isaiah foretold, saying unto the unwedded one: Bear the Savior of God, Whom all creation serves with fear, crying: Bless!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 8. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As Mother, thou hast surpassed the noetic ranks, and having drawn near unto God: We bless thy childbearing, O blessed Virgin, and highly exalt it![^90]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sacred voices of the God-inspired heralds from afar glorify thee as Mother of God and Virgin, through whom being deified we sing and highly exalt the Pure One unto the age!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Thou hast revealed natural beauty most excellent, having shone upon the flesh of the Godhead, O pure Virgin; therefore we sing of thee and highly exalt the Pure One unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: A new and God-befitting wonder: through the shut virginal gate manifestly enters the Lord, bare at His entrance, yet flesh-bearing and God in His going forth; and the gate remains shut: her unceasingly as Mother of God do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
