items.english_text: *Troparion:* Awesome is it to behold Thee, the Creator, lifted up upon the Tree, O Savior of God, God suffering in the flesh for His servants, and lying breathless in the tomb, loosing the dead from Hades: therefore, O Christ, as Almighty do we magnify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast saved our forefather from corruption of death, O Christ; Thou wast laid dead in the tomb, and hast blossomed forth life, raising the dead, and by Thy hand hast raised corruptible nature unto the light and clothed it in divine incorruption: therefore, as the Ever-living Source of light do we magnify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: O pure receptacle of Light...

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: ...God, Who was ineffably and changelessly incarnate of thee, having lifted up Adam's nature upon the Cross, became the first-born from the dead; and remaining God in the highest, together with the Father and the Divine Spirit, is glorified![^91]

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Cross. Ode 9. Heirmos: In the bush with fire...*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy Passion, O Savior, Thou hast granted incorruption and life unto the faithful, and by Thy life-creating rising Thou didst resurrect our earthly nature, seating it on high; therefore, praising Thee joyfully and unceasingly, do we magnify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Great and awesome is the King in radiance, and our Savior Christ over all the earth; for He Himself has shone forth as unwaning light, giving divine dominion and sure victory unto them that bow down before Him!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: Though bound in body and afflicted, I pray thee, loose me by thy kindness, not remembering my cruel, countless evils, O Virgin, that protected by thy prayers I may not perish!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Birthgiver of God. Ode 9. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Satiety of thy praises, O Virgin, never overtakes the pious faithful; for they ever receive the desired divine and spiritual love, magnifying thee as the Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ́ · г̃ · і́р̃ · И́ же ѡ̃ несоу́щии всѧ приведыи · сло́во съꙁи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast given us as unashamed intercessor her that bore Thee, O Christ: through her prayers Thou grantest mercy unto us, the Spirit, the Giver of grace, Who proceeds from the Father through Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Красна дшею красна помыслы · красна тѣлѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Finding thee fair in soul, fair in thoughts, and fair in body, the Fair One was incarnate from thy virginal flanks, as He knew, adorning that which was formless, O Virgin: Whom pray thou to save us![^92]

items.slavonic_text: ѡбрѣтъ тѧ красныи · и́ꙁ бокꙋ твоею дв̃ичьскѧ
items.english_text: *Then the Exapostilarion: Evangelical Resurrection [Exapostilarion].*

items.slavonic_text: въплътнсѧ · ꙗкоже свѣдыи · неѡбраженнаего оу́
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: крашаꙗ дв̃о · егоже моли спасти на̃ :~ та̃ . свѣ̃ .
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Come, all ye nations, understand the power of the awesome mystery: for Christ our Savior, Who was in the beginning the Word, was crucified for us, and was willingly buried, and is risen from the dead, that He might save all things: let us bow down before Him!

items.slavonic_text: єѵ̃льскаꙗ . въскр̃на . на хва . ст̃ры̃ . въскр̃ны .
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thy guards declared all the wonders, O Lord, but the assembly of vanity filled their right hands with gold, thinking to conceal Thy Resurrection, which all the world glorifies: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: гла̃ г̃ : Придѣте въсн ꙗ́ꙁыци · раꙁоумѣите стра
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* All things were filled with joy when they received proof of the Resurrection: Mary Magdalene came unto the tomb and found an angel sitting upon the stone, shining in his raiment, and saying: Why seek ye the Living among the dead? He is not here, but is risen, as He said, going before you into Galilee!

items.slavonic_text: шныꙗ таины силоу · х̃съ бо сп̃съ нашь · и́же спръва
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* In Thy light, O Master, shall we see light, O Lover of mankind; Who art risen from the dead, granting salvation unto the human race, that all creation may hymn Thee, the only Sinless One: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: сыи слово · распѧт сѧ нась ради · и́ волею погребе
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The myrrh-bearing women brought morning song with tears, O Lord: having sweet spices for a fragrance, unto Thy tomb...

items.slavonic_text: сѧ · въскрьсыи и́ꙁ мр̃твыихъ · да сп̃сеть въсѣчьска
items.english_text: ...they came, seeking eagerly to anoint Thy most pure body. But the angel sitting upon the stone proclaimed good tidings unto them: Why seek ye the Living among the dead? For having trampled down death, He is risen as God, granting great mercy unto all the faithful![^93]

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ : томоу поклоним сѧ :~ Повѣдаша въсѣ чюде
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Having come unto Thy tomb on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene, not finding Thy body, cried out weeping with lamentation: Woe is me, my Savior! How has the King of all been stolen? But the pair of light-bearing angels within the tomb cried out: Why weepest thou, O woman? I weep, she said, because they have taken away my Lord from the tomb, and I know not where they have laid Him. And turning back, when she saw Thee, she straightway cried out: My Lord and my God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: са стражіе твои г̃и · и́же съборы сꙋетныихь · и́ сплъ
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Finding Peter hiding, Mary Magdalene cried out: Why have ye forsaken the One Christ Who was straightway with you? Ye took no pity on Him as a friend, nor did ye remember Him as Master: shall the sting of death assemble you? Nay, come, behold the empty tomb of Him Who sits in the most pure bosom of the Father, and bow down before Him, Who has great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: ни и́мъ ꙁлатою десницю ихь · оу́таити мнѧхоу въ
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The angel, shining upon Thy life-giving tomb, said unto the myrrh-bearing women: The Deliverer has emptied the tombs and overthrown Hades, and is risen on the third day, as the only Mighty and Almighty One!

items.slavonic_text: скр̃сеніе твое · е́же весь мирь славить · помилоуи на̃ :~
items.english_text: *On Sunday, at the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: Радости въсѧ и́сплъниша сѧ · въскр̃сеніа и́скоусь
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When forefather Adam rejected Thy commandment, O Christ, Thou didst drive him out of Paradise; but when the thief, O Compassionate One, confessed Thee upon the Cross, Thou didst establish him therein, crying: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom![^94]

items.slavonic_text: прїемши · марїа магдалыни къ гробоу прииде ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, all creation was changed, seeing Thee, its Master, in human nature without earthly father; therefore with the thief we cry: Remember us, O Savior!

items.slavonic_text: и́ ѡбрѣте аг̃гела на камени сѣдѧща · риꙁами бли
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When we had sinned, Thou didst condemn us by the curse of death, O Giver of life, our God; but having suffered in Thy body, O Sinless Lord, Thou didst bring the dead to life, who cry: Remember us in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: стающи сѧ · и́ гл̃аща · что́ живаго съ мр̃твыими
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Moses, having stretched out his hands upon the mountain, prefigured the Cross and vanquished Amalek; and we, the faithful, having received it as a mighty weapon against demons, faithfully cry: Remember us, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: и́щете · нѣꙁдѣ нꙋ въскр̃се · ꙗкоже рече · варѧꙗ въ га
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Risen from the dead on the third day, Thou hast raised us up together by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and by Thy death Thou hast destroyed all the power of death, O Lord; therefore faithfully we cry out: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: лилеи :~ Въ свѣтѣ твоемь вл̃кѡ · оу́ꙁримы свѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst first appear unto the myrrh-bearing women when Thou hadst risen from the dead, O Savior, crying aloud: Rejoice! And through them announcing Thine arising unto Thy friends, O Christ; therefore with faith we cry: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: ч̃лколюбче · въскр̃сыи и́ꙁ мр̃твыихь · сп̃сеніе родоу
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Divine Spirit do we the faithful bow down, unto the uncreated Trinity, and in three Persons, one Godhead forever; with the bodiless...

items.slavonic_text: чл̃чьскомоу дароуꙗ · да тѧ вьсѧ тварь пѣсно
items.english_text: ...hosts, we faithfully glorify the Godhead in three Hypostases![^95]

items.slavonic_text: славить · е̃динаго беꙁгрѣшнаго · помилоуи на̃ :~
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, heavenly gate, through which the incarnate Creator passed, preserving thee sealed; rejoice, light cloud, bearing the divine rain, Christ; rejoice, throne and heavenly ladder; rejoice, mountain unhewn!

items.slavonic_text: і́ны . ст̃ры . въсточны . Пѣснь оу́трьнюю .
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3: Great is our Lord, and great is His power.*

items.english_text: *Epistle for the 3rd Sunday, to the Romans:*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: Brethren: Glory and honor and peace unto everyone that works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek; for there is no respect of persons with God. For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law; for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified, in tribulations; knowing that tribulation produces patience, and patience experience, and experience hope; and hope puts not to shame, because the love of God is shed abroad in your hearts by the Holy Spirit Who is given unto us. For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly. For scarcely for a righteous man will one die; yet perhaps for a good man someone would even dare to die. But God commends His love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us. Much more then, being now justified by His blood, we shall be saved from wrath through Him. For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of His Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved in His...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Alleluia: In Thee, O Lord, have I put my hope...*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: At that time, when Jesus entered Capernaum, a centurion approached Him, entreating Him and saying: Lord, my servant lies at home paralyzed, suffering terribly. Jesus says unto him: I will come and heal him. The centurion answered and said unto Him: Lord, I am not worthy that Thou shouldest come under my roof; but only speak the word, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me; and I say to this one: Go, and he goes; and to another: Come, and he comes; and to my servant: Do this, and he does it. When Jesus heard it, He marveled, and said unto them that followed Him: Truly I say unto you, not even in Israel have I found such faith. And I say unto you that many shall come from east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of heaven; but the sons of the Kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth. And He said unto the centurion: Go thy way; as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in that hour.

items.english_text: *Kinonikon: Praise [the Lord from the heavens]...*

items.english_text: *On Sunday evening, Penitential Stichera, Tone 3, without [the Stichera to] the Cross:*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Greatly sinning against Thee and grieving Thee, the good Master and merciful Nature, Who receivest them that turn from evil: make me, who foolishly transgressed, as one of Thy harlots...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: ...I have spent my life in negligence, and have drawn near unto the end, wretch that I am; and I consider not the impending judgment; but having turned me back from my fall, O Savior, rescue me from the snares![^97]

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Deliver my afflicted soul, O Lord, from the tomb and the gnashing of teeth, and from every other prepared torment, O Most Good One, that in faith I may sing of Thee, the merciful God and Lover of mankind by nature!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Stichera to the Bodiless Hosts, the same [Tone]:*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou hast presented the bodiless choirs, O Lord, the wealth of Thy goodness unto all, and hast brought them from non-existence into being, who now with unceasing voices glorify Thy glory which is beyond understanding!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Great is the splendor of Thine angels, O Christ: the bodiless ones run swiftly, preserving the Church by the power that comes from Thee, O Master, and they pray unto Thee for the universe!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Beholding the beauty of Thy three-sun and unique Godhead, the hosts that serve Thee reveal unto those in the world the brilliance thereof, and having immaterially adorned themselves, they grant us divine illuminations!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O most pure one who rulest over all creatures, my mind is terribly overwhelmed by passions: preserve me by thy fervent protection and maternal prayer, and make me a servant unto thy Son and Savior!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential [Stichera]:*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* To offer a faithful hymn as incense unto Thee, O Christ, and with good spiritual songs: have mercy, and save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Save me, O Lord my God, for Thou art the salvation of all: the storm of passions troubles me, and the burden of iniquities sinks me to the deep...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: ...give me a helping hand, and lead me up unto the light of compunction, as the only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind![^98]

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *To the Martyrs:* Great is the power of Thy Cross: for it was set up in one place, yet it operates in all the world; and from fishermen it showed forth Apostles, and from the Gentiles Martyrs, that they may pray for our souls!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mother of God, Protectress of all who pray unto thee, in thee do we place our hope, and in thee do we boast, and in thee is all our trust: pray thou unto Him Who was born of thee for thine unprofitable servants!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," set 8 [stichera], and we sing Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Bowing down unceasingly before Thy life-creating Cross, O Christ God, we sing and glorify Thy third-day Resurrection; for thereby hast Thou renewed corrupted human nature, O Almighty One, and hast renewed for us the heavenly ascent, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou hast loosed the sentence of the tree of disobedience, O Savior, by being willingly nailed to the tree of the Cross; and having descended into Hades, Thou didst burst the bonds of death as God; therefore do we bow down before Thy Resurrection from the dead, joyfully crying aloud: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou hast shattered the gates of Hades, O Lord, and by Thy death hast destroyed the kingdom of death, and hast set free the human race from corruption...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: ...granting life and incorruption unto the world, and great mercy![^99]

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Come, ye peoples, let us sing of the Savior's third-day arising, whereby we have been delivered from the unbreakable bonds of Hades, and having received incorruption and life, we cry: O Thou Who wast crucified, and buried, and art risen, save us by Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Angels and men, O Savior, sing of Thy third-day Resurrection, whereby the ends of the universe have been enlightened, and we all have been delivered from the servitude of the enemy, crying and saying: O Life-Creator, Almighty Savior, save us by Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou hast smashed the gates of brass, and broken in pieces the bars of iron, O Christ God, and hast raised up fallen mankind; therefore with one accord we cry aloud: Risen from the dead, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O Lord, Thy begetting of the Father was timeless and co-eternal; and Thine incarnation of the Virgin was ineffable and unutterable unto men; and Thy descent into Hades was terrible unto the devil and his angels: for having trampled down death, Thou didst rise on the third day, granting incorruption unto men and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Theotokion [Dogmatikon]:* The Prophet David, who through thee became the ancestor of God, in song cried out concerning thee unto Him that did great things for thee: At Thy right hand stood the Queen. For God, Who was well-pleased to become man of thee without father, showed thee forth as Mother, the mediatress of life, that He might fashion anew His own image, corrupted by passions; and having found the stray sheep, taking it upon His shoulders, He brings it unto the Father...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: ...and according to His own will unites it with the heavenly powers, and saves the world, O Mother of God, Christ Who has great and abundant mercy![^100]

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Ascending the Cross, O Lord, Thou didst cleanse our ancestral curse, and descending into Hades, Thou didst set free the eternal prisoners, granting incorruption and life unto the human race; therefore singing, we glorify Thy life-creating and saving Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Suspended upon the Tree, O only Mighty One, Thou didst shake all creation; and laid in the tomb, Thou didst raise up those dwelling in the tombs, granting incorruption and life unto the human race; therefore singing, we glorify Thy third-day arising!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* A lawless people, O Christ, delivering Thee unto Pilate, condemned Thee to be crucified, showing themselves ungrateful concerning Thy benefits; but having willingly endured burial, by Thine own sovereign power Thou didst rise on the third day as God, granting us endless life and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* With tears the women reached the tomb, seeking Thee; and not finding Thee, weeping with lamentation, they cried out, saying: Woe to us, our Savior, King of all! How hast Thou been stolen away? And what place holds Thy life-bearing body? But the angel answered them, saying: Weep not, but go and preach that He is risen, granting us joy, as the only Compassionate One!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Grant comfort unto thy servants, O all-immaculate one, putting an end to our cruel adversities and delivering us from every affliction; for thee alone do we have as a firm and sure...

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: ...foundation, and we have acquired thy protection: let us not be put to shame, O Sovereign Lady, who call upon thee; hasten to the supplication of those who faithfully cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, Helper of all, Joy and Protection of our souls![^101]

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Having learned from the angel the radiant proclamation of the Resurrection, and having cast away the ancestral condemnation, the Lord's female disciples boasting said unto the Apostles: Death is overthrown! Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown even unto the angels: through thee, O Mother of God, was revealed unto those upon earth as God, incarnate in unconfused union, and willingly accepting the Cross for our sake, whereby having resurrected the first-fashioned, He saved our souls from death!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Canon to the Most Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, whose acrostic is: "The fourth song I offer unto Thee." Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos: The Red Sea's deep...*

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let us glorify the Trinity in One Principle, forming a Unity, a Unity by nature, co-eternal and co-enthroned, entreating Whom we say: Save us who with faith honor Thee!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He was anointed by the Father with the Spirit of joy, the deifying oil, as the Son, having been manifested as the three-hypostatic Principle of the one Godhead.

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unable to endure gazing upon the beauty of the unapproachable glory of Thy radiance, O Three-Sun Unity, O Trinity, the seraphim veil themselves with wings, and unceasingly glorify Thee with thrice-holy hymns!

items.slavonic_text: оу́ханїа ꙗ́кѡ вонꙗ и́моуща · къ гробоу твое́моу
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having unutterably given birth to the Creator of all...

items.slavonic_text: дила еси преч̃таа · ветхыꙗ адам̃а и́ꙁбавляюще клѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* ...giving birth, O most pure one, delivering ancient Adam from the curse; and through thee have we come to know the one God in three Hypostases.[^102]

items.slavonic_text: твы · и́ съдрьжителѧ · и́ тобою познахомъ е̃дїнаго б̃а
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Power from on high Thou hast sent unto Thy disciples of old, as Thou didst send from the Father the Comforter, O Christ: it showed forth as one Thy three-sun essence.

items.slavonic_text: трисъставнаго :~ пѣ̃ . г̃ . ір̃мо . Не мудростиѫ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou didst appear unto Patriarch Abraham in the form of men, O Trinity in Unity, Thou didst reveal the unchanging nature of Thy goodness and dominion.

items.slavonic_text: Силоу свыше ты преже ап̃лѡ̃ твои · ꙗкоже посла
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O God Who art believed on as One in three forms, manifestly uncircumscribed, and incomprehensible unto all minds: deliver our souls from every affliction!

items.slavonic_text: лъ еси х̃е ѡ̃ ѡ̃ца оутѣшителѧ · є̃дино показа е̃сть тво
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having been directed by the all-wise guidance of Thy Son, we glorify the unique, three-radiant Godhead, and we bless thee, O Ever-Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: трислънечное :~ Патрїархоу авраамоу · е̃гда ꙗ́
items.english_text: By a single nod and by the most pure counsel of Thy Father and of the Spirit, Thou didst create all things, O Christ, Many-Merciful; and Thou didst accept crucifixion for the human race: therefore, giving thanks, we cry aloud unto Thee, O Merciful One: Have mercy on Thy flock, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: ви сѧ въ ѡ́браꙁѣ моужестѣ · тро́ичное единице не
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* All-hymned, unwedded Mother of Christ God, we glorify thy childbearing, O only merciful one, whereby we have been delivered from the deception of idols and from every calamity, O Sovereign Lady: therefore in faith we cry aloud unto thee: Have mercy on thy flock, O all-hymned one!

items.slavonic_text: премѣнно ꙗ́ви твоеꙗ бл̃гты и́ гс̃тва :~ И́ же въ ѡ́
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The supersubstantial Trinity in the unity of Godhead and supreme dominion, with the seraphim...

items.slavonic_text: браꙁѣхъ трїе единь б̃ъ вѣроуемыи · не ѡ́писаньно
items.english_text: ...we glorify Thee, the indivisible Nature, unconfused, of equal power, O God of glory, Who art incomprehensible![^103]

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́вѣ · и́ недооумѣваемыи свѣстьми · и́ꙁбави д̃ша
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Separated ineffably in the Persons of the Godhead, yet united by the dominion of one sovereignty, uncomposed and uniquely uncircumscribed, we hymn Thee, the Creator of all creation!

items.slavonic_text: наша ѡ̃ въсѣкоꙗ скръби :~ Съставленними бывы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Unoriginate Mind ineffably begot the Word, and the Divine Spirit proceeded with equal power; therefore do we proclaim the consubstantial Trinity, God the Master of all!

items.slavonic_text: ше сп̃а твоего · предмоудрыи повелении · е̃динь
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Appearing in ancient times under types, He announced beforehand the Word incarnate from thee, O Virgin; and in the last times He appeared unto men, truly revealing the one Principle in three Hypostases!

items.slavonic_text: ственое трисїꙗнное б̃гонач̃алне славимъ тѧ бла
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: All things were amazed...*

items.slavonic_text: жимъ пр̃но д̃во :~ сѣдална · гла̃ · д̃ · скоро пре :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having understood by faith the all-operative Godhead, we sing of the one impassible essence, in three life-originating and united Hypostases: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the co-eternal Nature!

items.slavonic_text: Е̃динѣмь мановенне · и́ прѣчистыи съвѣтом ѡ̃ца
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Three-Sun Light, shining with the essential radiance of Thy unique hypostatic Godhead, O Uncreated Nature, Giver of light, Source of every light-giving beam: grant that I may behold Thine ineffable beauty!

items.slavonic_text: твоего и́ д̃ха · съꙁдавыи вьсачъскаꙗ · х̃е много
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As the only essential Creator, Sustainer of all, and Ruler of boundaries, Truth and Life-Giver, we pray unto Thee in faith, O Master, O Three-Sun One: preserve [us]!

items.slavonic_text: мл̃тиве · и́ распѧтие приꙗть ꙁа ро̃ чл̃чськыи · тѣм
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Desiring to deify man who had decayed of old, [the Word] was incarnate from thee...

items.slavonic_text: бл̃годарѧще въпїемь ти мл̃тиве · помилоуи ста
items.english_text: ...in the image of divine knowledge, and becoming man, He revealed the one Principle in three Persons.[^104]

items.slavonic_text: до свое чл̃колюбче :~ сла̃ · і́ нн̃ · б̃ Прѣпѣтаа б̃гоневѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Manifestly the Father is revealed as resting, and the Spirit seen in Christ when He was baptized; therefore do we glorify the one Principle of the Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: стинаа мт̃и х̃а б̃а · и́ славимъ рж̃тво твое е̃диного мл̃ти
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As [Isaiah] saw Thee, with thrice-holy voices we hymn Thee as sitting upon a high throne; he recognized the three-sun Hypostases of the one Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: ваа · и́мже и́ꙁбавихомь сѧ и́долскыꙗ льсти · и́ ѡ̃
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having an exalted heart, O Exalted King in three Hypostases, show us also forth as Thy servants, that we may intelligently behold the brightness of Thy glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: въсѣкоꙗ бѣды вл̃чце , тѣмь вѣроѭ въпїемь ти
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst deign to fashion anew our nature, appearing from the Virgin, O Savior and God; as the Lover of mankind, Thou hast made the human race partakers of divine glory!

items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ . д̃ . ір̃мо . Сѣдѧи въ . Пресꙋщественоую тр̃ицꙋ въ
items.english_text: Incomprehensible God and unapproachable, one God by nature: O Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, cover and preserve us who cry aloud in faith in Thy holy church, night and day; and deliver us not, O Master, unto the enemies who seek our destruction!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Despise us not, O all-hymned Virgin: with thanksgiving we sing of thee from our heart; make us, thy servants, worthy of thy mercies, who cry aloud and say: O Most Holy Mother of God and Virgin, anticipate and deliver us from enemies visible and invisible, and from every dire threat, for thou art our protection!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Imitating upon earth the ranks of heaven, the intelligent powers and the radiance of glory...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...we praise Thee divinely in one single-operative Hypostasis in three Persons![^105]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The pure Prophet of old spoke of Thee under types, the Creator before the ages of ages, having revealed the ineffable God with the Unoriginate One, the divine three-person Hypostases!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Word, invisible by essence, all-creative: Thou didst appear unto men, becoming man from the holy Mother of God, taking flesh unto the participation of Thy Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast appeared as the east of the noetic Sun, Who appeared bodily, and thou enlightenest all, O Mother of God, Ever-Blessed Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Light, single in principle and three-radiant, Unoriginate Essence, Incomprehensible Beauty: dwell within us, and show us forth as light-bearing temples of Thy Godhead, who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Indivisible Trinity and unconfused Unity: deliver me from various passions and darkness and transgressions, and illumine me with Thy beneficent rays, that I may behold Thy glory, and hymn Thee, the God of glory!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Supersubstantial Mind, the Father; and Son, the co-express Word; and Spirit co-enthroned: one Essence and Power, co-eternal Nature and ineffable Majesty: O Trinity in Unity, preserve Thy flock, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure one, thou containest the vessel holding the divine Manna; with luminous torches the faithful cry unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace, joy of Apostles...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...and rejoicing of Martyrs![^106]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Let every earthborn mortal...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Now do I lift up my heart and mind, and the vows of soul and body, unto Thee, my Creator and Deliverer, O only Unoriginate and Three-Radiant One: give ear and save me, Thy servant, from all temptations and afflictions!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Lift up our minds and thoughts unto Thee on high; enlighten us with most pure beams, O Father, Word, and Spirit: unapproachable, co-express Light, Sun of glory, Sovereign of light, that we may ever glorify Thee, God single in principle and in three Hypostases!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the Father, and the Son, and the divine Spirit do we the faithful bow down, unto the uncreated Trinity in three Persons in one Godhead ever; with the bodiless powers, we faithfully glorify the Godhead in three Hypostases!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save me who believe in Thee, O Lord, and who proclaim the unoriginate and co-eternal single essence, and three divine and co-express Persons; and make me worthy of Thy divine glory, by the intercessions of Thy most pure Mother!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Then "It is truly meet," and the rest as indicated before. At "God is the Lord," the Troparion; and search before for the Trinity Kathismata.*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma Reading, Resurrection Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Having looked upon the entrance of the tomb, and unable to endure the angelic flame, the myrrh-bearing women marveled with trembling, saying: Has He been stolen, Who opened Paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen, Who before His Passion preached the...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...Resurrection? Truly the Lord is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in Hades![^107]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Twice. Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Awesome and truly most glorious wonder: how the Virgin gave birth unto Thee, the Creator, and after childbearing remained again a Virgin! By the birth from her, strengthen the faith, and tame the nations, and grant peace unto the whole world, as the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma Reading, Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* By Thy voluntary counsel Thou didst endure crucifixion, and mortal men laid Thee in a new tomb, Who by Thy word didst establish the ends of the earth; therefore the alien enemy was bound, and death was cruelly spoiled, and all those in Hades cried aloud: Christ the Life-Giver is risen, abiding unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Repeat. Glory... Both now... Theotokion, Podoben: "Joseph marveled" (Удивися Иосиф):*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: Joseph marveled, seeing that which was beyond nature; he considered in his mind the rain upon the fleece in thy seedless conception, O Mother of God, the bush burning with fire, Aaron's rod that budded; and bearing witness, thy betrothed and guardian cried aloud unto the priests: A Virgin brings forth, and after childbearing remains again a Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 4:* Having run unto Thy glorious arising, the myrrh-bearing women announced good tidings unto the Apostles, that Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* From my youth many passions war against me; but do Thou Thyself help me and save me, O my Savior!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Ye who hate Zion, be put to shame by the Lord...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...for ye shall be withered as grass by fire![^108]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *By the Holy Spirit:* Every soul is quickened, and by purity exalted, shining mystically in the Trinitarian Unity.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* I have cried fervently unto Thee, O Lord, from the depth of my soul; let Thine ears be attentive unto my divine supplication!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Whosoever has acquired hope in the Lord is higher than all who cause affliction.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *By the Holy Spirit:* Streams of grace gush forth, watering all creation unto revitalization.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Let my heart be lifted up unto Thee, O Word, and let nothing of the world's beauties entice me unto weakness!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* As one has love toward his mother, even more fervently are we bound in loving affection toward God.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *By the Holy Spirit:* The riches of divine theology, contemplation of God, and wisdom: for therein does the Word reveal all the Father's decrees.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 4: Arise, O Lord, help us.*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Let every breath [praise the Lord]... The Evangelical Resurrection [Gospel]. Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ... Psalm 50: Have mercy on me, O God...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Resurrection Canon, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: Having traversed the deep of the Red Sea with dry feet, ancient Israel of old vanquished the might of Amalek in the wilderness through the hands of Moses stretched out in the form of a cross.

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast raised up our fallen state, correcting upon the most pure wood of the Cross the ancient all-destructive ruin, O Master, healing it as Good and Almighty!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...Almighty![^109]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Bodily in the tomb, but in Hades with Thy soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the throne wast Thou, O Christ, with the Father and the Spirit, filling all things, Thyself uncircumscribed!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without seed by the Holy Spirit, by the Father's will, thou didst conceive the Son of God, and in the flesh didst give birth unto Him Who from the Father is without mother, and for our sake from thee without father!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: I shall open my mouth...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Healing the ruin of mankind, renewed by divine Blood, and crushing by might him that had crushed Thy creation of old...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The resurrection of the dead was wrought by Thy slaying, and strength was given over unto mortification, submitting with eternal life, as we bow down before God incarnate!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Higher in beauty than the heavenly hosts, the living temple of God was thine, O Virgin, who didst bear in thy womb our God, the most pure mountain!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God. Heirmos: Three staths...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The peoples trembled, the nations were troubled, and mighty kingdoms bowed down, O holy one, from the fear of thy childbearing; God the King came, overthrowing the tyrant, and delivered the world from corruption!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He that dwells on high made thee a habitation for Himself in His descent unto mankind, O Christ, and showed thee unshaken; for alone after childbearing did she preserve virginity, keeping the birth of the Creator!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Written in the unwritten Father, on the tree of old, and in the Mother's bosom Christ is bodily enrolled; Who after childbearing is preserved as truly Virgin beyond understanding...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...unto Whom let us sing aloud, unto our God, for He has been glorified![^110]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy Church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying: Thou art my strength, O Lord, my refuge and my firm foundation!*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Tree of life, the noetic true Vine, hangs upon the Cross, gushing forth incorruption unto all!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* How great, how awesome is He Who destroyed the boasting of Hades! As incorrupt God, He is now risen bodily from the tomb!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone on earth wast shown forth as the mediatress of supernatural blessings, O Mother of God: therefore with joy do we cry unto thee!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: Thy singers...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Filled with serpentine venom, the jaws struck against Thee, O Savior; and the Creator and Master of all with nails crushed his hand, for there is none holy besides Thee, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst willingly appear, O Lover of mankind; laid in the tomb, O Life-Giver, Thou didst open the gates of Hades unto eternal souls, for there is none holy besides Thee, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast shown forth as the untilled field, giving birth to the living Ear of wheat, becoming the mediatress of immortality unto all that partake of the Holy One Who holily rests in the holy place!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Descending from on high...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The earthly nature is cleansed, having conversed with the unbearable divine Fire, as in resurrection, O most pure Virgin, unto Him Who preserved unharmed from thee the unbaked Bread!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Truly drawing near unto God, as higher than all the angelic ranks, alone in the beauty of virginity, as Mother of the Ruler of all...

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: ...Almighty![^111]

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Marveled at beyond mind, they cannot comprehend thy childbearing, O Virgin; for in thy womb, O pure one, thou didst conceive the Word, the Fore-First, Who established every word!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst come healing by Thy Passion; on the Cross Thou dost suffer in Thy most pure flesh, in which Thou wast willingly clothed: therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thy power!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Leaving deadened death in the tomb, my Deliverer, bound today, is risen: unto Him let us cry aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Unwedded didst thou give birth, O Virgin, and after childbearing wast preserved; therefore unceasingly with joy, O Sovereign Lady, in uncondemned faith we cry unto thee!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: Unto the untraceable divine counsel...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Israel that received the law understood Thee not, God Who gavest the law; transgressing the law, they nailed Thee to the Cross as lawless, unworthy of the Lawgiver!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy divine soul, having despoiled the dwellings of Hades, raised up together the dead of ages, while Thy life-bearing body became the source of incorruption unto all!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, Ever-Virgin, truly the only Mother of God do we glorify, whom the seer Moses beheld prefigured, the unburnt bush that cleaved unto the fire, O most pure one!

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Sitting in [glory]...*

items.slavonic_text: е̃динствѣ бж̃тва · и́ господоначалїа · съ серафимы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He lived with men, the Invisible becoming visible, in the likeness of the Son...

items.slavonic_text: постижимаго бж̃тва · и́ въ ѡ́бражен сѧ ѡ̃ тебе д̃во ·
items.english_text: ...comprehended Godhead, and being depicted from thee, O Virgin, alien unto bitterness to those who know thee as the true Mother of God.[^112]

items.slavonic_text: ѡ́тꙋжда горес̂ти вѣдꙋщїитѧ и́стоую б̃огородите
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Immaterially did the Virgin receive the Immaterial One, become an Infant from her amidst material things; therefore in two natures is God recognized as flesh-bearer, and above earthly nature.

items.slavonic_text: льницꙋ :~ Приꙗть невещественѣ дѣваа · невеще
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A Virgin after childbearing: He Who dwelt in thee, O Virgin, and was born of thee without seed, the Word, yet remained with the Father; and in childbearing He preserved thee a Virgin, as Master and Creator.

items.slavonic_text: ственаго · посрѣдѣ вещеи младенца ѡ̃ неꙗ бывша ·
items.english_text: *Resurrection Canon, Tone 4. Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: тѣмъ въ двѣхъ оу́ществѣ познавает сѧ плотоносе
items.english_text: Thou, O Lord, art my light, come into the world, a holy Light turning from the darkness of ignorance those who sing praise unto Thee in faith!

items.slavonic_text: ць б̃ъ · и́ ꙁемлены прѣвыше естества :~ По рожде
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou, O Lord, didst mercifully come down unto earth; Thou didst raise up fallen human nature, being lifted up upon the Tree!

items.slavonic_text: ствѣ д̃вꙋ · и́же въ д̃воу втѧ всели сѧ и́ прождешна
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast taken from me, O Christ, the condemnation of sins; Thou hast destroyed the pangs of death, O Bountiful One, by Thy divine Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: беꙁь сѣмене слово · нѫ съпрѣбысть · и́ въ рожде
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee as an invincible weapon against enemies do we set forth; thee as the fortress and hope of our salvation do we possess, O Bride of God!

items.slavonic_text: ствѣ д̃вою съхранни ꙗ́ко вл̃ка и́ ꙁижитель :~ пѣ̃ е̃
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: All things were astonished...*

items.slavonic_text: ір̃мо . Ты г̃и ми свѣть · въ миры пришелъ еси · свѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Senseless Hades received Thee wholly into his mouth, seeing Thee nailed upon the Tree and pierced with a spear, thinking Thee a mere man without living soul; but his teeth were crushed by Thy divine might! He beheld the temple of Thy body destroyed, yet the tomb corrupted [Thee] not, being laid therein by Thine own will; he took both into his grasp, soul and...

items.slavonic_text: ть свѣтло ѡ́кращаа · ѡ́мраченны невѣдѣниꙗ к вѣрою
items.english_text: ...body, while the other sent them down into death.[^113]

items.slavonic_text: въспѣвающи тѧ :~ Ты г̃и на ꙁемлю мл̃тивно съ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Fulfilled and brought to an end were the prophetic sayings: for thou, O Virgin, without knowing a man's bed, didst receive in thy womb God Who is over all, and didst give birth unto the ageless Son, granting peace unto all that sing praise unto thee!

items.slavonic_text: шелъ еси · ты въꙁдвиже падшее чл̃ческое сѫщество
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Heirmos: Arisen...*

items.slavonic_text: Ты въꙁꙗ ты мн х̃е грѣховное съмоущенне · ты
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a house of glory, and the holy mountain of God, a Bride, a bridal chamber, a temple of sanctification, God the Savior lived in thee, making us upright and all-immaculate.

items.slavonic_text: раꙁроуши колыꙁанне съмр̃тныꙗ цер̃е · бж̃твеныи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst accept human covering, O Christ, without seed, most purely, inconfusedly, endued with a rational and noetic soul, by active will possessing sovereign mastery.

items.slavonic_text: въскренне :~ Тѧ ѡ́рꙋжїе непобѣдилое на врагы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The virginal womb put to shame the tyrant's mind; for as an Infant He touched with His hand the asp's soul-destroying den, and cast down the proud apostate, subduing him under the feet of our faithful Prince!

items.slavonic_text: прелагаемь · тѧ дрьжавоу и́ надеждоу нашего
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: I shall sacrifice unto Thee with a voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that mercifully flowed from Thy side!*

items.slavonic_text: сп̃сенїю · б̃гоневѣсто и́мамы :~ і́нь кр̃т ір̃м · Оу́ди
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, having girded Thyself with power, grappling with the tyrant; casting him down from the heights, Thou didst raise Adam up together with Thee by Thine invincible might!

items.slavonic_text: виша . Приꙗтъ всего оу́сты а́дь беꙁоумныи · на
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst rise most radiantly from the tomb, O Christ; Thou didst scatter all enemies by divine might, and filled all peoples with joy!

items.slavonic_text: древѣ бо пригвожена тѧ видѣвь · и́ копїемь пробо
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Than which of all ancient...

items.slavonic_text: дена беꙁь д̃ша жива б̃а проста мнѧщи тѧ чл̃ка · ра
items.english_text: ...marvels more marvelous, that as a Virgin in thy womb thou didst unwedded receive the Word Who holds all things together, containing Him without constraint![^114]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* One Lordship do I honor in three Persons indivisible, singing the three-hypostatic essence: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* In white guise appeared the Angel of the Resurrection unto the women, flashing with unapproachable light: Why cry ye at the tomb seeking the Living as dead? Behold, Christ is risen, unto Whom we sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone among all generations wast shown forth, O Virgin, all-pure Mother; thou wast the habitation of the Godhead, O all-immaculate, unconsumed by the fire of the divine Light: therefore do all of us bless thee, O Mary, Bride of God!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend, O Christ, upon the Tree of the Cross, and didst call all nations, willing to save the corrupt nature of Adam; therefore with thanksgiving we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy Crucifixion, O Lord!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Through thee, O pure Mother of God, have we known the God of all, and we have become sons of the Most High, ever crying unto thee: Rejoice, thou that art full of grace, the Lord is with thee!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Passing as a lily clothed in purity, O most pure one, by the Holy Spirit, shining in the midst of thorns and filling with fragrance those who sincerely magnify thee!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having assumed corrupt earthly nature from thine all-immaculate womb, the Incorrupt One showed it forth in Himself as incorrupt in His tender mercy: therefore do we magnify thee as the Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou that rulest over all creatures, grant unto thy people victorious vanquishing, putting the unsubmissive under the feet of our Prince, that we may magnify thee as the Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: Thou Who didst endure crucifixion and death, O Savior, and didst rise from the dead, O Almighty Lord: Glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* By Thy Cross, O Christ our Savior, deliver us from the snare of the enemy; and risen from the dead, raise us up who have fallen from sins, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord Lover of mankind, by the intercessions of Thy saints!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* By Thy Cross, O Christ, we have been set free from the ancient curse; and by Thy death Thou didst bring to naught the devil who tormented our nature, and by Thy Resurrection...

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: ...Thou didst fill all things with joy: therefore do we cry unto Thee: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee![^119]

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou didst accept death in the flesh, and didst grant us immortality, O Savior; and Thou didst dwell in the tomb that Thou mightest free us from Hades, raising us up together with Thyself: Thou didst suffer indeed as man, yet didst rise as God: therefore do we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Life-Giver, Lord, only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The rocks were split, O Savior, when Thy Cross was set up at the Place of the Skull; the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified when Thou wast laid in the tomb as dead; for having abolished the power of death, Thou didst grant incorruption unto the dead by Thy Resurrection, O Life-Giver, Savior, Lord: Glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Rejoice today, all creatures! Rejoice, for Christ is risen, having shattered the brazen gates and broken the iron bars, and brought Adam forth from the gates of death, and freed mankind from corruption! Where is thy victory, O Hades? Let us the faithful cry aloud: Where is thy sting, O death? Thou hast destroyed the arrogance of Hades, O Master; for as Ruler and Lord of all, Thou didst expose the devil by the Cross, and didst grant resurrection unto the dead, and didst make known ineffable life in the Gospel, being the only Good and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Where is Jesus Whom ye kept watching? Tell us, O Judeans: Where is He Whom ye laid in the tomb and sealed the stone? Give up the dead Man, Whom ye deprived of life! Give up the Buried One, or believe in Him Who is risen! For even if ye keep silence...

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: ...the stone rolled away from the tomb shall cry aloud of the Lord's Resurrection! Great is Thy mercy, great is the mystery of Thy dispensation, O our Savior: Glory to Thee![^120]

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Where are the seals of the tomb? Where are Pilate's soldiers guarding the sepulchre? O how was the treasure stolen? How was the Buried One moved? Slander not the Resurrection of Christ! The Lord was willingly crucified, and He is risen even as He willed, granting life and great mercy unto the inhabited world!

items.english_text: *At the Liturgy. The Beatitudes, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* On account of the tree was Adam banished from Paradise; but through the tree of the Cross did Christ establish the thief in Paradise: for the one, having tasted, transgressed the commandment of the Creator; but the other, being crucified, confessed Thee as God, crying: Remember us, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Living in Paradise, Adam transgressed; but the thief, beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Master, confessed Thee as God, seeking the heavenly Kingdom, and with these words cried unto Thee, O Lord Lover of mankind, our God: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ascending upon the Cross, Thou didst destroy the power of death and wiped out the handwriting of old against us, O Master; as Thou didst accept the repentance of the thief, grant it also unto us, O Lover of mankind, who in faith cry unto Thee, O Lord, merciful Christ: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ascending upon the Cross, Thou didst destroy the dominion of death; laid in the tomb...

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: ...Thou didst raise up all those in Hades, becoming the Firstborn from the dead, and eternal life was bestowed: therefore by Thy Resurrection save us, O our Deliverer: Remember us![^121]

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy disciples, O Christ, having been eyewitnesses of Thy sufferings and burial and divine resurrection, caught the nations and as fishes brought all in faith: with them we cry unto Thee: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Trinity Troparion:* The Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit do we all with one mind glorify, worthily praying unto the Unity of the Godhead in three Persons, abiding unconfusedly, simple, indivisible, and unapproachable; worshiping Him we sing, being delivered from torment: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy Mother, O Christ, who in the flesh bore Thee without seed, and remained in truth an incorrupt Virgin: her do we bring unto Thee in prayer, O Master; grant forgiveness of sins as Merciful unto those that cry unto Thee: Remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те

items.english_text: *Epistle: To the Hebrews [2 Cor. 6:16–18]:*

items.slavonic_text: лне волею · на вїе ѡ́ба и́стѧꙁаета · ѡ́бысты д̃ша и́ те
items.english_text: Brethren, ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said: I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people. Therefore come out from among them, and be ye cleansed, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you, and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be My sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty...

items.english_text: The Lord said: Whosoever will come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for My sake and the Gospel's, the same shall save it. For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul? Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of Me and of My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of him also shall the Son of Man be ashamed, when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels. And He said unto them: Truly, truly, I say unto you, that there be some of them that stand here, who shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

items.english_text: ...unapproachable, O Father Almighty, Word, and Spirit, that I may ever be well-pleasing unto Thee, O Lord of all![^132]

items.slavonic_text: жати тебѣ присно · г̃и въсꙗческихъ :~ Ѡ́блиста
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast shone forth the thrice-radiant glory, O all-hymned One, Christ and Lord, calling all to hymn the one Godhead in three Persons unto the ages.

items.slavonic_text: ла еси патре̃ лънечныꙗ славы · едино̑го прѣпѣ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The gold-gleaming lampstand foreshadowed thee, who didst receive the ineffable, unapproachable Light; with light thou enlightenest the earthly, Whom we highly exalt unto the ages.

items.slavonic_text: таа х̃а и̃ г̃а · всꙗ приꙁывающи е̃динаго б̃гоначалїа
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Rejoice, O Isaiah! For a Virgin hath conceived...*

items.slavonic_text: въ тре̃ лицехъ пѣти въ вѣкы :~ Златоꙁарныи свѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Earthly hymns cannot fittingly hymn Thee, O unoriginate Trinity; but as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind, since we dare by faith, O God-originating and co-enthroned Unity, we offer glory and praise unto Thy dominion!

items.slavonic_text: тилникъ тѧ проѡ́браꙁова · приємши неизречнный свѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Equally honoring Thee, the Seraphim hymn Thee with most holy lips as the one-originate and thrice-radiant God; with them receive also us sinners, O Lord, who sing of and magnify Thy dominion!

items.slavonic_text: непрѣстоупныи · свѣто̃ ѡ́ꙁарꙗеши вьсе̃ ꙁѣтьскꙗꙗ ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Look upon our debts, Thou Who in three God-originating Hypostases art the one true God of glory, and grant comfort unto Thy servants, through the prayers of the all-pure one and Mother of God, holy above all!

items.slavonic_text: егоже превоꙁносимъ въ вѣкы :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́р̃мо Исаиа ли
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As pure and immaculate Virgin, thou hast given birth unto the Savior Who delivers us from corruption, the immutable God; but now also send down upon us, O all-pure one, remission of our transgressions!

items.slavonic_text: кꙋи д̃ва а́кы въ оутробѣ въꙁ :~ Пѣнїа тѧ ꙁемнаа подѡ́
items.english_text: *Then 4 [hymns] of the other [choir], and the rest as indicated in the first Tone.*

items.english_text: *At "God is the Lord," Troparion, Tone 5: [written at Vespers]. After the first stichology:*

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:* Let us praise the Cross of the Lord, and honor His holy burial with hymns, and glorify His Resurrection; for as God He raised the dead from the tombs, and brought to naught the dominion of death and the strength of the devil, and shone light upon those in darkness![^133]

items.slavonic_text: льнаа съпрѣстолнаа единице · славꙋ приносимы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* O Lord, Thou wast called dead, Who didst slay death; and Thou wast laid in a tomb, Who didst empty the tombs; above, soldiers guarded the tomb, while below Thou didst raise up those who slept from the ages: O Almighty and Incomprehensible Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: твоеи дръжавѣ · и́ хваленїе :~ Равночъстно тѧ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Who can declare thy greatness? For thou didst bear the Creator of all creation, Who suffered for our sake, and rose from the dead, and raised [mankind], O Pure One, from the corruption of deceitful passions: O ecclesial throne of the Lord, chosen earth, and overshadowed mountain, amendment of sinners!

items.slavonic_text: славѧть · е̃диноначалнаго и́ трисвѣтлаго б̃а · по
items.english_text: *After the second stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:* O Lord, the lawless condemned nailed Thee in their midst, and with a spear they pierced Thy side, O Merciful One; and Thou didst accept burial, shattering the gates of Hades; and Thou didst arise on the third day. The women ran to see Thee, and having seen Thee, they proclaimed the Resurrection unto the Apostles: O highly exalted Savior, Whom the Angels hymn, blessed art Thou, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́ть серафими прѣст҃ыми доу́шетнами · с нимиже и́
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* O Lord, on the third day of Thy Resurrection, at the veneration of the Apostles, Peter cried aloud unto Thee: The women showed boldness, but I was afraid; the thief confessed Thee, but I denied Thee: wilt Thou call...

items.slavonic_text: ны съгрѣшныꙗ приими г̃и · и́ твоею державоу поюще
items.english_text: ...me henceforth Thy disciple, or wilt Thou make me once more a fisher of the deep? But receive me in repentance, O Christ God, and have mercy on me![^134]

items.slavonic_text: и́ величающе :~ Приꙁри к нашим долгамъ · и́же въ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O unwedded Mother, pure Theotokos, who didst turn Eve's sorrow into joy, we the faithful sing of and worship thee, for thou hast led us up from the ancient curse; and now pray unceasingly, O all-pure one, that we may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: трехь б̃гоначалныи съставѣхъ · единыи б̃ъ сыи и́ и́сти
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 5:* Perplexed in mind by the angelic vision, yet enlightened in soul by the divine Resurrection, the Myrrh-bearers brought good tidings unto the Apostles: Proclaim the Resurrection among the nations, as the Lord works together with miracles, and grants unto us great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: ненныи слави · подаи же рабом твоим оутѣшенїе · моли
items.english_text: *Hymns of the Degrees, Tone 5. Antiphon 1. Verse:* When I am afflicted, David-like do I sing unto Thee, O my Savior: deliver my soul from a deceitful tongue!

items.slavonic_text: твами преч̃тыꙗ и́ всѣхъ ст̃ыꙗ б̃гоматере :~ Ꙗ́ко чи
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* By the Holy Spirit all things visible and invisible are upheld; for being truly Sovereign, He is truly One of the Trinity.

items.slavonic_text: стаа и́ непорочнаа д̃во родила еси сп̃са · и́ꙁбавлꙗю
items.english_text: *Antiphon 2. Verse:* Arise unto the mountains, O my soul; go thither, whence thy help shall come!
