items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* Theologizing, let us say unto the Holy Spirit: Thou art God, life, desire, light, and intellect; Thou art goodness, Thou reignest unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: вленїе нашим прегрѣшенїе · ниꙁпосли преч̃таа :~ та̃
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* By the Holy Spirit is the life-originating dignity, from Whom every living creature is inspirited, as from the Father and together with the Word.

items.slavonic_text: д̃ ѡ́ иновѣ · и́ прочаа ꙗ́ко ꙋкаꙁано бы на пер̃ во гл̃сѣ :~
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 5: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up (LXX Ps. 9:33). Verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart (LXX Ps. 9:2). Let every breath... The Matins Gospel: The Resurrection of Christ... Psalm 50: Have mercy on me, O God...*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos: The horse and the riders... (Коня и всадники...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* The horse and the riders in the Red Sea, He Who shatters wars with a high arm, Christ shook off, and saved Israel, as they sang a triumphal hymn.

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, O Christ, the thorn-bearing synagogue of the Hebrews, having preserved no love toward Thee, the Benefactor, crowned with thorns as Ancestor, Who didst annul the penalty of thorns!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst raise me who had fallen into the pit, bowing down, O Life-Giver; having sought me out who was foul-smelling, and having endured the stench without experiencing sin, O Christ, Thou hast perfumed me with divine myrrh!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The curse is dissolved, and sorrow hath ceased: for the blessed and joyfully graced one hath shone forth joy and blessing unto the faithful, bearing Christ, the Flower, unto the whole universe!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Unto the Savior... (Спасителю...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Nailed in the flesh unto the Cross of Thine own will, Thou hast freed by the wood him that had fallen through the ancient denial: let us sing unto Him alone, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Nailed in the flesh upon the Cross, by the wood...

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: ...having destroyed the dominion of death, and descended into Hades, Thou art risen from the dead, O God, and hast reconciled the world in peace![^136]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Mother of God, unceasingly pray unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, and Who was not parted from the bosom of the Father, to deliver our souls from every assault!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Спасителю...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Light dwelt in thee, O all-pure one, and enlightened the world with the splendors of the Godhead: pray unto Christ to enlighten all who praise thee, O Virgin Mother!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As thou wast adorned with the beauty of virtues, O rejoiced one, working good beauty, thou didst receive spiritual radiance, O all-pure one, [bearing] Him Who adorned all things!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Sinaitic bush foreshadowed thee of old, remaining unconsumed, O Theotokos, when touched by fire: for as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and as a Virgin thou didst remain, beyond comprehension, O Bride of God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Establishing the earth upon nothing... (Утверждей землю ни на чемже...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and suspended its uncontainable weight: on the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only Good One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Gall they sought [to give Thee], they who had sucked [honey from the rock] in the wilderness for Him Who poured it forth; they brought Thee vinegar, O Christ, instead of manna; such thankfulness did the senseless children of Israel render unto Thee!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Those who of old were covered by the luminous cloud laid Christ the Life in the tomb; but rising by Thine own sovereign power, Thou didst grant unto all the faithful the spiritual radiance mystically overshadowing from above!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou, O Mother of God, without...

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: ...wedlock didst become [Mother] unto Him Who shone forth from the incorrupt Father, and without maternal pangs: therefore do we orthodoxly proclaim thee Theotokos, for thou didst bear the incarnate Word![^137]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: By the power of the Cross... (Силою Креста...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Risen from the tomb, O Christ, and delivering from the corruption of death: we hymn Thy third-day Resurrection, O Life-Giver!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* To anoint Thy body, O Christ, the Myrrh-bearers came unto Thy tomb, and finding it not, they returned with joy, glorifying Thy rising!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Pray unceasingly, O Pure One, unto Him Who came forth from thy loins, to deliver from the deceit of the devil those who praise thee as the Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Силою Креста...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The ladder whereby the Most High came down unto us to restore corrupted nature, He visibly showed thee naturally unto all: for through thee the Pre-good One was well pleased to unite Himself unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The mystery commanded of old by the Spirit, foreseen before the ages by all-seeing God, in these last of ages received fulfillment in thy womb, O all-pure one, and was manifested!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The ancient condemnation of the curse was dissolved through thy mediation, O pure Virgin; for from thee God appeared, pouring forth blessing unto all as the Pre-good One!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Perceiving Thy divine condescension with prophetic insight, O...*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Perceiving Thy divine dispensation, marveling, Habakkuk cried aloud unto Thee with trembling, O Christ: Thou art come for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thy servants!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The bitter waters of Marah...

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: ...as foreshadowing the image of Thy most pure Cross, O Lord, putting to death the condemnation of sin, Thou didst sweeten by the wood![^138]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Cross instead of the tree of knowledge, gall instead of food, the soldiers brought unto Thee, O Christ, while Thou didst pour out Thy divine blood, incorruptible in death!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without wedlock thou didst conceive, incorruptibly receiving in the womb, and thou didst bear God in the flesh, and after childbirth thou wast preserved a Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: I heard, [O Lord,] the report... (Услышах слух...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thy Cross was planted upon Calvary, O Christ, then the gates of Hades were shattered, and the eternal gatekeepers cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou didst descend, O Christ, unto the bound as dead, Thou didst raise up with Thyself the dead from the ages, and they cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin, thou didst give birth, and knewest not man, but wast known as the Mother of God, and remainedst a Virgin, as we praise thee: Rejoice, in hymns, O Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Услышах слух...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With heart and mind, with soul and lips do we faithfully confess thee truly to be the Theotokos, O Pure One, receiving unfeigned salvation, O Virgin, through thy prayers!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He Who created all things out of nothingness was clothed in flesh from thee, as the Benefactor was well pleased, for the salvation of those who sing of thee with faith and love, O all-pure one!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Praising thy childbirth, O all-hymned one, the transcendent choirs rejoice in hymnody, beholding thee as the Theotokos nurturing an infant, O ecclesial Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Clothed with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early and cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou art merciful! (Одеяйся свѣтом яко ризою, к Тебѣ утренюю и к Тебѣ вопїю: душу мою просвѣти омраченную, Христе, яко Милостивъ!):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The glorious God, in marvelous form, hangs willingly upon the tree, stripped of all honor, providing for me ineffable divine glory![^139]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast shown forth ever-shining incorruption, O Christ, having incorruptibly tasted mortal corruption in the flesh, rising from the tomb on the third day!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou who didst bear Christ without seed as salvation and righteousness unto us, freest ancestral dominion from the curse!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Rising early... (Утренюю...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy three-day burial Thou didst overthrow Hades, and manifestly didst raise all, as a merciful Lord!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy Cross, O Passionless One, Thou hast abolished death, O Christ God, and slain our sins!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Cease not to pray for us unto Him Whom thou didst bear, O Theotokos, that He may save the souls of us who praise thee, O Holy One!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Утренюю...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All the Prophets proclaimed beforehand concerning thee, that thou shouldest be the Mother of God, O all-pure Theotokos; for thou alone wast holy and seen to be immaculate!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A luminous cloud, raining down living water unto us, having rained down the incorruptible Christ, known by unhoped-for tokens, O Pure One!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As undefiled in immaculate beauty, He purely loved thy virginity to remain incorrupt, He Who dwelt within thee as the only Good and Compassionate One!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Surging with the soul-destroying tempest, O Master Christ, calm the sea of passions and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art merciful! (Волнящееся бурею душепагубною, Владыко Христе, похотное море укроти, и от тли возведи мя, яко Милостивъ!):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Into corruption fell the forefather, O Master Christ, having tasted of the forbidden food, and was raised unto life through Thy Passion...

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: ...through Thy Passion![^140]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As Life Thou didst draw near unto Hades, O Master Christ, and becoming incorruptible unto the corruptible, Thou didst grant Resurrection unto all!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a Virgin thou didst give birth, and after childbirth thou remainedst Pure; and in thine arms, O true Virgin-Mother, thou didst carry Him Who upholds all things!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: The abyss encompassed me... (Обыде мя бездна...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst stretch out Thy palms upon the Cross, gathering the scattered nations, O Christ our God, by Thy life-bearing Cross and Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst overthrow death, and shattered the gates of Hades, and released Adam who was bound; and they cried aloud: Thy right hand hath saved me, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The unburnt bush, the spiritual mountain and ladder, and the heavenly gate, do we worthily glorify, O glorious Mary, praise of the Orthodox!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Обыде мя бездна...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Cause of all things, Who granted existence unto all, accepted a cause by being incarnate for our sake, O immaculate Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pouring forth a soul-nourishing fountain of healing, O Sovereign Lady, unto those who come in faith beneath thy glorious shelter, we brightly glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast given birth unto the Cause of salvation, the Life-Giver, granting eternal deliverance unto those who confess thee in truth to be the Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: Highly exalted Lord of the fathers, Who quenched the flame and refreshed the children, who sang in one voice: Blessed art Thou, O God! (Превозносимый отцев Господь, пламень угасивый, отроки прохладивый, единогласно поющыя: Боже, благословенъ еси!):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Clothed in the flesh, Thou didst shatter by divine power upon the fishhook [of Thy flesh] the snares of the devil; Thou hast raised up those who cry unto Thee: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* United in one Person, the Unapproachable One is concealed in the flesh within the tomb, unsearchable, unto Whom we sing: Blessed art Thou, O God![^141]

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-immaculate one, thou didst give birth unto the incarnate God, one [Person] in two natures, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: He Who in the fiery furnace... (Иже в пещи огненнѣй...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the wood of the Cross Thou didst tear down the deceit of idols: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Risen from the tomb, having raised the dead from Hades: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As we all possess thee as salvation, O Theotokos, pray unto Him Who was incarnate of thee to save us!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos: The same (Иже в пещи огненнѣй...):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Remaining immaculate and unchanged according to fleshly constitution, yet changed in condescension as merciful toward thee, the Holy One, the only blessed God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As an immaculate bride, O Theotokos and Sovereign Lady, do we harmoniously glorify thee, the throne and dwelling of thy Master, Whom we all hymn!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Mother of the King of all, sanctified by the Spirit, O Virgin, didst thou become unto Him Who created thee, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Thee, the Creator of all, the children in the furnace, forming a universal choir, did sing: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto the ages! (Тебѣ, Вседѣтелю, в пещи отроцы, всемирный ликъ составльше, пояху: Дѣла вся, Господа пойте и превозносите Его во вѣки!):*

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure voluntary saving suffering; Thou didst pray concerning the cup, bearing according to intellect two wills and two operations, O Christ, in two natures: Hymn the Lord, all ye works!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* At Thine all-effecting descent, O Christ, Hades was mocked, and spewed forth the dead whom of old it had swallowed up through deceit, who sing and highly exalt Christ unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: на б̃ъ г̃ь тро̃ гла̃ , є̃ · пн̃ ве̃ по стра̃ · по а̃ стихѡ̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, beyond comprehension...

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: ...who didst bear the Word in God-manly manner, being a Virgin: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto the ages![^142]

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Him Who before the ages of the Father... (Отца прежде вѣк...):*

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Nailed upon the Cross of Thine own will, O Christ, stretching out Thy palms, and destroying the dominion of death: Ye priests, hymn, and highly exalt Him!

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Him Who descended into Hades and abolished death, O Christ, and rose in glory, and raised the dead: Ye priests, hymn, and highly exalt Him!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Higher than the Cherubim wast thou shown to be, O holy one, and in thine arms thou didst carry Christ: Ye priests, hymn and highly exalt Him!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* The living in truth and light-bearing throne and tables of grace confess thee, O Virgin, who didst receive the Word from thee; highly exalt Him!

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Rejoice, O Isaiah: a Virgin has conceived in the womb, and given birth unto a Son, Emmanuel, both God and man; Orient is His name; Whom magnifying, with the One Who gave birth we bless thee! (Исаие, ликуй, Дѣва имѣ во утробѣ, и породи Сына Еммануила, Бога же и человѣка, Восток имя Ему, Егоже величающе, с Рождшею тя ублажаем!):*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst take up fallen man, O Master Christ, from the virgin womb, as Thou wast united unto the whole [human nature], yet taking no part in any sin; and me entirely hast Thou freed from passions by Thy most pure passions!

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst accept passions in the flesh, and having delivered the whole world from deceit, O Merciful One, with unceasing hymns we magnify Thee!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, Who didst rise from the tomb on the third day, and cast down Hades, and enlighten the world, we the faithful unanimously magnify!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Virgin, Mother of Christ God, Whom thou didst bear; pray unto Him to grant remission of sins unto those who praise thee in faith!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* From thy pure blood was curdled the supernatural flesh for the Creator of all and for the only-begotten Son of His Father, not changing what He was, but taking an animate and ensouled nature, O Theotokos!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst halt the circuitous, mortal, and restrained onset, having in truth given birth in the flesh, beyond comprehension, unto eternal Life, which when bitter Hades touched, it was shattered, O most holy Virgin Mother!

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sitting upon the throne, Thy Son, the Master, placed thee at His right hand in glory, O pure one, shining with golden fringes and divine virtues, granting, O most blessed one, as Mother, boldness before the Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O Lord, while the tomb was sealed by the lawless, Thou didst come forth from the tomb, even as Thou wast born of the Theotokos; Thy bodiless Angels understood not how Thou wast incarnate; the soldiers guarding Thee perceived not when Thou didst arise; for both were sealed unto those who enquire, and the wonders were revealed unto those who worship the mystery in faith; which we hymn: render also unto us joy and great mercy![^144]

items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O Lord, having shattered the eternal bars and broken the bonds asunder, Thou didst arise from the tomb, leaving behind Thy burial linens as a witness of Thy true and three-day burial; and Thou didst go before into Galilee, Thou Who wast guarded in a cave: Great is Thy mercy, O incomprehensible Savior, have mercy and save us!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Lord, the women ran unto the tomb to see Thee, Christ, Who didst suffer for our sake; and having arrived, they found an Angel sitting upon the stone, rolled away through fear; and he cried aloud unto them, saying: The Lord is risen; say unto His disciples that He is risen from the dead, saving our souls!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* O Lord, even as Thou didst come forth from the sealed tomb, so didst Thou enter while the doors were shut unto Thy disciples, showing them the bodily passions which Thou didst accept, O longsuffering Savior; as from the seed of David Thou didst endure wounds; as the Son of God Thou didst free the world: Great is Thy mercy, O incomprehensible Savior, have mercy and save us!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* O Lord, King of the ages and Creator of all, having accepted crucifixion and burial for our sake, that Thou mightest free us from death: Thou art our God, for beside Thee we know no other![^145]

items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* O Lord, who shall declare Thy shining wonders? Or who shall proclaim Thy fearful mysteries? For having become incarnate for our sake as Thou Thyself didst will, Thou didst manifest the strength of Thy power; for by Thy Cross Thou didst open Paradise unto the thief, and by Thy burial Thou didst destroy the strongholds of the devil, and by Thy Resurrection Thou hast enlightened all: O Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Unto the God-receiving tomb of Thine, the guards cried aloud: O your senseless counsel! Attempting to guard the Uncircumscribed, ye labor in vain to conceal the Resurrection of the Crucified, Who wills to appear in radiance! O your vainly-counseling council! Why do ye take counsel again to hide what cannot be hidden? Rather hear from us and believe in the truth of what has come to pass: an Angel lightning-flashing came down from heaven and rolled away the stone; seized by fear and dread of him, he cried aloud with strength unto the myrrh-bearing women, saying: Behold ye not the guards slain, and the seals broken, and Hades emptied, and the sting of death shattered? Why seek ye the Living as dead? Go quickly, proclaim the good news of the Resurrection unto the Apostles, crying aloud in joy: Truly...

items.english_text: *Glory... Sticheron of the Gospel of the Sunday. At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The thief on the cross believed Thee to be God; he confessed Thee truly in his heart, calling aloud: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, between two condemned thieves, the one blaspheming Thee was condemned, O Lord, while the other theologizing Thee was settled in Paradise: Remember us, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From the wood of the Cross the life-source gushed forth unto the human race, and having shattered the ancient curse: let us hymn Christ as Savior and Benefactor of us!

items.english_text: *Epistle [Rubric: To the Hebrews; Witness: Ephesians 4:7 & 1 Corinthians 12:7–11]:* Brethren, unto each one of us grace is given according to the measure of the gift of Christ. But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to profit withal: for to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom, and after this the word of knowledge by the same Spirit; to another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit; to another the working of powers and power; to another prophecy; to another kinds of tongues. But all these things the one and same Spirit works, dividing unto each one as He wills.

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Gospel [Rubric: Gospel according to John; Witness: Matthew 10:1, 5–6]:* At that time, Jesus called His twelve disciples, and gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every infirmity and every disease among the people. These twelve Jesus sent forth, saying: Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and enter not into a city of the Samaritans; but go rather unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel;

items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou possessest by nature as God a heart of bounties and a treasury of goodness; therefore we pray Thee, O Christ our Savior, and falling down we ever call aloud, crying: Grant unto Thy servants remission of debts and transgressions, and forgiveness of all things wherein we have all sinned, as Thou art a compassionate God and Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Desiring to save all as God, for whose sake Thou didst appear in human form as man: save us who worship Thy commandments; for Thou camest not, O Lover of mankind, to save the righteous, but those bound in transgressions; and us, who are shackled by many sins, do Thou release by the grace of divine baptism, as Thou art a compassionate God and Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Ever beholding the face of God, enlightened by Him with thrice-radiant beams: enlighten us, and deliver us from the passions and temptations of the ages, O holy Archangels: by their prayers, O God, grant peace unto all the world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* The Seraphim and Cherubim, and all Angels and Archangels, Thrones, Principalities, Dominions, and Powers unceasingly glorify the Divine Trinity, knowing one Lordship, with immaterial lips: pray ye unto Christ to grant peace unto all the world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Fearful and most glorious is the great mystery: the Uncontainable was contained within thy womb, and as Mother after childbirth thou remainedst still a Virgin; for thou didst bear God Who came down and was incarnate for our sake! Unto Him let us cry aloud, unto Him let us sing a hymn, chanting with the Angels: Holy art Thou, O Christ God, Who wast made man for our sake; O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: слово рождешнаа д̃вце сꙋщи · г̃а всꙗ дѣ пойте · и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го :~ і́нь кр̃тꙋ і́рм̃о : Ѡ́ц̃а прѣже вѣкъ · На кр̃тѣ волею х̃е длани свои простеръ · и́ съ мр̃тноую дръжавꙋ раꙁрꙋшивъ · сщ̃енници пойте и́ превъꙁносите е̃го :~ Съшедшаго въ а́дъ и́ съ мр̃ть оу́праꙁднї х̃е · и́ въскреша въ славѣ · и́ мр̃твыꙗ въскрѣсивша , сщ̃еннїи пойте и́ прѣвъꙁноси :~ б̃ Херꙋвїи выишеши с̃таа ꙗ́ви · и́ на рꙋкꙋ своею х̃а понесла еси · сщ̃еннїи пои :~ і́нь б̃ци і́рм̃о т̃о̃ · По́еть с намї и́ бесплътныи плъкь д̃вце , рожество ти непостижное едине̃нь ликъ сътво́рше любовию · тѧ превъꙁноси :~ Вода свѣтлаа ꙗ́же съ мр̃тнꙋю д̃х̃а и́с тебе и́ꙁшелье вѣкѣ длъгъ · сквръноую и́ꙁмыꙗ вѣрно поющиимь , и́ прѣвъꙁно́сѧщи :~ Житвъныи въ и́стинꙋ и́ свѣтоно́сныи престо́ль · и́ скрижалне бл̃годати , и́сповѣдаетꙗ̃ · слово д̃вце ѿ те прие̃мъшо · е̃го превъꙁноси :~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ і́рм̃о · И́саиа ликꙋи д̃ва а́ко и́мѣ въ оутрѣвѣ , и́ породи с̃на е̃ммануила б̃а же и́ ч̃лка · въстокъ имѧ е̃моу · е̃го же величае · с рожешю тꙗ ѡ́блжае :~ Пашаго ч̃лка въсприꙗть влк̃о х̃е · и́с чрѣва д̃вы ꙗ́ко всемоусъвъкоуплисѧ · грѣхѣ же едино̃мь непричащысѧ · и́ всего ма ѿ стратеи ты свободнль еси · преч̃тыими нестрали :~ Боготочную ти кровнж · и́злианною влк̃о х̃е ѡ́ ребры прѣч̃титыи и́ животворащихъ · жрътва бѡ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Having the victory over Hades, O Christ, Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, that Thou mightest raise with Thyself those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death: free among the dead, and pouring forth life from Thine own light: O Almighty Savior, have mercy on us!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Today Christ, having trampled down death, is risen even as He said, and has granted rejoicing unto all the world, that all, crying aloud, may send up a hymn: O Fountain of life, Unapproachable Light, Almighty Savior, have mercy on us!

items.english_text: *At the Entrance, Dogmatikon Theotokion, Tone 6:* Who blesses thee not, O most holy Virgin? Or who sings not of thy pure childbirth? For the timeless only-begotten Son, Who shone forth from the Father, the Same came forth from thee, O pure one, having ineffably become incarnate: being God by nature, and having become man by nature for our sake; not divided into two Persons, but known in two natures without confusion: Him entreat, O pure and most blessed one, that our souls may have mercy!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Desiring to correct the corruption of ancient ruin, Christ was nailed upon the Cross and laid in the tomb. Him the myrrh-bearing women sought with tears, and weeping they said: "Woe to us, O Savior, King of all! How didst Thou deign to dwell in a tomb? And having dwelt there of Thine Own will, how wast Thou stolen away? What manner of place hid Thy life-bearing body? Yea, appear, even as Thou didst promise us, appear unto us, and stay our tearful weeping!" But while they wept, an Angel cried aloud unto them: "Cease from weeping! Go, tell the Apostles that Christ is risen, granting resurrection and great mercy unto the world!"

items.slavonic_text: стаꙗ х҃съ. ѡт твоѥѥ оутробы проше. въ мя ѡблъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Timeless Mind, O Father; co-equal divine Word; and Spirit divine, good, and right: as in faith we hymn Thy dominion, preserve us, as Thou art merciful!

items.slavonic_text: ксѧ дрѣвниꙗ клятвы адама свободи. тѣмже
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having [delivered our] pasture from corruption, and having become man by nature, O my God, Thou didst dwell within the womb of the most pure one, and didst deliver [us] from the ancient first condemnation of our forefather.

items.slavonic_text: ти пречистаꙗ ꙗко б҃жии мт҃ри дв҃ци въ истиноу въ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O pure Virgin, look down from heaven and behold the grievous wounds of our passions, and have compassion, O most pure one, and heal [our] hidden infirmity, distilling thy mercy upon thy servants: if thou art with us, none shall be against us!

items.slavonic_text: пиѥмь непрестально. радоуи сѧ ꙗко агг҃лъ. радоуи сѧ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Christ is my power...

items.slavonic_text: прѣчⷭ҇таꙗ застоупнице и покровъ и сп҃сениѥ дш҃амь
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Elevating our thoughts, O Thrice-radiant Unity, quickly lift up the soul and heart of Thy singers, and make them worthy of Thine illumination and brightness!

items.slavonic_text: гробѣ твоѥмь. и стрегоущиѥ оумрътвиша. и сто
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Change and transform [us] from the evil of the passions unto virtue, O one immutable and unchangeable Trinity, enlightening us with Thy rays!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗше мариꙗ на гробѣ ищющи прѣчистаго тѣла тво
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In Thy pre-eternal counsel Thou didst establish the angelic ranks as ministers of Thy goodness, O Thrice-hypostatic Unity: together with them receive also our praise!

items.slavonic_text: ѥго. и спровръже ада не некоушь сѧ ѡт него. срѣте
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The uncreated divine Nature, co-eternal, having assumed created human nature...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: ...in thy womb, O Mother of God, Ever-Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* By Thy divine light, O Good One...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having recognized the Principle of Godhead to be by nature providential and saving for all, O Master, Thrice-radiant yet One: unto Thee do we rise early, asking forgiveness of transgressions!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Father, with the unoriginate Son, and co-eternal Son, [and] Holy Spirit: establish, O Monarchical Trinity, Thy singers [free] from every temptation and affliction!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ordering Thy beneficent providence, guiding us ever unto the pleasing of Thy Thrice-hypostatic Godhead, make us partakers of the heavenly Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unchangeable Word of God, Who upholdest and preservest all things by Thine almighty hand: preserve and protect us who magnify Thee, by the prayers of the Mother of God who bore Thee!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Beholding the sea of life...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant wisdom and understanding unto Thy singers, O Thrice-radiant Principle of Godhead, and vouchsafe that the rays of the beauty and light-giving brightness of Thy goodness may illumine us all!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O indivisible Light, thrice-radiant by nature, almighty and unapproachable: illumine the hearts of those who faithfully sing of Thy dominion, and give them wings unto divine love!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* One Light in three Persons, in Father, Son, and Holy Spirit: Three indivisibly, praised as three-in-one, and known as worshipped as One!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who dwelt within thee, O Ever-Virgin, as the Almighty...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: ...taught men to worship [the one Thrice-radiant Godhead]!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O Virgin, look upon us, O all-hymned Mother of God; enlighten with light our darkened hearts, preserve thy flock, O most pure one; for as much as thou wilt, thou art able, as being the Mother of thy Creator, for those who call upon thee and love thee: if thou art with us, none shall be against us!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The angel made the furnace produce dew...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant me manly understanding, O Unity of thrice-radiant form, to keep and preserve Thy divine commandments, ever to sing unto Thee faithfully: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Praised as one by nature, and God unutterable by nature, yet bearing a threefold number in Persons: preserve us all from diverse temptations!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Co-essential and co-eternal in glory, Thee the one God by nature... the Trinity of Hypostases, clearly unchangeable in form...[^156]

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The co-eternal God, having assumed our composite nature immaculately within thy womb, O pure one, appeared in love for mankind, and taught all to sing: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the venerable...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Cleansing of transgressions quickly grant unto me, and from manifold passions...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: ...deliverance, O Trinity of one form, Thrice-hypostatic Unity, that I may glorify Thee unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As God hearing the prayer of Thy warriors, mercifully have mercy upon all, O Thrice-radiant Unity, all-good Trinity, as we hymn Thy majesty!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Light co-eternal from the eternal Light, from the Father the begotten Word, with the Spirit proceeding as Light, praised and supremely exalted with faith!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast borne the Physician of mankind, O immaculate one, the almighty Word, Christ and Lord, Who heals the primal curse of our forefather: Whom we supremely exalt unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* It is not possible for man to see God...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unable to behold the beauty of Thy glory, O Master, the cherubic ranks, covering themselves with wings, unceasingly cry out a threefold hymn to the Thrice-hypostatic [Godhead], and glorify the single dominion of Thy Godhead's Principle!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy brightness, O Never-setting Sun, grant unto Thy people: enlighten our hearts and souls, and deliver us from many transgressions, O One all-merciful and Thrice-hypostatic, and make us worthy of unending life!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Light unified and thrice-radiant, Giver of light: by Thy divinity illumine those who faithfully sing of Thee, and deliver them from gloomy wickedness; make them worthy of bright mansions, as Thou art all-good!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who by wisdom before the ages created all things, O Virgin, has through thee saved that which was corrupted, and has filled all things with the rays of divine light;...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: ...thee, O Mother of God, we truly glorify in faith!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparia: "It is truly meet," and the rest as usual.*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord": Troparion, and as at Vespers. After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*[^157]

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* The tomb having been opened and Hades lamenting, Mary cried unto the Apostles who had hidden themselves: "Come forth, ye laborers of the vineyard, and proclaim the word of the Resurrection: that the Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!"

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* O Lord, Mary Magdalene stood before Thy tomb, and weeping she cried aloud, supposing Thee to be the gardener, saying: "Where have ye laid the Eternal Life? Where have ye hidden Him Who sits upon the cherubic throne? For the guards thereof became as dead from fear. Either give me my Lord, or cry aloud with me: O Thou Who wast among the dead, and hast raised up the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin Mother of God, entreat Thy Son, Who was nailed willingly to the Cross and is risen from the dead, Christ our God, that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn 1:* By Thy voluntary death we have found immortal life, O all-powerful and only Savior of all; for by Thy precious Resurrection Thou hast called all, O merciful One, shattering the enemy's arrows and the victory of Hades and the sting of death!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* The myrrh-bearing women, having set aside grief, unto them the Angel spoke: [why seek ye the living among the dead?][^158] Christ is risen from the tomb, having great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Gideon prefigured the conception, and David declared thy childbirth, O all-hymned Mother of God: for the Word came down like dew upon the fleece into thy womb, and sprouted without seed, O holy Earth, the salvation of the world, Christ our God, O thou who art full of grace!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *After the Evlogitaria (The Blameless), Hypakoe:* By Thy voluntary and life-creating death, O Christ, having shattered the gates of Hades as God, Thou hast opened unto us the ancient Paradise; and having risen from the dead, Thou hast delivered our life from corruption.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Gradual Antiphons, Tone 6. Antiphon 1:*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 1:* Unto heaven do I lift up mine eyes, unto Thee, O Word: have compassion on me, that I may live unto Thee!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 2:* Have mercy upon us who are set at naught, fashioning us as well-fitted vessels for Thee, O Word!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... In the Holy Spirit:* Every saving cause exists: if He blow upon anyone worthily, He quickly takes him from earthly things, elevates him, gives him wings, and sets him on high.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 1:* If the Lord had not been among us, not one of us could have withstood the enemy's warfare to conquer it; for they that conquer are exalted hence.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 2:* Let not my soul be seized by their teeth like a bird, O Word: woe is me, how shall I escape the enemy, being a lover of sin?

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... In the Holy Spirit:* Is deification unto all, good pleasure, understanding, peace, and blessing: for He is equal in operation to the Father and the Word.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 1:* They that trust in the Lord are fearsome to enemies and marvelous to all: for they look on high.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Verse 2:* Unto iniquities the lot of the righteous stretches not forth his hands, having Thee as Helper, O Savior.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... In the Holy Spirit:* Is dominion over all; Whom the armies on high worship,...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: ...together with every breath below.

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon: Lord, stir up Thy might, and come to save us (LXX Ps. 79:3).*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Let every breath. The Resurrection Gospel. Then: "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ." Psalm 50: "Have mercy on me, O God." And the refrains, and the rest.*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Resurrection Canon, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:* As Israel walked on dry land through the deep with their feet, beholding the pursuer Pharaoh drowned, they cried: Let us sing a song of victory unto God, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Stretching out Thy palms upon the Cross, Thou didst fulfill the Father's good pleasure, O Lord Jesus, [Creator] of all things: therefore let us all sing a song of victory unto Thee!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In fear unto Thee, as a handmaid, death came commanded unto the Master of all, Who through her dispenses endless life and resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having received Thine Own Creator, as He Himself willed, incarnate beyond understanding from thy seedless womb, thou hast truly appeared as Sovereign Lady of creation!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos:* By the wave of the sea...

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, Who by the wood of the Cross didst abolish the ancient curse,[^159] pouring forth salvation unto men and healing of passions, having for our sake assumed human nature: Thee, our Savior, do we glorify!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, Who didst descend into the depth among the dead, Who givest life and didst cause the light to shine forth: we sing of Thy Resurrection, and worshipping we glorify Thee, O merciful King!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Inexhaustible treasure of virginity for mankind, having borne the Creator, Christ: Whom earthly beings having found, rejoicing, unceasingly glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Ode 1. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Eve made me partaker of the ancient disobedience and by tasting brought in the curse; which thou, O most pure one, hast destroyed, having borne the Beginning of blessing, the Savior!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having borne the divine Flash of lightning, Christ God: drive away the mist of my passions and the gloom of sin, O pure one, by the light of thy brightness!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Expectation of the nations brought forth from thee, even as [the prophets] mystically foresaw with noetic eyes: God Who has delivered us through thy mediation!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Resurrection Canon. Ode 3. Heirmos:* There is none holy like Thee, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established them upon the rock of Thy confession!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding God crucified in the flesh, all creation dissolved in fear; yet by the hand of Him Who holds all things, Who was crucified for our sake, it was firmly sustained!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By death death was abolished, and lies breathless; for unable to endure the divine assault of Life, the strong one is slain, and [Christ] grants resurrection unto all!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The miracle of thy divine childbirth, O pure one, surpasses every order of nature: for beyond nature thou didst conceive God in thy womb, and having given birth, thou remainest ever a Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Ode 3. Heirmos: Thee, Who suspended [the earth] upon the waters...*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend upon the height of the Cross, and didst despoil all the power of the strong one; the Cross gave the gift to understand Thy mystery: and there is none holy besides Thee, O Lord![^160]

items.slavonic_text: дв҃оу даꙗ животъ. въскресънъ из мрътвыхъ. г҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thine enemies slandered Thee, marvelling at the greatness of Thy power; unto whom Thou hast granted resurrection, freeing the captives who cry aloud: There is none holy besides Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Надежа родоу чл҃чьскомоу. и сп҃сеніе веѣлыи за
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Hope of the human race, and protection of the faithful,[^161] O Mother of God, thou alone didst appear as Ever-Virgin: therefore thee, our immaculate Sovereign Lady, do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: стоупленіе. бц҃е ѥдина ты прⷭ҇но дв҃о ꙗви сѧ. тѣмже
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Mother of God. Ode 3. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: тꙗ влⷣчцоу. непорочноую величаѥмь: ~ інъ бц҃и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having assumed our corruptible flesh without pain and without seed beyond utterance,[^162] O most pure one, the Good One, having preserved thee intact, united [thee] unto Himself eternally.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding God incarnate from thee, O Virgin, the angelic ranks marvelled with fear, magnifying thee with unceasing hymns as the Mother of God.

items.english_text: *Epistle to the Hebrews [Heb. 7:26–8:2]:*

items.slavonic_text: Бра́ · та́ко намъ подоба́ше · а́рхиереи пра́ведны ·
items.english_text: Brethren: Such a High Priest was fitting for us, Who is holy, innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens; Who has no need daily, as the high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for His own sins, and then for those of the people: for this He did once for all when He offered up Himself. For the law appoints men high priests having infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was after the law, appoints the Son, perfected unto ages of ages. Now of the things spoken this is the sum: We have such a High Priest, Who is seated on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens; a Minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

items.english_text: The Lord said: "I am the door: by Me if anyone enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture. The thief comes not, but to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life. I am the Good Shepherd: the Good Shepherd lays down His life for the sheep. But he that is a hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep, and flees; and the wolf catches them,[^173] and scatters the sheep. The hireling flees, because he is a hireling, and cares not for the sheep. I am the Good Shepherd, and know Mine own, and am known of...

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, Who destroyed the dominion of death and enlightened the human race, crying aloud with the bodiless hosts: O Creator and our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having endured the Cross and burial for our sake, O Savior, by death as God Thou didst put death to death; therefore we worship Thy Resurrection on the third day: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* The Apostles, beholding the Resurrection of the Creator, marvelled, singing the angelic praise: this is the glory of the Church, this is the wealth of the Kingdom! O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Though Thou wast seized, O Christ, by lawless men, yet Thou art my God, and I am not ashamed; though Thou wast smitten on the back, I deny Thee not; though nailed to the Cross, I hide it not: in Thy Resurrection do I boast, for Thy death is my life; O Almighty One and Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Fulfilling David's prophecy, O Christ, Thou didst reveal Thy majesty in Zion unto Thy disciples,...

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: ...showing Thyself praised and glorified ever with the Father and the Holy Spirit: pre-eternal as the bodiless Word, and in these last days incarnate for our sake, slain as man, and risen in glory as the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* Thou didst descend even unto Hades, O Christ, as Thou didst will, and didst overthrow death as God and Master, and didst rise on the third day, raising Adam with Thyself from the insoluble bonds of Hades and from corruption, as he cried aloud and said: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Thou wast laid in the tomb as one asleep, and didst rise on the third day as mighty in strength, raising Adam with Thyself from mortal corruption, as the Almighty One!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thou wast known as Mother beyond nature, O Mother of God, yet remainedst a Virgin beyond word and understanding; no tongue can declare the wonders of thy childbirth: for most glorious was thy conception, O pure one, and incomprehensible was the manner of thy giving birth; for wherever God so wills, the order of nature is overcome: therefore knowing thee to be the Mother of God, all of us pray fervently unto thee: Unceasingly intercede for our souls!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* The Savior of the world is risen from the tomb, and has raised man together with His own flesh: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Come, let us worship Him Who is risen from the dead and has enlightened all things; for by His Resurrection on the third day He has delivered us from the tyranny of Hades, granting unto us life and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Having descended into Hades, O Christ, Thou didst put death to death, and rising on the third day,...

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: ...Thou didst raise us who were fallen, as we cry aloud: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O compassionate Lord!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Awesome didst Thou appear, O Lord, lying in the tomb as one asleep, and rising on the third day as mighty, Thou didst raise Adam with Thyself, who cried: Glory to Thine all-powerful rising, O Lord and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Fleeing unto thy protection, O Sovereign Lady, all of us earthborn cry aloud unto thee: O Mother of God, our hope, deliver us from our countless transgressions, and save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Resurrection Troparion, Tone 7:* Thou didst destroy death by Thy Cross; Thou didst open Paradise to the thief; Thou didst change the lamentation of the myrrh-bearers into joy, and commanded the Apostles to proclaim that Thou art risen, O Christ God, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the treasury of our resurrection, O all-praised one, lead up from the pit and depth of transgressions those who hope in thee: for thou didst save those guilty of sin, having given birth unto our Salvation; who before childbirth wast a Virgin, and in childbirth a Virgin, and after childbirth still a Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *At Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy Trinity, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* By Thy nod the nature of the waters, previously fluid, was transformed upon earth; therefore Israel, having marched dry-shod, sings unto Thee a song of victory!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Circumcise the eyes of my understanding, and my heart and clay lips, O all-holy Trinity of all, that I may joyfully sing praise unto Thee, the Giver of ages!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That Thou mightest show forth the abundance of Thy goodness, Thou didst fashion man, O one uncircumscribed Trinity, an honorable image...

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: ...of Thy Godhead:[^180] do Thou, O Creator, renew him!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The pre-eternal Mind, and His co-eternal Word, and the co-unoriginate Spirit, shining forth, taught us to worship the one God, consubstantial in essence, in three hypostatic Persons!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In the bush of old, the divine Word appeared unto Moses as a purifying fire, yet burned it not, prefiguring the incarnation from the Virgin, whereby He renewed the earthborn!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hymning the single, thrice-radiant, and all-creating Master, we ask forgiveness of transgressions: O almighty God, despise not those who faithfully glorify Thy goodness!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Word of God, consubstantial, sprang forth as an Offshoot from the Father, as from an unoriginate root, and the divine Spirit, co-essential: therefore, ye faithful, let us glorify the one Lordship in threefold forms!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Equally honored and co-grown is the tri-hypostatic nature, divided without division, a single-originate Trinity; all of us the faithful glorify Thee, and worshipping we ask forgiveness of transgressions!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beyond expression, without earthly likeness, the Word of God came forth manifestly from the pure Virgin, and showed forth unto all the thrice-shining Godhead, an indivisible essence in immutable hypostases!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:* I have sinned, have mercy, O Holy Trinity, upon Thy servants who flee unto Thee, the Compassionate One; and forgive, for Thou art merciful!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:*...

items.english_text: ...From malice and transgressions deliver our souls, O most pure Mother of God, and cleanse from sins those who sing of thee, [having given birth unto] the unchangeable God![^181]

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Foreseeing Thy coming...*[^182]

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Marked by the words of Thine incomprehensible and thrice-radiant Godhead, sweetly do we praise Thee, O Lord and Lover of mankind, and glorify Thy power!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* On earth and in heaven with the bodiless choirs, we praise the indivisible Trinity in Unity, as reigning unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without departing from the Father's glory, Thou didst descend into our lowest estate, incarnate as the transcendent God, and hast exalted us unto divine glory, as Thou art merciful!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Light-originating Essence, Trinity in Unity: strengthen us in Thy love![^183]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Mind, the Word, and the Spirit: one Godhead and thrice-radiant Unity; deliver from temptations and eternal sorrows those who glorify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Taking form, O Word of God, having assumed human nature from the holy Virgin, Thou didst teach us to praise the Trinity in Unity, co-enthroned and consubstantial!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By thy childbirth beyond understanding, O most pure one, the condemnation of the first parents was loosed, and the first-formed regained entry into Paradise, loudly...

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: ...praising thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* With equal glory and dominion, the Monarchy of the Godhead, existing immutable in three hypostases, having the distinctions of glory within Itself, according to the natural properties of each![^184]

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The noetic ranks of angelic orders praise the thrice-radiant Godhead; with them also we, with clay lips, sing of the one Creator of all things, crying aloud and faithfully glorifying!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Indivisible Trinity, one and co-essential, in three Persons one Essence: we worship Thee, O Father, Son, and Spirit, one Essence and one Power, one God, consubstantial Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beyond expression by word, the Word, born of His Father as the sun before all ages, in these last days shone forth from the Virgin; we proclaim the one God in three Persons, uncircumscribed!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:* Tri-hypostatic and thrice-personal Unity: have mercy upon those whom Thou didst create, not rejecting them; burning away the malice of our souls, and enlightening the souls and hearts of those that sing of Thy goodness: O our God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Brighter than fire and more active than flame is the mercy of thy goodness, O Sovereign Lady, burning away the sins of men and enlightening the hearts of those that sing of thee, magnifying thy greatness, O thou who hast been gladdened by God!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
