items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Following the words of the divine prophets, we glorify Thee alone as the one God in threefold form, crying thus:...

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: ...Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With clay lips, singing the song of the immaterial orders, we praise the glory of the Trinity in the unity of essence, crying thus: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unoriginate Trinity, indivisible in essence, co-enthroned in unity, inseparable in glory, pre-beginning Nature and Kingdom: save those who sing unto Thee in faith!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Creator and Builder of the earthly creation, O most pure one, manifestly became incarnate of thee, and men, made alive, cry aloud: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O most pure one![^185]

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Unconsumed by the fire...*

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou Who upholdest all creation, O Trinity in Unity, ruling over all, Who embracest the whole earth: preserve those whom Thou hast drawn by Thy love, who ever cry: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Illumine Thy singers and servants with the thrice-radiant rays of the sun, with divine-working victories; and beholding the beauty of the one Trinity, grant that we may sing as far as we are able: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Make the beacons of Thy Church thrice-radiant, O Benefactor and Lover of mankind, and unite them with Thy communicants; show them to be unassailable by invisible foes and fleshly passions, O Master, one Godhead of the people, that they may unceasingly cry: All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: рь добрыи · и знають моꙗ мене · ꙗкоже зна́ет ма
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The God-originating Light shone forth from thy womb, O Virgin Mother unwedded and spotless, [illumining] the whole world...

items.slavonic_text: слънъчныимы свѣто̃ ѡ́зари · и́ ꙁемлю ѡ́внси · по́ж
items.english_text: ...illumining the whole world with thrice-radiant light, and [renewing] the earth:[^186] Praise the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ше всеꙗ дѣла г̃нꙗ г̃а : ~ пѣ̃ ѳ̃ ірмо мл̃ти б̃о д̃ва аи́ч ·
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:*[^187] To speak with a loud voice and to sing worthily [of Him] Whom in the highest heavens the Seraphim [unceasingly][^188] praise, we of the earth are unable; but nevertheless, as Master of all and Lover of mankind, Thee do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: Высокогла̃ти · и пѣти д̃ши но · е̃го же къ вышнии нб̃с
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Deliver Thy faithful singers from bodily sicknesses and spiritual passions, O singular, indivisible Trinity; preserve them unharmed, and free them from all worldly temptations!

items.slavonic_text: ꙁь прѣстанно серафими въспѣвають · неможемь
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O co-equal, thrice-radiant Godhead, having pre-eternal dominion, and in the immutable beauty of essential goodness: grant remission of transgressions unto Thy servants, and deliverance from defiled passions!

items.slavonic_text: ꙁемнїн · н̃ ѡ́баче ꙗко вл̃цѣ въсѣхь , и ч̃лколюбнвȣ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Assuming a mind, a soul, and a bodily union from thy womb, O Mother of God, O spotless one, the Word of God truly appeared as Man, and having deified the essence of men, He was manifestly shown forth!

items.slavonic_text: тобѣ величае̃мь : ~ Тѣлесныꙗ болѣꙁни и́ꙁбави · и́
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet... and the rest.*[^189] *At Sunday Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Resurrection: After the 1st Stichologia, Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: д̃шевныꙗ стр̃ти вѣрныꙗ пѣвцы своꙗ · единственаа
items.english_text: When the tomb was sealed, O Life, Thou didst shine forth from the grave, O Christ God; and while the doors were shut, Thou didst come unto the disciples, O Resurrection of all, renewing an upright spirit in us through them, according to Thy great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: тр̃це нераздѣлнаа · съхранити неврѣдимы · и́ ѡ[т]
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Life lay in the tomb, and seals were upon the stone; as a sleeping king the soldiers guarded Christ, and angels glorified Him as immortal God; and the women cried aloud: The Lord is risen,...

items.slavonic_text: всѣ бжитскыи нескȣшенїи свободи : ~ Равномощь
items.english_text: ...granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: ное б̃гоначалїе трисвѣтлое · прѣже имоущна др̃ь
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Rejoice, thou that art full of grace, O Virgin Theotokos, haven and help of the human race! For from thee was the Redeemer of the world incarnate; thou alone art Mother and ever-blessed Virgin; entreat Christ God to grant peace unto the world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.slavonic_text: жавою · и неиꙁмѣнною добротою соущьсткеныꙗ
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichologia, Sessional Hymn:* Unto the tomb ran the women, carrying myrrh with tears, while the soldiers were guarding Thee, the King of all; they said among themselves: "Who shall roll away the stone for us?" The Angel of Great Counsel[^190] is risen, having trampled down death: O almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: бл̃гостина · даж прегрѣшенїе ѡ́поущенїе твои ра
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn:* Thou Who by Thy three-day burial didst despoil death, and by Thy life-bearing rising didst raise up corrupted man: O Christ God, have mercy upon us!

items.slavonic_text: бѡ̃ · и́ сквръныи стр̃тен и́ꙁбавленїе : ~ Оу́мъ д̃шии
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Entreat unceasingly, O Virgin Theotokos, Christ God, Who was crucified for our sake and rose again, and destroyed the dominion of death, that He may save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: пл̃тное съвокоупленїе прїимь б̃гомати · ѡ[т] твое́го
items.english_text: *After the Blameless [Psalm 118], Hypakoe, Tone 7:* Thou Who didst take our form, and endure crucifixion in the flesh: save me by Thy Resurrection, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: оутробы нескврънаа · бж̃їе сло́во къ истинно ч̃лкь а́
items.english_text: *Graduals, Tone 7. Antiphon 1:* O Savior, Who didst turn back the captivity of Zion from deceit: give life also unto me, delivering me from the bondage of passions!

items.slavonic_text: ви са · ѡ́божившаго соущества · ч̃лкь ꙗ́квѣ показа
items.english_text: They that sow in affliction in the south, with fastings and tears, shall thus reap joyful sheaves of nourishment unto life eternal!

items.slavonic_text: са : ~ т̃и д̃ши но е̃ꙗ ковъ : ~ и́ прочаа · на оу́треннꙗ въ
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Through the Holy Spirit:* [He is] the Fountain of divine treasures; from Him come wisdom, understanding, and the fear [of God]; unto Him be praise, glory, honor, and dominion!

items.slavonic_text: г̃ь тр̃о поверенї с̃тра̃ · по пр̃вкон ст̃лѡ̃ т̃ ь гл̃а з̃
items.english_text: Except the Lord build the house of the soul, in vain do we labor; for without Him, neither deed nor word is accomplished!

items.slavonic_text: Знаменаноу гро́боу животь ѡ[т] гроба въсиꙗлъ е̃си
items.english_text: By Thy Holy Spirit, the fruits of the womb, moved [by Him], are turned unto the paternal commandments for adoption!

items.slavonic_text: х̃е б̃е · дверемь затвореныи мы оу́ченикомь прѣста ·
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Through the Holy Spirit:* All things have their being [from Him]; for before all things He is God, the Unapproachable Light, and the Life of all!

items.slavonic_text: всѣ въскренїе · д̃хъ правыи тѣми ѡ́бнавлаа намь по
items.english_text: *Antiphon 3:* They that fear the Lord, having found the paths of life, are now and ever blessed with incorruptible glory!

items.slavonic_text: велицѣи мл̃тнти твоеи : ~ Жиꙁнь въ гро́бѣ въꙁлежа
items.english_text: Beholding thy children around thy table like young shoots, rejoice and be glad, O Chief Shepherd, bringing them unto Christ!

items.slavonic_text: ше · и печати на камени лежахоу · ꙗ́ко цр̃а спаще
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Through the Holy Spirit:* The depth of gifts, the richness of glory, the great abyss of judgments; of one glory, He is co-worshipped God[^191] with the Father and the Son!

items.slavonic_text: воини стрѣжахоу х̃а · и а́ггл̃и славаахоу , ꙗ́ко
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up!* *Verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart.* *Let every breath praise the Lord.* *Resurrection Gospel, as assigned.* *Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ.* *Psalm 50: Have mercy on me, O God.* *Troparion after Psalm 50, and the rest.*[^192]

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:* By Thy beckoning, the naturally flowing watery substance on earth changed its form, O Lord; therefore Israel, journeying dryshod, sings unto Thee a song of victory!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The tyranny of death is condemned, when by unjust death on the Tree Thou wast condemned, O Lord; therefore the prince of darkness, not overcoming Thee, was justly cast out!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hades drew near unto Thee, and not having power to grind Thy body with teeth, his...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...jaws were shattered; therefore, O Savior, having destroyed the pangs of death, Thou didst rise from the tomb on the third day!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst loose the sorrow of the first mother Eve, for having escaped pangs, without knowledge of wedlock thou didst give birth; therefore, manifestly knowing thee as the most pure Theotokos, all we call thee blessed!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Let us sing...* From the life-bearing and pierced side gushed forth two fountains; let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having lain in the tomb, and risen on the third day, Christ, granting incorruption unto the dead: let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Mother of Christ God, who ineffably in the flesh didst bear the Word of God, Who suffered as another for His own servants!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Same Heirmos:* O Virgin who didst bear the Abyss of compassion: illumine my soul with thy light-bearing radiance, that I may worthily sing, O most pure one, of the power of thy wonders!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding us wounded by the arrow of sin, O Word, as Benefactor Thou didst have compassion; therefore, ineffably uniting Thyself, O most pure one, through the flesh which He, the Divine One, received from thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* And human nature was seized by death, corrupt and harmed, O most pure Sovereign Lady; but thou, having conceived Life, didst lead it back from corruption unto life!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* In the beginning, by the all-powerful Word, Thou didst establish the heavens, O Lord and Savior, and by the all-creating Spirit of God all their host; establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst mount the Tree...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...of Thine own will; for our sake Thou didst suffer sores, O truly Merciful Savior, and didst endure wounds, mediating salvation for the world and the faithful, therefore unto Thy mercy, O Almighty One, we have recourse!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst heal the wounds of the soul bitten by the serpent's gnawing, O Christ, and didst show light in darkness to him who of old descended into corruption; for descending through the Cross into Hades, Thou didst raise me up with Thyself!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By the prayers of Thy Mother who knew not wedlock, grant peace unto the whole world, O Savior, and bestow victories upon our Prince[^193] against contrary adversaries, and vouchsafe incorruptible glory unto those that hymn Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Thou Who didst give power from on high unto the disciples:* Let us give majesty unto the Lord, Who rose gloriously from the tomb and enlightened the whole world!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst fill the universe with joy by Thy Resurrection, O Christ, for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most pure Mother and Virgin, alone all-praised: entreat Thy Savior that He may save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Same Heirmos:* With evil crawling, [the serpent] of Eden ensnared me with the love of divinity and cast me down to earth; but as Thou art merciful by nature and compassionate, Thou hadst pity; the Grace [of God] made its dwelling in thy womb, assimilating Himself unto me in compassion, O Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Blessed is the Fruit of thy womb, O Virgin, O Theotokos, joy of all; for thou didst bear gladness unto the whole world, and true rejoicing, destroying sinful sorrow, O Bride of God!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst bear for us eternal Life and Light, O Virgin Birthgiver of God,...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...the return of ancient men unto the Father, therefore, adorning ourselves with faith, we confess [this] grace!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* Leaving not the Father's bosom, Thou didst descend to earth, O Christ God; I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Giving Thy shoulders unto wounds, incarnate of the Virgin; for the servant who sinned, the guiltless Master is beaten, loosing my transgressions!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Standing before judges, judged by lawbreakers as a judge is received, and receiving a blow from a defiled hand: He that created man and manifestly judges the earth in righteousness!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O true Child of God, entreat thy Creator and God, O spotless one, that He may guide into the haven of salvation the flock that glorifies thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: The prophet beholding...*[^194] Knowing no sin, O Lord, having known it not, Thou didst take upon Thyself that which was ours, appearing as an infant, and slaying the senseless, deceived tyrant!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having received corruption like Adam, O Lord my God, Thou didst abolish by Thy death him that held the power of death, and didst deliver men from deceit!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having come forth from the shadowed, pure mountain, the Virgin, Thou wast enrolled with servants, freeing us from bondage, as Master of all; therefore we glorify Him that was born of thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Same Heirmos:* Chosen by all and shown forth good unto God, all-hymned by the brightness of the pre-creation: illumine with thy light-shedding those that sing of thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst bear God on earth, O pure one,...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...incarnate of thy most pure blood, Who delivers from grievous transgressions those who with love magnify and honor thee, O most pure one!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The defiled rational nature receives the seed of divine operation, for He came forth from thee beyond understanding, O Virgin: the mystery of thy birthgiving, O most pure and all-blessed one!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* The night is without light unto the faithless, but unto the faithful there is illumination in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore early in the morning we sing unto Thee, praising Thy Divinity!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* For the sake of servants Thou wast betrayed, O Christ, and didst endure blows, mediating freedom for those who sing of Thee; early in the morning we sing unto Thee, praising Thy Divinity!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By divine power, O Christ, and by the weakness of the flesh, Thou didst cast down the strong one, and by Thy Resurrection, O Savior, didst show me to be victor over death!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst give birth unto God, O pure Mother, Who was incarnate of thee in a manner befitting God, O all-praised one; for thou knewest not a man's bed, but didst bring forth from the Holy Spirit!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Early in the morning unto Thee...* Grant Thy peace, O merciful Lord, and let Thy precious Cross enlighten our souls, as we praise Thee as merciful!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou Who didst make light shine upon the world by Thy Resurrection, and by Thy rising, O Christ, didst raise up him who had fallen through the enemy's deceit: save those who faithfully praise Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without seed thou didst knowingly conceive God, O unwedded Mother, Who was born before the ages of the Father; entreat Him ever, O Theotokos, that He may save us!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: O Lord my God...*

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: The ladder which Jacob saw, fixed unto the heights, was an image of thee who knewest not wedlock; through thee God lived among men, O most pure Sovereign Lady!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having received eternal redemption through thee, O Virgin, with diligence we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady!" and rejoicing in thy light, we hymn thee with songs!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Finding thee alone among thorns like a lily, O Virgin, shining with the brightness of purity, the Bridegroom brought thee unto Himself as an all-hymned Bride with the flower of virginity!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^195] Voyaging in the tempest of life without wind, and being submerged like a ship by sins, and cast about by the soul-corrupting whirlpool, crying like Jonah, O Christ: "Lead me up from the death-bearing deep!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The earthly congregation having of old been sold by polytheistic deceit, Thou, the Son of God, didst come in the form of a servant, and wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, that Thou mightest deliver [us] from corruption, as Thou art merciful!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In the spiritual chamber of the body not made with hands, destroyed by passions, when it seemed to be neglected, the apostolic choir, having hope, suddenly worshipped and proclaimed everywhere Him Who is risen!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Who among men can declare the image of thine ineffable birthgiving, O spotless one, O Virgin Bride of God, for our sake? For the ineffable Word united Himself [to flesh] from thee, and the flesh remained unchangeable!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: I cried unto Thee...* When Thou wast crucified, O Master, the whole earth was shaken, and...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...as Thou art good, Thou didst heal my grievous transgressions!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Death was abolished, and Hades was overthrown; for Christ arose [from the dead], preparing the resurrection of men!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O most pure Sovereign Lady, strong hope of Christians: preserve those who sing of thee with love, as one loving the truth!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Same Heirmos:* The prophetic prophecies manifestly proclaimed by legal types that thou wouldst give birth unto the Blessing of all creation, Who in many and manifold ways did good unto those who faithfully sing of thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adam the first-formed, who of old was frightened away by the counsel of the murderer of man from the divine food of paradise, thou didst manifestly lead back, O unwedded one, having given birth unto Him Who delivered us from his transgression!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Divine Light, Who by His all-effective power brought all things into being out of nothing, came forth from thy womb, O pure one, and shone with divine radiance upon those sitting in the darkness of death!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Kontakion: Protection of Christians unashamed...*[^196]

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Of old the Children showed the fiery-burning furnace to be breathing dew, singing to the one God and saying: "O God of our fathers, Who art supremely exalted, blessed art Thou!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the tree he who committed disobedience is put to death, but by the obedience of Christ he is formed anew; for for my sake the all-glorious Son of God is crucified!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All creation hymns Thee Who didst rise from the tomb, O Christ, for being Life, Thou didst blossom forth in Hades, the...

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: ...Resurrection of the dead and all-glorious Light unto those in darkness!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, daughter of corruptible Adam! Rejoice, only Bride of God! Rejoice, through whom the curse was banished, for thou didst bear God; entreat Him, O pure one, to save us all!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: In the Chaldean furnace...* Of Thine own will Thou wast crucified upon the Cross, that Thou mightest free men from corruption; therefore, pouring forth hymns, [we cry]: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst rise from the dead, O Giver of life, and trampling down the dominion of death, Thou didst raise with Thyself the eternal prisoners, who cry: "O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A Virgin gives birth without a man, and after childbirth remains a Virgin; for she gave birth unto God, singing unto Whom we cry aloud: "[O God] of our fathers!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Same Heirmos:* Having raiment all-adorned and gilded, thy Creator and Lord loved thee, O Virgin: "O God of our fathers, Who art supremely exalted!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Illumine me, O Virgin! Of old, the live coal[^197] which Isaiah foresaw typically prefigured thy birthgiving: "O God of our fathers, Who art supremely exalted, blessed art Thou!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the figures of all thy divine birthgiving, the divine prophets joyfully cried aloud: "O God of our fathers, Who art supremely exalted, blessed art Thou!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃а бессъмърьтна , жены же въпиꙗхоу въскресъ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The bush unconsumed by fire in Sinai, communing [therewith], showed forth God unto slow-tongued and stammering Moses; and the Children cast into the fire with divine zeal showed forth singers: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.slavonic_text: с̃оу́ꙁелныихъ воистворы́и дети · бестрастныи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become the Deliverer of the bound,[^198] O passionless Lord, Thou didst endure judgment, delivering the condemned; for as in Adam we died, so also all in Christ shall we live: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him!"

items.slavonic_text: ги тръпиши соудь · ѡ́соуженыихъ иꙁбавлаꙗ · ꙗ́
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He again translated us from corruption unto incorruption; holding the power, having cast [the enemy] down into dark and lightless habitations, He shatters the malice of the strong one and spoils his house: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him!"

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́ко же ѡ́ а́дамѣ оумрохомь · вси же ѡ[т] х̃ѣ ѡ́живе
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy pure and most immaculate childbirth, O Virgin, cleansed the defiled and unclean parts of the universe, and became the cause of our reconciliation[^199] unto God, O most pure one; therefore we hymn thee as Theotokos: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him!"

items.slavonic_text: мь · всꙗ дѣла г̃ни г̃а поите и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го : ~
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: The Children being called...*

items.slavonic_text: Пакы нась ѡ[т] тла на нетлѣнне прѣложи · дръжаи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Without beginning unto all, O Holy Trinity; for without time was the beginning of being: the Begetter God and Father, not prior in time unto the Son and not prior unto the Spirit; and appearing worshipped as Three in one Essence, and of one Godhead indivisible, is not God praised unto ages: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: силоу · въ мрачныꙗ и́ несвѣтлыꙗ ѡ́бители · скача
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast pierced in the ribs, with drops of divine Blood cleansing the earth defiled by the bloodshed of idolatrous wrath: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto ages!"

items.slavonic_text: растръꙁаеть крѣпкаго ꙁлобоу · и́ плѣнꙗꙗ домь
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin, who didst cause Christ, the Luminary before the sun, to shine forth upon the world, and delivering from corruption, enlightening with the knowledge of God those who cry: "Supremely exalted art Thou unto ages!"

items.slavonic_text: е́го · всꙗ дѣла г̃ни г̃а поите и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го : ~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Твое ч̃истое и́ пренепоро́чное д̃вце · сквръное же и́
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the light of thy childbirth, [thou didst strangely and timelessly illumine] the universe...

items.slavonic_text: нечистое вселеныꙗ ѡ́цѣтиль е̃ · и́ бы наше львели
items.english_text: ...[thou didst strangely and] timelessly illumine [the universe], O Birthgiver thereof; for truly upon thine arms thou dost bear God Who ever enlightens those that faithfully cry: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: ренню к б̃оу вина прѣч̃истаа · тѣм тꙗ б̃ц̃ю пое̃мь ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We ever piously praise thy womb which contained God ineffably incarnate, Who gave unto the faithful the radiant enlightenment of the knowledge of God, who ever cry: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: всꙗ дѣла г̃ни г̃а поите и́ прѣвъꙁно[сите] : ~ інь кр̃тоу ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the rays of thy light make radiant those who hymn thee, O pure Theotokos, Birthgiver of Light; for thou wast shown forth as the dwelling-place of Light, brightly enlightening those who ever cry: "All ye works of the Lord, hymn the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: ірм̃о · отроцѣ къꙁыва : ~ Беꙁначалнаа всѣмь ·
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Rejoice, radiant Bride, Mother of the Giver of light! Rejoice, thou who didst contain in thy womb Him Who cannot be contained! Rejoice, thou who art more honorable than the Cherubim themselves, having given birth unto the Savior of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: тр̃це с̃таа · невлѣтѣ бо начало быти · родитель б̃ъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the saving Blood, His own precious Blood, wherewith He redeemed us who had fallen through deceit, and destroyed the deceitful torment of the fierce enemy: therefore we unceasingly magnify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: и́ ѡц̃ь · не лѣтѣ прѣже сн̃а и́ прѣже д̃ха · и́ ꙗ́квыша
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure death by the spear,[^200] O Compassionate One, and didst come forth from the tomb as a bridegroom from the bridal chamber, and didst grant us incorruption: therefore we unceasingly magnify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: покланꙗема три въ единомь соу́ществѣ · н едино
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We have thee as a calm haven, O Theotokos, unto which we flee when laboring in life, being delivered by thy prayer from the enemy's assaults, and we remain unharmed!

items.slavonic_text: го бж̃тва нераꙁдѣлно · не̃сть б̃ъ хвалимь · въ вѣкы
items.english_text: *Another Canon of the Cross. Heirmos: Incorrupt...*[^201] Ye that ascribe suffering unto the Godhead, be ashamed, ye...

items.slavonic_text: всꙗ дѣла г̃ни г̃а поите : ~ В ребра прободен бысть
items.english_text: ...[fools];[^202] for [He is] God of glory, crucified in the flesh, yet not crucified in the essence of the Godhead, Whom in two natures we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: каплами кро́ви бж̃твъныꙗ · ꙁемлю ѡ́цѣщь ѡ[т]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye who believe not in the resurrection of bodies, coming to the tomb of Christ, learn that the Giver of life, having become dead in the flesh, arose, for the assurance of the final resurrection, Whom we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: кровени їдолскаго гнѣва ѡ́сквръненȣ · всꙗ дѣла
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Not by Godhead is the Trinity [divided], but by Hypostases; nor by confusion of Persons; but honoring one Godhead we understand division, and again making distinction, Which we unceasingly magnify!

items.slavonic_text: г̃ни г̃а поите и́ прѣвъꙁносите е̃го въ вѣкы : ~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Свѣтило прежде сълнца въснꙗвши мироу д̃вце
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast shown forth as the Mediatress of eternal joy and gladness unto us, O Ever-Virgin Maiden, having given birth unto the Redeemer; in spirit and in truth worshipping Him as God Who delivers [us]!

items.slavonic_text: ха · и ѡ[т] тлы и́ꙁбавлающе просвѣщающе раꙁȣмо
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy forefather [David] remembers thee, O most pure one, as secret [tabernacle] of the divine covenants,[^203] having contained God beyond nature, Who sat upon the Tree in holiness, Whom unceasingly we faithful magnify!

items.slavonic_text: б̃а говѣрыисть еси въпнюще е̃ въ вѣкы · інь пр̃тѣи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* For truly thou wast higher than all creation alone; for thou didst bear in the flesh for our sake the Creator of all; therefore as Mother of the Master of all, thou bearest for all the primordial victory!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion. Incipit: Having appeared...*[^204]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Sunday Stichera, Tone 7, Samoglasny:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Christ is risen from the dead, and the bonds of death are destroyed! Proclaim, O earth, great joy! Praise, ye heavens, the glory of God!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the holy Lord Jesus, the only Sinless One!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Unceasingly worshipping Christ's Resurrection, for He has saved us from our iniquities, Holy Lord Jesus, Who didst show forth the Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* For our sake God was among men; for the sake of corrupted nature the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us; unto the unthankful the gracious Benefactor, unto the captives the Deliverer, unto those sitting in darkness the Sun of righteousness; upon the Cross passionless, in Hades light, in death life, the Resurrection for the fallen: unto Whom let us cry: Our God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Eastern Stichera:*[^205]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Thou didst shatter the gates of Hades, O Lord, and didst destroy the dominion of death by Thy mighty power, and didst resurrect the dead that had sat from the ages in darkness, by Thy divine and all-glorious Resurrection, as King of all and Almighty God!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* For He resurrected the dead from the unbreakable bonds of Hades, and granted unto the world life eternal and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* From the depth of Hades [the thief] cried aloud from afar unto Thee, the Creator, and was counted worthy of Paradise; Thine ears, O Lord, were attentive unto his voice; without voice receiving him as suppliant, Thou didst clothe Thyself in the whole nature, not partaking of passions, yet partaking of death, and rising, Thou didst raise with Thyself the fallen one, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8:* Why did ye reject the Chief Cornerstone, O lawless Jews? Which God placed in Sion...

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: ...Who from the stone poured forth water in the wilderness, and for us poured forth immortality from His ribs? This is the Stone Which was cut out from the virginal mountain without hand of man: the Savior of man coming upon the clouds of heaven, the Ancient of Days, as Daniel said: His Kingdom is eternal![^206]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Evangelical Sticheron. Incipit: Having appeared...*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Fair was the fruit to look upon and good for food that killed me of old; but Christ is the Tree of Life, of Which eating I die not, but cry with the thief: "Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Compassionate One, and didst tear up the handwriting against Adam, and didst save the human race from deceit: therefore we hymn Thee, O Benefactor Lord!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Bitterness was poured forth and Hades was shaken at the hearing thereof, of old at the Passion of Christ upon the Cross; Thou didst pour forth the sweetness of incorruption: therefore we cry: "Glory to Thy rising!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Thou didst nail our sins unto the Cross, and by death didst put death to death, raising the dead from the dead: therefore we worship Thy Resurrection on the third day!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* In the tomb as dead Thou wast laid, O Life of all, O Christ, and didst shatter the gates of death, and didst rise in glory on the third day as mighty, and didst enlighten all: we cry aloud to worship Thy Resurrection on the third day!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Troparion 6:* The Lord, having risen on the third day from the dead, granted peace unto His disciples, and having blessed them, said: "Lead all unto...

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: ...My Kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Trinity Troparion:* Indivisible Trinity, one single Essence, thrice-radiant Substance: we worship Thee, O Father, Son, and Spirit, one Godhead and one Power, one consubstantial Trinity: "Remember me, O Lord, when [Thou comest into Thy Kingdom]!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear the Son and Word of the Father in the flesh upon earth, as He alone knows; therefore, O Virgin Mother, being made divine[^207] through thee, we cry aloud unto thee: "Rejoice, Hope of Christians!"

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 7: The Lord will give strength unto His people (LXX Ps. 28:11).* *Verse: Bring unto the Lord, ye sons of God (LXX Ps. 28:1).*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Epistle to the Galatians [Gal. 5:22–6:2]:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: Brethren: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, patience, goodness, gentleness, unfeignedness; against such there is no law. And they that are Christ Jesus' have crucified the flesh with the passions and lusts. If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit; and let us not be desirous of vainglory, despising one another, envying one another. And if a man be overtaken in any fault, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in the spirit of gentleness, considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted. Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Alleluia. Verse 1: It is good to give thanks unto the Lord (LXX Ps. 91:2). Verse 2: To proclaim Thy mercy in the morning (LXX Ps. 91:3).*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Gospel according to Matthew [Matt. 11:27–30]:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: The Lord said unto His disciples: "All things are delivered unto Me of My Father; and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither does any man know the Father,...

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: ...save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal Him. Come unto Me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you, and learn of Me; for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For My yoke is easy, and My burden is light."

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, Stichera at "Lord, I have cried", Penitential, Tone 7, Podoben: "No longer am I hindered" (Оуже не възбранни):*[^208]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Me who sin all the day long and grieve Thee, the Good Master, Who art merciful by nature: receive me returning as the prodigal, and make me as one of Thy hired servants, O Heavenly Father!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* In laziness I have passed through the measure of life, and I, the wretched one, have drawn near unto the end, and I think not of the judgment that awaits me, nor of falling away from God; but do Thou, turning me, save me, and snatch me away from all these things!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* From Gehenna and the gnashing of teeth deliver my humble soul, O Lord, and from all eternal condemnation, O All-Good One, that with faith I may hymn Thee as merciful God and Lover of mankind by nature!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Other Stichera of the Bodiless Powers.*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* A flaming fire Thine Angels, O Lord; Thou hast shown them forth unto us as fervent defenders, swift helpers, O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Save us, O Master, by the prayers of Thine Angels,...

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: ...washing away our stumbling-blocks, cleansing defiled sins, O Almighty: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Seraphim and Cherubim, Angels, Principalities, Dominions, singing with the brightness of all Angels, with Authorities: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* From thee, O most pure Theotokos Virgin, was ineffably born Christ our God, truly being pre-eternal God and Man, Son of both, ever-existing; and Who, having become [incarnate] for our sake, saves everyone: Whose nature is of two essences,[^209] the one showing power by miracles, and the other shining forth through passions; therefore the same One dies as Man and rises as God: entreat Him, O pure unwedded one, that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As he that fell among thieves and was wounded, so also have I fallen through my sins, and my soul is wounded: unto whom shall I flee, guilty that I am, except unto Thee, the Merciful, the Physician of souls? Pour out upon me, O God, Thy great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* As Thou art the Sun of righteousness, illumine the hearts of those that hymn Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Glory to Thee, O Christ God, praise of the Apostles, joy of the Martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Pacify our life by the prayers of the Theotokos, as we cry unto Thee: O Merciful One, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *On Saturday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried", set 8 stichoi, and sing the Resurrection Stichera, Tone 8, Samoglasny:*

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Evening hymn and spiritual service we offer unto Thee, O Christ, for Thou wast well pleased to have mercy upon us by [Thy] Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Lord, O Lord, cast us not away from Thy presence, but as Thou wast well pleased, have mercy upon us by [Thy] Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Rejoice, O Holy Sion, Mother of the Churches, dwelling-place of God! For thou didst first receive the remission of sins by the Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Eastern Stichera:*[^210]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* The Word of God the Father, begotten before the ages, in the latter times incarnate of the unwedded one, willingly endured crucifixion and burial for three days, and saved man who of old had been dead, by His Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Thy Resurrection from the dead we glorify, O Christ, for the sake whereof Thou didst free the race of Adam from the torment of Hades, and granted unto the world life eternal and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* Glory to Thee, O Christ Savior, Only-begotten Son of God, Who wast nailed unto the Cross and didst rise from the tomb on the third day!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Thee do we glorify, O Lord, Who for our sake willingly didst endure crucifixion; Thee do we worship, O Almighty Savior: cast us not away from Thy presence, but hear us and save us, for the sake of Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Dogmatikon Theotokion:* The King of heaven, for His love toward mankind, appeared on earth and lived among men; for having taken flesh from the pure Virgin, and having come forth from her with the assumption [thereof], He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in hypostasis. Therefore, proclaiming Him truly as perfect God and perfect Man, we confess Christ our God: entreat Him, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, O Jesus, Who camest down from heaven; Thou didst come unto death, O Immortal Life; unto those in darkness the True Light, and unto all the fallen the Resurrection: O our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Other Stichera according to the Alphabet:*[^211]

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Let us glorify Christ, Who is risen from the dead; for He took soul and body, and by the Passion severed both: for Thy most pure Soul, descending into Hades, which also He despoiled, while in the tomb Thy most pure Body knew not corruption, O Redeemer of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* With psalms and hymns let us glorify Christ, Thy Resurrection from the dead, wherewith Thou didst free us from the torment of Hades, as God granting unto us life eternal and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: б̃ци ірм̃о т̃о · Свѣтомь твоего рожьства · вселеноую
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* O Master of all, incomprehensible Creator of heaven and earth, enduring [crucifixion] upon the Cross, Thou didst pour forth dispassion unto us; and accepting burial, and rising in glory, Thou didst raise Adam with a mighty hand: glory to Thy Resurrection on the third day, wherewith Thou hast granted us life eternal, and cleansing of sins, as the only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Безневѣстнаꙗ м[а]ти д[ѣ]во · ꙗже б[ог]а неизреченно заче
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unwedded Virgin Mother, who ineffably didst conceive God in the flesh, Mother of the Most High God: receive the supplications of Thy servants, O most immaculate one, who grantest unto all cleansing of transgressions; receive now also our humble supplications, and pray unceasingly that we all may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: нши плътїю · м[а]ти б[ог]а вышнего · твоихъ рабъ м[о]ленїꙗ
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 8:* From the heights didst Thou descend, O Compassionate One; Thou didst endure three-day burial, that Thou mightest free us from passions: O our Life and Resurrection, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: прїими прѣнепорочнаꙗ · всѣмъ подающаꙗ оучѣще
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Resurrection Theotokion, Tone 8:*[^212] He Who for our sake was born of the Virgin, and endured crucifixion, O Good One, Who by death didst despoil death, and manifest the Resurrection as God: despise not those whom Thou didst create with Thy hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Theotokos who bore Thee, who intercedes for us; and save, O our Savior, a despairing people!

items.slavonic_text: нїе прѣгрѣшенїемъ · н[ы]нѣ наши малая моленїа прїи
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Trinity, Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos: Arming... (Въоружена):*[^213] Unto the Thrice-radiant King and Builder and Provider of all, and unto the one God in one Godhead existing, offering single and common divine glory unto the One Beginning, singing the Thrice-Holy hymn:

items.slavonic_text: ми · и моли непрестан[н]о сп[а]стис[ѧ] всѣмъ намъ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having directed our journey on high by river-like divine revelations, let us glorify the God-originating Essence in the unity of co-eternal, unoriginate glory in Three Persons: Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit, all-effecting and all-powerful!

items.slavonic_text: сниде мл[о]с[е]рде · погребенїе прїатъ тридневное · да на[съ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Abraham, having become the sacred initiate of mysteries, in a holy manner of old entertained the Creator of all, God and Lord, in three Persons, and recognized the Three-Hypostatic, single Dominion!

items.slavonic_text: свободиши ѿ страстеи · животе и въскр[есе]нїе наше
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unwedded one, having given birth unto Christ, Who assumed our nature, O most pure one...

items.slavonic_text: ~ в с ла и҃ · И же нас ради рожденеи ѿ
items.english_text: ...and remained without change both [natures]: entreat Him unceasingly to grant remission of my sins!

items.slavonic_text: д[ѣ]вы · распятїе притръпѣ вь бл[а]гыи · испровъргыи
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: The Affirmation...* Thee, the unapproachable God and King of glory, high upon the throne the heavenly [powers] beheld, Whom Cherubim and Seraphim glorify with unceasing hymns, the One Principle and Three-Hypostatic!

items.slavonic_text: смрътїю смръть · и въскр[есе]нїе явль ꙗко б[ог]ъ · не прѣзри
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Word, Who from the Father alone was born as from Mind, and the Spirit proceeding incomprehensibly by all human thoughts: receiving through scriptural teachings, we revere the One God, Thrice-radiant!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗже съз[да] рукою своею · ꙗви ч[е]л[овѣ]колюбїе свое мл[о]с[е]рде
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He Who is, the unbegotten Father, having timelessly begotten of His own Essence the Son, the Savior, Light from Light, brings forth the co-originating Light and Spirit, all-effecting and equal in honor!

items.slavonic_text: прїими рожьшюю т[ѧ] б[огороди]цу · м[о]л[ѧ]щююс[ѧ] за ны · сп[а]си
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst appear as the Church, O pure Virgin, Mother of the King of all, Who omnipotently and most wisely ordered and established the habitations; Whom entreat for me with thy maternal boldness!

items.slavonic_text: ~ канѡ[нъ] св[ѧ]тѣи тр[ои]цѣ гла[съ] и҃
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn to the Trinity, Tone 8:*[^214] The power of the Thrice-radiant and thrice-shining unoriginate Principle let all us faithful hymn, and with one desire let all the angelic heavenly choirs and earthly ecclesiastical ranks assemble to cry: "Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O most good God: glory and praise unto Thy dominion!"

items.slavonic_text: пѣ[снь] а҃ ірмо · Въоружена :~ Трїслънечному ц[а]рю
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Having given birth unto the ineffable and changeless God, Who ever delivers from sins and falls...

items.slavonic_text: и строителю · и промысльникоу вьсѣ · и б[о]гу единомоу
items.english_text: ...grievous, receive from Him change of sorrow, O good one, and by thy morning prayers [deliver me], that now with thanksgiving I may cry unto thee, O Mary, Mother of God, according to the mercy which thou hast obtained, O most immaculate one!

items.slavonic_text: б[о]ж[е]ствоу с[оу]щю · единественоую и обьще б[о]ж[е]ственоу
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou art Christ God, Thou art...*[^215]

items.slavonic_text: славоу · къ единоначалному припаде · пѣснь трїс[вѧ]тоую
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Dawns of the Godhead Thou didst manifest unto those in darkness, brightly dispersing all the soul's night, and the Sun of righteousness shone forth: simple indeed in Essence, but thrice-radiant in Persons, Whom we hymn in everlasting glory!

items.slavonic_text: Рѣчней б[о]ж[ь]ствънаꙗ извѣщенїа · прѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Him Who is hymned by the mouths of the Seraphim, we faithful also glorify with our lips: the one Lord of glory, singing unto Thee in unity and Hypostases; O Compassionate One unto all, grant unto Thy servants, O only Good One, remission of sins!

items.slavonic_text: выспрь наставивыи шествїе · б[о]гоначалное ество во
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All-holding, all-knowing, invisible Essence, most bountiful, compassionate, and long-suffering, honorable and God-originating Trinity: forget not me, Thy servant, unto the end, nor annul the covenant which Thou didst establish with Thy servants, for the sake of Thine ineffable mercy!

items.slavonic_text: единъствѣ слави · приснос[оу]щноисъ безначално
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Fair alone did the all-effecting and God-originating Word find thee from the ages, loving thy beauty, and dwelt within thee, renewing all human nature: Whom entreat unceasingly to deliver us from every torment!

items.slavonic_text: въ тр[ои]лицѣ · ѿц҃а и сн҃а и с[вѧ]т[а]го д[у]ха · вседѣтелноую и
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off...*[^216]

items.slavonic_text: С[вѧ]щеннотаинникъ авраамъ бывъ · с[вѧ]ще
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The co-eternal Three Persons of glory, the divine Essence dividing and uniting Thee as the One God, we faithfully cry: O One-Principle Holy Trinity, deliver Thy servants...

items.slavonic_text: ннообразнѣ · древле творца вьсѣхъ б[ог]а и г[оспод]а · въ трїесоста
items.english_text: ...from every affliction and sorrow!

items.slavonic_text: вънѣ прїꙗтъ оучаса · и трїисоставную дръжав[у] единест
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I weep for the weakness of my mind, how against my will I suffer the change of lust; therefore I cry unto Thee: O Holy God-originating Trinity, direct me unto good by Thy mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Weighed down with the slumber of sin, and cast down unto death by sinful sleep; but as the Lover of mankind, most good and all-merciful, O Holy God-originating Trinity, have compassion and have mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mother of God, Maiden Virgin most pure and immaculate, graced of God: by thy prayers entreat thy Son and God, O all-honorable one, swiftly to deliver thy servants now from passions!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior...*[^217]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Imitating the ranks of heavenly minds, O all-ruling Trinity, supersubstantial unto all, we glorify Thee with thrice-holy hymns with our faithful lips!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Worshipping and honoring the Three-Hypostatic [Godhead], Who created man according to His own image and brought him into being out of nothingness as was spoken of old, I sing and magnify!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Almighty God, One and unapproachable, dwell within me according to Thine ineffable mercy, O Thrice-radiant Master: enlighten me and give me understanding, as God and compassionate!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having become a pure temple unto God, show me forth as a temple of divine grace, O most pure Lady; preserve me unharmed by thy prayers!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben (*подобенъ*):*[^218] Confessing in truth, ye faithful, the Father without beginning, and the Son without beginning, and the Divine Spirit: indivisible...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...uncircumscribed, and ineffable, O simple, holy, and divine Trinity, singing unto Thee with the Angels: "Holy art Thou, O Father and Son, with the Holy Spirit in Persons! Have mercy upon those whom Thou didst create according to Thine image, O Master!"

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We ever give thanks unto God for thee, we magnify [thee] faithfully and worship, unceasingly hymning thy childbirth, O thou full of grace; we unceasingly hymn thee, saved, O all-merciful Virgin: that by God [thou mayest deliver us] from the snatching of demons and from the trial of the dread Day of Judgment, that we thy servants may not be put to shame!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The condescension of God...*[^219]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thine ineffable wisdom, show forth the order of goodness, that Thy servant may freely be shown mercy; look upon my prayer, and ever free and deliver [me], O Trinity-Unity God, granting deliverance from sins and passions!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Father, the unbegotten Mind, and the Word born of Him, and Holy Spirit, being co-ruling: we hymn Thee as Thrice-radiant!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unoriginate Trinity, indivisible in Essence, enthroned together in unity, inseparate in glory, primordial Essence and Kingdom: save those who believe in Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Fallen into mortification through sins, O most pure one, I flee unto thee with faith, O Most Pure, Originator of life: by thy prayers make thy servant alive, and deliver from all temptations and passions!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Sevenfold...*[^220]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being the unwaning Light, thrice-shining and thrice-radiant, One Principle, One Dominion...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...simple, incomprehensible God: enlighten now my dark-figured heart, make it radiant and light-bearing to hymn Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With sacred divine wings the Seraphim cover their faces in godly fear, not enduring the glory of the thrice-radiant beauty of the God-originating, co-ruling and God-beginning Thrice-Holy Trinity; yet we also, daring, hymn and glorify unto ages!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Lordly Origin without beginning, all-powerful and all-effecting goodness, and all-perfect Beginning, deifying and unceasing, innocent Cause, creative, intentional, provident, and saving unto all: we glorify the Unity in Essence, the Trinity, unto ages!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The unwaning Sun shone upon earth, for Whose sake, from thy virginal birth, O most pure Lady, He delivered mankind from idolatrous darkness: therefore enlighten with light and preserve thy servants who hymn thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Thee, unwedded...*[^221]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O King of glory and All-Holder of all, primordial Essence, from the beginning and Life-originating, Who wast well-pleased to bring [us] forth from non-being, compassionate, loving mankind: we sinners now glorify Thee, the unoriginate Trinity, asking remission, profound humility, and oneness of mind for the Churches!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Single Lordship thrice-shining, single God-Head in Three Persons: accept Thy singers in goodly beauty, and deliver us from transgressions and grievous temptations...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...grant humility, and unto the Churches goodly order and assembly!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Distinguishing Thee in Persons of Hypostasis, Thrice-Holy, in one Dominion we ever worship; all things standing by Thy word of command: grant forgiveness of sins, that we may worthily glorify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In the womb of the pure Virgin, O Christ, Thou didst make Thy dwelling; Thou wast manifestly shown forth unto all as God and Man, without change, without division, in truth: O God, ever protect Thy servants to be [Thee] unto ages, by the prayers of her that bore Thee; grant peace and humility unto all the world!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Triadika Hymns, Tone 4: In truth... and the rest:*[^222]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord", the Resurrection Troparion; repeat it.*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *After the First Stichologia, Sessional Hymns:*[^223]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* Wonderfully was Thy tomb sealed, and an Angel rolled away the stone from the doors; and the women, having beheld Thee risen from the dead, announced the good tidings unto Thy disciples in Sion: that the Life of all is risen, and has broken the bonds of death: Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* With ineffable brightness appearing unto the Myrrh-bearing women, the Angel, arrayed in radiant garments of joy, spoke the word: "The sad dominion of death is destroyed, the joy of incorruption has shone forth, and having risen from the dead, the Savior has saved the human race!"

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Let us hymn the heavenly gate, and ark, the most holy mountain, radiant cloud, the unburnt bush, the rational paradise, and the deliverance of Eve, the great hope of the whole universe...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...for salvation for the world was wrought in her, and remission of ancestral transgressions; therefore unto her [we cry]: O Mother of Christ God, grant remission of transgressions, for we thy servants have thee now as our Protectress!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 8:*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* Risen from the dead art Thou, the Life of all, and a radiant Angel said unto the women: "Cease from tears and announce the good tidings unto the Apostles; cry aloud, singing: Christ the Lord is risen, Who was well-pleased as God to save the human race!"

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Unto that [sepulchre] the women brought burial [myrrh], and they heard the angelic voice from the tomb: "Cease from tears, receive joy, cry aloud, singing: Christ is risen, Who was well-pleased as God to save the human race!"

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:*[^224] All creation rejoices in thee, O thou full of grace: the angelic assembly and the human race; hallowed temple and rational paradise, virginal boast, of whom God was incarnate and became a child, [yet] changeless, our God Who exists before the ages: for He made thy womb a throne, and made thy womb more spacious than the heavens; all creation rejoices in thee, O thou full of grace: glory to thee!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Hypakoe:* The Myrrh-bearing women, standing at the tomb of the Life-Giver, sought the Master among the dead, the Immortal One; and receiving the joy of the good tidings from the Angel, they announced the good tidings unto the Apostles: Christ is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Hymns of Degrees, Tone 8. Antiphon 1:*[^225]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* From my youth the enemy tempts me and inflames me with pleasures...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...but trusting in Thee, O Lord, I vanquish that one!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Ye that hate Sion, let them become as the grass before it is plucked up; for Christ shall cut down their necks with the cutting of torment!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *To the Holy Spirit:* To live ever: Light of Light, great God; with the Father and with the Word let us hymn Him!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* When I call, O Lord, give ear, and incline Thine ear unto me crying, and cleanse me before Thou takest me away hence!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Unto his mother [the earth] [turning], everyone having hope shall not be terrified then, when Thou shalt judge all by fire and torment!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *To the Holy Spirit:* Theology of the Thrice-Holy Unity: the Father without beginning, from Whom was born the timeless Son, and the Spirit co-enthroned, identical in form, shining forth with the Son from the Father!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* Let my heart be covered with Thy fear, being humble-minded, lest being lifted up it fall away from Thee, O All-Compassionate One!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Everyone entering into earth as into his mother shall immediately depart thither, to receive either torments or honors for how he lived!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *To the Holy Spirit:* Everyone who divinely beholds and speaks forth higher wonders, singing of the One God in Trinity; for even if Thrice-shining, He is of one authority in the Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 1:* Behold now, what is good or what is pleasant, but for brethren to dwell together? For concerning this the Lord promised life eternal!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Stanza 2:* Concerning His raiment, He Who clothes the lilies of the field commands the world to take no thought for anything!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *To the Holy Spirit:* In Whom abiding not everyone has, Giver of peace...

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: ...for He is consubstantial with God the Father and the Son!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 8: Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest (LXX Ps. 131:8).*[^226] *Verse: Remember David, O Lord, and all his meekness (LXX Ps. 131:1).*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord. Verse: Praise God in His saints (LXX Ps. 150:1).*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ...*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Psalm 50. Have mercy upon me, O God... and Refrain.*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *And the Prayer: "Save, O God, Thy people..." and the rest.*

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*[^227] The weapon-bearing Pharaoh did the wonderworking rod of Moses of old submerge, striking crosswise and dividing the sea, and saving fleeing Israel, walking on foot, sending up a hymn unto God!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* How shall we not marvel at the almighty Godhead of Christ? For from the passion He pours forth dispassion and incorruption unto all, and from His holy rib a fountain dripping immortality, and life from the tomb, co-essential!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As in goodly beauty the Angel now appeared unto the women, bearing the radiant immaterial forms, showing forth the immaterial order in appearance, crying: "Light has risen, the Lord is risen!"

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Most glorious things were spoken concerning thee throughout generations of generations, who didst receive the Word of God in thy womb, yet remaining pure, O Theotokos Mary: therefore we glorify thee, our true protectress after God!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Having traversed the water as upon dry land...*[^228]

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The painful gates were lifted up, and the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified, beholding the Most High of all nature [descending] unto the nethermost parts!

items.slavonic_text: Nеневѣстобрачно х[рист]а родила · ество пона
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The angelic ranks marveled, beholding upon the throne...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *(Lacuna: Physical leaf p201 is missing from this surviving printed exemplar (archival binder's notice: "ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ").)*[^229]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...[Lord,] Thou art the life of earthly ones; [the creation] hymns Thee in spirit!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou art the resurrection and rejoicing unto us all, and Thee do we glorify unceasingly, O Plenteous-in-mercy!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee all we Christians have as our refuge and wall, and thee do we glorify unceasingly, O Unwedded One!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Theotokos, Heirmos, of the same Tone:*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Grant us help by thy prayers, all-venerable one, repelling the onslaught of bitter griefs!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast the restoration of Eve our foremother, giving birth to Christ the Author of life, O all-spotless Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Gird me with power, O all-pure one, who didst give birth from the womb in the flesh to the true God, the hypostatic Power!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^230] Thou art my Lord, O Christ, Thou art also my power, Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing, Who leaving not the Father's bosom, hast visited our poverty in mercy; therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Loving me that was hostile, Thou in marvelous condescension didst come down to earth, O Savior,[^231] not rejecting the reproach of my extreme poverty; and remaining in the height of Thine all-pure glory, Thou didst glorify him that was dishonored before!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Who, beholding Thee, O Master, marvels not: death dissolved by Thy passion, and corruption by the Cross, and through death the wealth of Hades emptied by Thy goodly power? I hymn the deed of Thee Who wast crucified, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art the boast of the faithful, O unwedded Virgin; thou art our protection and shelter; thou art the refuge of Christians, a wall and a ha...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...ven; for unto thy Son thou dost bear prayers, O spotless one, saving from perils those who with faith and love know thee as pure Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: I have heard...*[^232]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The lawless children nailed Thee to the Cross, O Christ, whereby, O Merciful Savior, Thou didst save those who glorify Thy marvelous deeds!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
