items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise those condemned in the tombs, who glorify Thy rising, O only Almighty Lifegiver!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Pray to thy strong God, O all-pure one, to save His flock from affliction and sorrows, and from every harm of the adversary!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Having brought forth the lifegiving ear of corn, O untilled field, which gives life to the world, O Theotokos, save those who praise thee!*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All proclaim thee, all-pure Theotokos, as enlightenment; for thou, ever-Virgin, hast given birth to the Sun of Righteousness!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Grant us cleansing of our ignorances, as Sinless One, God of all the world, by the prayers of her who gave birth to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^233] Why hast Thou cast me away from Thy face, O Never-setting Light, and an alien darkness has covered me, the wretched one? But turn me unto the light of Thy commandments, and direct my ways, I pray Thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Enduring to be clothed in the purple robe of reproach, covering the ill-formed blessedness of the first-fashioned, Thou wast nailed naked upon the Cross, O Christ, stripping off the garment of mortality!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Him of dust who had fallen by death, Thou didst raise again, [clothing our] nature in incorruption...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...renewing once more the churchly image, shining forth life in incorruption!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having maternal boldness toward thy Son, O all-pure one, despise not our race, we pray thee; for thee alone do we offer unto the Master as prayerful propitiation!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: Enlighten us by Thy commandments...*[^234]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Guide us by the power of Thy Cross, O Lord, Lover of mankind; for unto Thee do we fall down: grant us Thy peace, O only Plenteous-in-mercy!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Helmsman of our life, O Christ our God, unto those who praise Thy rising grant also Thy peace, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Pray to thy Son and our God, O unwedded Bride, pure Mother, to send down great mercy upon the faithful!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Theotokos, of the same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Quench the uncontrollable surging of my passions, for thou didst give birth to the Helmsman and Lord!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The angelic ranks and gatherings of men serve thy childbearing, O pure Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, Bride of God, destroy the armies of the enemy, and make those who hymn thee to rejoice!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^235] Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities, and lead me up from the depth of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By a tree did the ancient evil one mightily cast me down; but Thou Thyself, being hanged, O Christ, didst mightily cast him down by the Cross, and didst raise up the fallen, [created in Thine] image!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hadst compassion on Sion, shining forth from the tomb, a new...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...covenant fulfilling in prayer by divine Blood; and Thou art sacrificed therein unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* May we be delivered through thee from bitter transgressions, prayer of mercy, O pure Theotokos; and may we obtain, O all-pure one, divine illumination through the Son of God ineffably incarnate of thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord...*[^236]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Stretching out Thy palms upon the Cross, Thou didst heal the unrestrainedly outstretched hand of the first-fashioned in Eden; and of Thine own will Thou didst taste gall, O Christ, and didst save from corruption, as Good One, those who praise Thee, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Deliverer tasted death of the first condemnation, that He might destroy the kingdom of corruption; and having descended into Hades, O Christ Savior, save as Mighty One those who hymn Thy resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Cease not to pray for us, O all-pure Theotokos Virgin, for thou art the confirmation of the faithful, and by hope in thee are we strengthened; therefore do we glorify God Who was incarnate of thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Grant me a robe...*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The faithful proclaim thee as the Church and Ark of God, the ensouled bridal chamber, and the Heavenly Gate, O Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become the Destroyer of pagan shrines as God, He that was born of thee, O Mary, Bride of God, is worshipped with the Father and the Spirit!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Word of God showed thee, O Virgin, unto men as Queen of barren virgins; for through thee the Most High came down unto us, as Protectress!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:*[^237] At God's condescension the fire was ashamed in Babylon of old; therefore the Children in the furnace, dancing with joyful foot...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...as in light, sang: Blessed [art Thou, O God of our Fathers]!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* At the glorious condescension of the divine wealth, at Thy poverty, O Christ, the angelic ranks are amazed, beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, that Thou mightest save those crying in faith: Blessed is the God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By Thy divine descent the nethermost parts were filled with light, and the darkness that before pursued was driven away; therefore the captives from the ages cried unto the Risen One: Blessed [art Thou]!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Proclaiming orthodoxly from the Father the Lord of all, the Only-begotten Son from the One Father, we have beheld the one upright Spirit proceeding from Thee, co-natural and co-eternal!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: He Who from the Father...*[^238]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Spreading out upon the Tree like a fruitful vine, O Master, pouring forth the wine of immortality, O Christ, gladdening the hearts of those crying in spirit: Blessed art Thou, O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having risen from the tomb as from sleep, O Compassionate One, and having destroyed death, all creation believed as the Apostles proclaimed the resurrection: Blessed art Thou, O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Incarnate from the virginal womb, Thou didst appear for our salvation; therefore, entering by Thy Trinity, we cry orthodoxly to the Theotokos: Blessed art Thou, O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Most Holy Theotokos, of the same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Incarnate of the virginal womb, Thou didst appear for our salvation; therefore, knowing Thy Mother to be the Theotokos, we cry thankfully: [Blessed art Thou], O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A rod didst thou appear, O Virgin, from the root of Jesse, [bearing] the all-divine, light-bearing, saving Fruit, unto the wife of faith...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...crying unto Thine: Blessed art Thou, O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The hypostatic Wisdom of the Most High filled all the divine powers with wisdom, for the sake of the Theotokos, of those crying in faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our Fathers!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:*[^239] Sevenfold did the Chaldean tyrant fiercely heat the furnace for the pious children; but beholding them saved by a better power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Christ unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The co-essential Godhead, the all-divine power, has divinely shone upon us; for having manifestly tasted death in the flesh, by the Crucifixion He destroyed the strength of Hades; Whom we unceasingly hymn: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Crucified is risen; the boastful one is fallen; the fallen and broken one is restored, and darkness is driven away, and incorruption has blossomed forth; for by life death was swallowed up: Ye children, bless...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Thrice-radiant Godhead, shining in one ray from the one three-hypostatic nature: the unoriginate Father, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the reigning consubstantial Spirit, we hymn: Ye children, bless; ye priests...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: Unto the Victor...*[^240]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having stretched out His hands upon the Tree, naked, calling [all] to be warmed by His noble nakedness: Bless and supremely exalt...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having honored Him Who raised fallen Adam from the nethermost parts unto high-enthroned glory: Bless, all ye works...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst appear, O Virgin, as daughter of fallen Adam; for thou art the divine [mother] of Him Who renewed our nature, Whom we hymn: Bless...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos: The King of Heaven, Whom...*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Quench the assault of the adversaries and the fiery burning arrows, that we may hymn thee, pure one, unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beyond nature hast thou given birth to the Creator and Savior, God the Word, O Virgin; therefore do we hymn thee, pure one, unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With radiant splendor, He Who is unapproachable Light, dwelling within thee, O Virgin, showed thee forth as light unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:*[^241] Thee, unwedded Mother of God the Most High; thee, who beyond mind didst give birth by the Word to the truly existing God, higher than the all-pure Hosts, in unceasing doxologies do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, Who didst raise up fallen Adam, glorifying him with Thyself in the heavens, O Christ, as King of all and Lord, in unceasing hymns do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, God crucified for our sake of Thine own will, Who didst abolish the dominion of death, O Christ, and didst deliver [us] from the bonds of Hades, in unceasing blessings do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, who didst bear in thine arms the invisible God, Who is hymned on high by the Hosts, and through thee ever granting us salvation in the resurrection, do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross. Heirmos: In truth [Theotokos]...*[^242]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Tree of Thy Cross was revealed, O Christ, upon which stretching out Thy divine palms, Thou didst plant righteousness in the world, O Christ!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Descending of Thine own will with Thy Cross into the nethermost parts of the earth, O Merciful God, for Thy tender mercy's sake Thou hast magnified [us]...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Receptacle of Light, O blessed of God, for the sake of the Radiance enlighten my heart, driving away the cloud of despondency, and chasing away the darkness of sin, O thou who didst give birth to the Sinless One!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Another, to the Theotokos, of the same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy memory fills with joy and gladness those who draw near, pouring forth healings, who piously confess thee as Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With hymns do we praise thee, O highly favored of God, and unceasingly offer: "Rejoice!", for thou hast poured forth joy upon the world!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Comely did He become through thy flesh, O Theotokos, all-pure and incorrupt, Mediator of life unto those who hold fast, who magnify thee in faith!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Holy is the Lord our God (LXX Ps. 98:9). Evangelical Exapostilarion, Reading 1, Resurrectional.*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 8:*[^243]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Lord, even though Thou didst stand at the judgment seat, judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not withdraw from the throne, sitting with the Father; and having risen from the dead, Thou didst free the world from the servitude of the stranger, as only Compassionate One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Lord, Thou hast given us Thy Cross as a weapon against the devil; for he trembles and shakes, not able to look upon its power; for it raises the dead and has abolished death: therefore we worship Thy burial and Thy resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Lord, even though the Jews laid Thee in the tomb as dead, yet soldiers guarded Thee as a sleeping king; and as the treasury of life they sealed it with a seal: and Thou didst rise and grant incorruption unto our souls!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Lord, when Thou wast nailed upon the Cross and didst stretch out Thy hands...

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: ...then didst Thou abolish the dominion of death by Thy strength, and having descended into Hades didst free the souls, co-raising and enlightening our souls by Thy resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Anatolian Stichera:*[^244]

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Thou didst suffer on the Cross, being impassible in Thy Godhead; Thou didst receive burial for three days, that Thou mightest free us from the servitude of the enemy, and having made us immortal, make us alive, O Christ, through Thy resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* I worship and supremely glorify, and hymn, O Christ, Thy rising from the tomb, whereby Thou hast freed us from the insoluble bonds of Hades, and hast granted unto the world, as God, incorruption and eternal life, as Good One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Him Who is risen from the dead let us glorify: God the Word, Who appeared dwelling in Himself upon earth, for our sake received reproach from the lawless and blows on the cheek; Whose kingdom He destroyed as Almighty God: therefore He was nailed to the Cross in the flesh, for our sake as Man, and opened Paradise unto the thief as Creator of all, Deliverer and Savior of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Sticheron 8:* Being the incomprehensible Creator of heaven and earth, Thou didst suffer upon the Cross, that Thou mightest pour forth impassibility unto me, as God; Thou didst receive three-day burial, and didst rise in glory, co-raising Adam as Almighty!

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *Then the Evangelical Sticheron, Reading 1. Both now... Most blessed art thou (Theotokion).*

items.slavonic_text: [Листъ 201 утраченъ / отсутствꙋетъ въ данномъ экземплярѣ: ЭТОГО ЛИСТА В КНИГЕ НЕТ]
items.english_text: *At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 8: Remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom...*

items.slavonic_text: Х҃е сп҃се мира · іакоже помѧнꙋ разбоиника на древѣ ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree, vouchsafe also unto me, O only Compassionate One, Thy heavenly kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: и сподоби ма єдине щедре нб҃наго ти цр҃твиꙗ : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Nailed of Thine own will upon the Tree, O our Savior, by the Tree Thou hast delivered Adam from the curse, restoring as Compassionate One that which was in His image unto the habitation of Paradise![^245]

items.slavonic_text: Иа древѣ пригвозди сѧ сп҃се нашь волею · древѡмь
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Today, having risen from the tomb, Thou didst pour forth incorruption unto all the dead, and granting joy unto the myrrh-bearing women, Thou didst rise as Merciful!

items.slavonic_text: адама ѿ клѧтвы избавилъ єси · ѿдавъ іако ще
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Today Thou hast abolished the dominion of death by Thy power, O Giver of life, and hast freed the souls from the dead, [O Thou Who art the] Resurrection, our only Savior!

items.slavonic_text: гроба · въсѣмъ мр҃твыимь источи нетлѣніе · и радо
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As in heaven the multitude of Angels, so also on earth the human race celebrates Thy most holy Resurrection, [praising] Thy goodness!

items.slavonic_text: сть мѵроносицамь даровавы · въскресе іако милосе
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Rejoice, ye wise myrrh-bearing women, who first beheld the Resurrection of Christ and announced joy unto the Apostles and the Resurrection unto the whole world!

items.slavonic_text: є[си] силою своею жизнодавче · и дꙋша свободилъ єси ѿ
items.english_text: *Glory:* Trinity without beginning and indivisible Essence, co-enthroned Unity, unseparated in glory, transcendent Nature: save those who believe in Thee!

items.slavonic_text: мрътвыихъ въскресеніе єдине сп҃се нашь : ~
items.english_text: *Both now:* Thee in truth, O Virgin Mother of God, let all the faithful with one accord hymn, as strong champion and intercessor, and the salvation of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: мнѡжество аг҃гль , тако и на земли родъ чл҃чськы
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon [Tone 8: Pray, and give glory unto the Lord our God (LXX Ps. 75:12). Verse: Known in Judea is God; in Israel His name is great (LXX Ps. 75:2)].*[^246]

items.slavonic_text: и · прѣсвѣтое въскресеніе празднꙋеть · бл҃гости твоеꙗ
items.english_text: *Epistle to the Corinthians [1 Cor. 1:10–18]:*[^247] Brethren, I beseech you by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment. For it has been declared...

items.slavonic_text: Радоуите сѧ мꙋдрыꙗ жены мѵроносица ,
items.english_text: ...unto me of you, my brethren, by them of the household of Chloe, that there are contentions among you. Now this I say, that every one of you says: "I am of Paul," and "I of Apollos," and "I of Cephas," and "I of Christ." Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were ye baptized in the name of Paul? I thank my God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius, lest anyone should say that I baptized in mine own name. And I baptized also the household of Stephanas; besides, I know not whether I baptized any other. For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Gospel: not in wisdom of words, lest the Cross of Christ should be made of none effect. For the word of the Cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us who are saved it is the power of God.

items.slavonic_text: преж[е] въскр҃сеніе х҃во видѣвше · и възвѣстиша апо
items.english_text: *Alleluia: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord (LXX Ps. 94:1). Verse: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving (LXX Ps. 94:2).*[^248]

items.slavonic_text: столо[м] радо[сть] · и всему мироу въскр҃сеніе : ~
items.english_text: *Gospel according to John [John 15:17–16:2]:*[^249] The Lord said unto His disciples: These things I command you, that ye love one another. If the world hate you, know that it hated Me before it hated you. If ye were of the world, the world would love its own; but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you. Remember the word that I said unto you: The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted Me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept My word, they will keep yours also. But all these things will they do unto you for My name's sake, because they know not Him Who sent Me. If I had not come and spoken unto them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin. He that hates Me hates My Father also. If...

items.slavonic_text: началнаꙗ тр҃це · и нераздѣлнаꙗ сꙋщество · съпрѣ
items.english_text: ...I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they would not have had sin; but now have they both seen and hated both Me and My Father. But this comes to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law: "They hated Me without a cause." But when the Comforter is come, Whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, Who proceeds from the Father, He shall testify of Me; and ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with Me from the beginning. These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended. They shall put you out of the synagogues; yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he offers service unto God.

items.slavonic_text: столнаꙗ єдниство · неразлꙋчнаꙗ славою · пренача
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, Stichera to our Lord, of Repentance, Tone 8, Podoben: "Lord, even though at the judgment seat" (Господи аще на судищи):*[^250]

items.slavonic_text: дв҃о бг҃ородителнице , вси вѣрніи съгла[сно] воспоимъ ·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* O good Shepherd, Who didst lay down Thy life for the sheep, Who alone art good, knowing the hidden things and deeds wrought by me: shepherd me wisely away from the wandering one, and snatch me from the wolf, O Lamb of God, and have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: іако крѣпкꙋю поборницꙋ и застꙋпницꙋ · и сп҃сеніе
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Weighed down by frightful phantasms through the deceit of sin, grant me also the morning day of repentance, enlightening the eyes of my mind, O Christ, the Enlightenment of our souls, and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Прѡо въщи инте̄гвинда · і҃ · з҃ наємь
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Entangled in the gloom of sin and worldly pleasures, alas, O my wretched soul! And various passions hold sway, and I have no thoughts of compunction. But, O Savior, have compassion on my weakness, and give me tears of compunction, that I also may bewail myself before the end; I cry unto Thy tender mercy, O Lord: O Christ, my Savior, save me who am in despair, and...

items.slavonic_text: въ іоудєнѣхъ · а҃ пль · ч҃ е҃ и҃ · к корєнөѡмь ·
items.english_text: ...[deliver me from the enemy who destroys] souls!

items.slavonic_text: Братіа , молю вы имєнемь гн҃а нашего іс҃ х҃а · да то же гл҃е
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Lord, the bodiless choirs unceasingly glorify Thee, delighting in Thy beauty, Thine ineffable goodness; with thrice-radiant rays they most richly praise Thee: by whose prayers, O Savior, save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: те вси · и да не сꙋть въ васъ распрѧ · да єсте же съврꙋ
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Lord, Thou hast established the all-encompassing ranks of Angels, O all-powerful Word, granting them a habitation of unwaning radiance through the all-holy Spirit: by whose prayers preserve the blessings of the Church!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Lord, the Seraphim, Principalities, and Angels, Dominions, and Powers, and Archangels, and the Cherubim praise Thee awesomely, sending up praise unto Thee: by whose prayers, O Savior, save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* What virtue, or what praise is worthy of thee, O Mary? For bowing the heavens, He descended and was pleased to be born of thee, the pre-eternal God; for whose sake all things upon earth today are filled with joy, the idolatrous shrines are brought low, and the pagan altars are destroyed, for Christ is come into the world, our God Who became incarnate: glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon: Behold now bless the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord (LXX Ps. 133:1). Verse: Ye that stand in the temple of the Lord (LXX Ps. 133:2).*

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Repentance [Kneeling]:*

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thee, King and God, the Angels unceasingly hymn; but I fall down before Thee, crying unto Thee as the publican: O God, be gracious unto me and have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Having entered into [the sea of life], O Immortal One, I am submerged by worldly waves; but rising up, crying unto my Benefactor: O God, be gracious unto me and have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Martyrs of the Lord, in every place...

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: ...ye sanctify and heal every infirmity; and now watching, deliver our souls from the snare of the enemy, we pray!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I, O holy Virgin Theotokos, flee unto thy protection; I know that I shall find salvation, for thou art able to help me!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Supreme Commanders of the heavenly hosts, we the unworthy now beseech you: that by your prayers you may shelter us under the shadow of the wings of your immaterial glory, preserving us who fall down and cry diligently: Deliver us from perils, as leaders of the higher powers![^251]

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Knowing that thou art superior to all creatures, O Theotokos, we draw near to hymn thee with our soul in perils; therefore we pray thee: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *At the First Stichologia, Sessional Hymns of Repentance, Tone 1:*[^252]

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* Make haste to open unto me the Father's embrace; prodigally have I squandered my life, but looking unto the wealth of Thy tender mercies, despise not now an impoverished heart; unto Thee, O Lord, in repentance I cry: I have sinned, Father, against heaven and before Thee!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall I, a sinner, appear? I have not borne the burden and the heat of the day, but number me with the laborers of the eleventh hour, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, joy of our forefathers, glory of our race, and protection of those who run unto thee!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *At the Second Stichologia, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1:* I have zealously imitated the prodigal in sins, but have not acquired his repentance; yet as the all-good Son, O Lord, turn me who have willfully wandered, and cleanse me from the defilements of my transgressions for the sake of the Theotokos; I cry unto Thee: I have sinned, Father, against heaven and before Thee!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2:* When Thou comest in power...

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: ...upon earth with glory, and all things tremble, a river of fire flows before the judgment seat, and the books are opened, and secret things are made manifest: then deliver me from the unquenchable fire, and vouchsafe me to stand on Thy right hand, O righteous Judge!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* These soldiers of the great King resisted the commands of the tyrants manfully; they were heedless of tortures, and having abolished all deceit, ye were worthily crowned; and they ask of the Savior peace and great mercy for our souls!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos, for thou didst bear the heavenly King, the Savior and Enlightener of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *On Monday [at Matins], Canon of Repentance [to our Lord Jesus Christ], Ode 1, Tone 1. Heirmos:*[^253] Thy victorious right hand has been glorified in strength in a manner fitting for God; for that immortal [right hand], being all-powerful, shattered the adversaries, renewing a path through the deep for the Israelites, for He has been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Consume the multitude of my sins by the multitude of Thy compassions, and grant me a thought of conversion, that I may glorify Thy goodness which surpasses the mind!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fittingly imitating the deadness of Christ Who suffered of His own will, O all-praised passion-bearers, ye endured many various deaths, O glorious ones; therefore, O martyrs, ye have been likened unto the immortal life!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The ranks of bodiless powers praise thee, O all-hymned Virgin, who didst bear the uncircumscribed God incarnate, and didst remain a virgin, even as before childbirth, O all-pure one!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Angels, Tone 1. Heirmos: Delivered from bitter slavery...*

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Standing before the throne, before the Master, O all-holy Angels: entreat the Word, the Angel of great counsel, Who with the Father without beginning is in the Spirit, for us who praise you in hymns!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Light-bearing mirrors, receiving the outpourings of the thrice-radiant light, all ye ranks of Angels, having first conceived the divine arrangements as far as is attainable!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Illumined by the divine light, enlightened by the Holy Spirit, deliver us from passions and eternal pitfalls!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God, Who adorned the ranks of the higher powers, took up His abode in thy most pure womb, O Theotokos, higher than the Seraphim, and was made flesh without change!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^254] O Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and hast mercifully clothed Thyself therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may sing unto Thee, the spiritual temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Have mercy on me, O only Good One, have mercy! As the publican I cry unto Thee with fear, bearing a multitude of sins with myself, and covered with the weight of transgressions, and filled with immeasurable shame!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Confessing the Unity of the Holy Trinity, ye destroyed the deceit of the devil by divine faith, and were shown forth as luminaries, illumining the hearts of all with divine rays!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O holy, all-pure one, thou didst bear the Holy One Who rests in the saints, the Son and Word co-beginningless with the Father, Who sanctifies the world and shines forth with goodness!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, the same:* To the divine light the Seraphim drawing near, filled with abundant...

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: ...satisfaction, having shone forth first in brightness, as secondary lights they are deified by the Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring diligently to sing angelically in light, granted help and faithfully asking with purity of mind, and with most pure lips, to receive their illuminations!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Have mercy on me, O only Good One, save me as the publican! With fear I cry unto Thee, bearing [sins] with myself, and covered with the weight of transgressions, filled with immeasurable shame!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Gabriel was counted worthy to behold the transcendent Word, O all-hymned Virgin, and brought unto thee the joyful voice, plainly proclaiming the conception of the Word and declaring the ineffable childbirth!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:*[^255] Seeing with far-seeing eyes the mountain shadowed by the grace of God, Habakkuk proclaimed that the Holy One of Israel should go forth from thee, for our salvation and renewal!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto whom shall I liken thee, O my wretched soul, working wicked and grievous deeds? But turn and cry unto Him Who willfully became poor for thy sake: O Knower of hearts, have mercy and save me!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Great champions, true martyrs, ye endured the fire of torment and bitter suffering; therefore, O spiritual ones, deliver us who faithfully glorify thee from alien torment!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who of old was begotten of the Father, the Savior, born of thee in time beyond time, O Virgin, taking flesh from thee, was pleased to blot out the ancient curse, as Merciful!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, the same:* Thrones, Cherubim, and Seraphim fulfilling the primary beauty...

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: ...flashing with divine rays, receiving the divine ministrations, with songs they praise Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* They praise the thrice-radiant Unity of the Godhead, by threefold holy sanctifications, making known an unceasing voice; and the most pure Seraphim mystically bless and gloriously instruct!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sigh, O my soul! Weep, O my soul! But cease from evil deeds and unseemly actions, that by the prayers of the holy Archangels thou mayest find the Judge merciful!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is higher than all creation, Who formed man on earth wisely and by divine hand, illumined with divine splendor, took up His abode in thy womb, O all-hymned one!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^256] Our enlightenment by Thy coming, O Christ, and having illumined the ends of the world with the Cross, enlighten the hearts of those who orthodoxly hymn Thee with the light of Thy knowledge!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou knowest the hidden and secret things of my heart, O God my Creator; judge me not, O Lord, in the day of judgment, when Thou shalt judge the whole world!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthened by the hope of things to come, O martyrs, enduring tearings easily and manfully, by unflagging endurance ye gave no rest unto the multifaceted enemy!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The mouth cannot tell of thy dignity, nor recount ineffable beauty, O unwedded one; ineffably thou givest birth, and bearest in thy hands Him Who holds all things in His hand!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, the same:* Kindled with divine love, Dominions and Powers...

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: ...and Powers and secondary ranks, with unceasing mouth praising the divine origin, [glorify] one power, one essence!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The leadership of Archangels, ranks of spiritual Angels, Principalities and innumerable hosts, shining with threefold unity, are most brightly taught to honor the one Essence!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As Thou art the Physician of souls and bodies, O Master, heal the grievous and heavy sickness of my soul, for the sake of the Angels and Archangels, O Christ, by their God-pleasing prayers, as Thou art all-good!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast adorned more than all angelic comeliness, having conceived the Creator of Angels, O most pure Mother of God, receiving flesh and bearing the Incarnate One, O all-immaculate one!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^257] The uttermost abyss has encompassed us, and there is none to deliver; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter: save Thy people, O our God, for Thou art the strength and restoration of the weak!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wandering on the path of destruction, and fallen into the pit of transgressions: turn me back, O Christ, unto the path of Thy commandments and unto the light of Thy righteousness, that I may glorify Thee!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Showered with stones as with truly precious stones, ye did not reject the Rock of life, nor did ye sacrifice unto the idols carved of stone, O glorious and forever existing martyrs, invincible ones!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* According to the divine will thou didst bear One of the Trinity, begotten of the Father, O immaculate one, serving the One Essence: Whom pray unceasingly without ceasing!

items.slavonic_text: шени въ тоиже мысли · и въ тоиже воли · наре
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, the same:* The bodiless ranks, O Lord, standing before the throne of Thy glory, O Merciful One, with unceasing voices thrice...

items.slavonic_text: ты бо крѣпость єси нашь хр҃тїанѡмъ и похвала : ~
items.english_text: ...[holy hymn bringing unto Thee: for] Thou art our strength, and the boast of Christians![^258]

items.slavonic_text: Зраще твоего лица доброты непостижныꙗ · прѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the incomprehensible beauties of Thy face, O most divine Angels, and flashing with divine rays through Thy beauty, they are espoused [unto Thee], for Thou art our light and rejoicing, O Master!

items.slavonic_text: бж҃твенїи аг҃гли · и лѣпотою твоею бж҃твныи лиза
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Raising the dead to life, leading the blind unto the light, and opening a remedy for those who are grievously infirm, which brought near the day of salvation: such is your intercession, O holy Angels and Archangels!

items.slavonic_text: рꙗюще невѣстатсѧ , ты бо єси н[а]мъ вл[ады]ко свѣтъ и радованіе : ~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The transcendent Bodiless One, the Word from thee, O all-pure one, was incarnate, He Who by His will created and brought forth the bodiless hosts from non-existence, as All-powerful!

items.slavonic_text: Мртвы живого сїа · слѣпыи свѣтоу же пришество
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Archangels, Tone 2:* Archangels of God, ministers of divine glory, leaders of the Angels and guides of the bodiless [powers]: ask that which is profitable for us, and great mercy, as archangels of the bodiless hosts!

items.slavonic_text: ва · и немощны лютѣ врачевство ѡтверзе · иже сп҃се
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:*[^259] Thee, O Mother of God, we faithful perceive as a noetic furnace; for as He saved the three youths, the Exalted and Renovating One was wholly contained in thy womb, the God of our fathers Who is praised and exceeding glorious!

items.slavonic_text: нїеднь приближи , ваши застꙋпленїе ст҃и аг҃гли и
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As of old Daniel tamed the lions by fasting, and armed himself with good deeds: imitate him, O my soul, for the roaring one seeks ever to devour me as a lion; and falling down before God, pray that He may make him of none effect!

items.slavonic_text: архаг҃гли : ~ Воплоти сѧ прѣбесплотень · слово ис
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The God-radiant martyrs, enlightened with the light of the most rich Trinity, passed through the dark gloom and deceitful mist, singing with praises: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: тебе прч҃таа · творѧ иве[р]же волею · бесплотнаа воинь
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In accordance with the law, nature is renewed in thee; for beyond the laws of the flesh thou, O immaculate one, didst bear the Lawgiver, Who established deliverance for all who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: ства · приведъıи ѿ небытїа іако вседоганъ : ~ г҃ г҃ б҃ ·
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, to the Bodiless Powers, the same:*[^260] Being the unoriginate Light, O Master, Thou didst shine forth as Light from the Father; Thou hast established the angelic hosts, who receive the unwaning radiance as mirrors, praising: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Архистратизи · бж҃їи слꙋжителїе бж҃твныꙗ сла
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Neither tongue nor mind, O Master, can recount Thy wonders and God-befitting deed; for Thou hast adorned beyond measure the beauty of the heavenly hosts, praised by the fathers!

items.slavonic_text: вы · аг҃гло началници и наставници бесплотных ·
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shining with radiant beams, O Angels and Archangels, enlighten the whole inhabited world; therefore also I pray: enlighten my darkened soul by your prayers!

items.slavonic_text: єже єсть нашь на ползоу просите велиꙗ мл҃ть · іакоже
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In the flesh from thee, O holy one, the Son, Who is before the ages from the Father without mother, came for our sake in our image, Whom the bodiless hosts serve unceasingly, as [One] praised: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: сплотныи архистратизи : ~ Пѣ[снь] з҃ · ірм[осъ] Тебе мы
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible, by the beauty of piety shone purer than gold, saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn and exalt Him above all forever!

items.slavonic_text: сленꙋю бц҃е пещь разꙋмѣємъ вѣрнїи · іакоже бо
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Christ my Deliverer, Merciful One, deliver me who am held fast by the mist of sin and all passions, as I hymn Thee: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn and exalt Him above all!

items.slavonic_text: сп҃се трї ѡтрокы · прѣвъзносимыи и прѣѡбновле[ны]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou shalt come, O Christ, in glory to judge the world, number me among the standing of Thine elect, as I hymn and say: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: въ чрѣвѣ твѣ весь врꙋшенъ · въспѣваємъıи ѡц҃емъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Desiring to save the world, having proclaimed Christ unto thee, that thou shouldest be the Mother of Him Who made all things, Whom we hymn, O all-pure one, praising and exalting Him above all!

items.slavonic_text: б҃ъ и прѣпрославленъ : ~ Якы древле даниилъ
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, to the Bodiless Powers [Tone 1]:*[^261] The angelic hosts hymn Thee, as the Source of all good brings forth secondary lights by divine power without corruption, who receive the transcendent light, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: оукроти вь постомь · въ ѡроужи же сѧ добрыи
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The pre-eternal Mind and Creator, having super-essentially established the transcendent minds, drawing near unto Himself, is hymned: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: дѣломь · томоу оуподобне сѧ дше · рыкающаго въ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The choirs of light, the angelic hosts, were illumined with the rays of thrice-radiant beauty; we faithful, as is fitting, hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: сегда іако лва хотѧ поглотити ма · и къ б҃оу припа
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Him Who was begotten beyond word from the Father before the ages, incarnate ineffably, thou didst bear for us, O all-hymned Virgin, Whom we hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: дающи ла · бездѣлна ма хотѧ сътворити : ~ Бг҃о
items.english_text: *We praise, we bless, and we worship the Lord:*

items.slavonic_text: зарнїи ганїнци · просвѣтивше сѧ свѣто тр҃це прѣбога
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The angelic hosts hymn Thee, and the human race glorifies Thee, sacred servants, souls of the righteous, as Creator and Lord, throughout all ages!

items.slavonic_text: тыꙗ · тмоу мрачноую и лъстьнꙋю ѡмглоу , про
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* The burning bush revealed unconsumed the image of thy pure childbearing; and now we pray thee to quench the furnace of tribulations raging against us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: have mercy on me! For I have a soul that suffers distress from demonic assaults, and foolishly commits unrighteousness, not fearing Thy fear, O longsuffering Lord!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having already passed through the turbulent water of tribulations, O choirs of martyrs, and the bitter torment of that time, ye have reached the eternal havens of the wisdom...

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: ...of God, and the enjoyment of everlasting calm!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou bearest, O Lady, Him Who bears all things, and dost nurse Him Who gives food to all; great and awesome beyond understanding is thy mystery, O ark of the honorable sanctuary, Virgin Mother of God: therefore in faith we bless thee!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, the same [to the Bodiless Powers]:*[^262] Partakers of ineffable glory Thou hast made the bodiless minds, O Savior; and now, O Good One, preserve Thy people who with love run unto Thee, O Merciful One: and Thee, O Savior, we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Praising this with joy, instill in Thy church, O Master, the heavenly sweetness and beauty, and quietly grant good order, that we may unceasingly magnify Thee, O Savior!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Preserving Thy servants from on high, O Almighty One, preserve Thy flock in peace; Thou Who alone art peace and love, keeping our spiritual faith, and destroying every demonic power by Thy might!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The ranks of Angels, O pure one, also now unceasingly glorify thy childbearing, standing in their order, looking on with fear, filled with His greatness: thee they unceasingly magnify!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn [Photogogikon / Exapostilarion], Tone 1:* Archangels and Angels, Principalities, Powers, and Authorities, Thrones, many-eyed Cherubim and Seraphim, and six-winged living creatures: pray unto the Lord, that we may be delivered from tribulations and unquenchable fire!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art my protectress, O all-pure one, and a firm refuge; thou art the mediatress of the world, and falling down before thee I cry: deliver me from cruel evils, O thou who didst bear the Joy of the world...

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: ...and snatching from eternal fire those who hope in thee, O Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Repentance, Tone 1:*[^263]

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Behold what awaits thee, O my soul! For the day is about to expose thy secret evil deeds; therefore, see that thou canst not escape, and preventing it, cry aloud unto the Only One: O God, cleanse me as the publican, and save me!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved! I always promise to repent, yet I turn to worse things. Therefore I pray Thee, Who wast born of the Virgin: set me upright, O Lord, and have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* O all-praised martyrs, the earth did not hide you, but heaven received you; the gates of Paradise were opened unto you, and being within, enjoying the Tree of life, pray unto Christ, to grant unto our souls peace and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Joy of the heavenly ranks, and strong helper of men upon earth, O pure Virgin: save us who flee unto thee, for our hope after God, O Mother of God, have we placed in thee!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *On Monday, Beatitudes at the Hours, Tone 1:*

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* For the sake of food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross Christ led the thief into it: Remember me, crying in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Grant me fountains of compunction from Thy tender mercy, O Christ God; cleanse me from every evil defilement, and make me a partaker of Thy kingdom, O Good One!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Bringing the ranks of the Archangels unto prayer, O Savior, have compassion on us for their sake, as Thou art all-good, overlooking all our [sins]...

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: ...sins committed in knowledge and in ignorance!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* By the stream of your blood, O saints, ye manifestly drowned the noetic Pharaoh; and now ye pour forth streams of wonders, drying up the deep of infirmities: therefore ye are blessed!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Glory:* Let us worship the Father, and let us glorify the Son, and let us faithful hymn the all-holy Spirit, calling out and saying: O all-pure Trinity, consubstantial, save us!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Both now:* O thou who didst bear the unwaning Light, enlighten my soul darkened by the assaults of demons, O all-immaculate one, and free me from the coming fire by thy mediation!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon [Tone 4]: Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire (LXX Ps. 103:4). Verse: Bless the Lord, O my soul (LXX Ps. 103:1).*[^264]

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Epistle to the Hebrews [Heb. 2:2–10]:* Brethren, if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward, how shall we escape, if we neglect so great a salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard Him; God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with various miracles, and distributions of the Holy Spirit, according to His own will? For He did not put in subjection unto the angels the world to come, whereof we speak. But one in a certain place testified, saying: "What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that Thou visitest him? Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; Thou crownedst him with glory and honor, and didst set him over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet." For in that He put all in subjection under him, He left nothing that is not put under him. But now...

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: ...we see not yet all things put under him. But we see Jesus, Who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor; that He by the grace of God should taste death for every man. For it became Him, for Whom are all things, and by Whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the Captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Gospel according to John [sic! Matthew 13:24–30, 36–43]:*[^265] The Lord spoke unto His disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man who sowed good seed in his field; but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way. But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also. So the servants of the householder came and said unto him: "Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then does it have tares?" He said unto them: "An enemy has done this." The servants said unto him: "Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?" But he said: "Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them. Let both grow together until the harvest; and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers: Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn." And His disciples came unto Him, saying: "Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field." He answered and said unto them: "He Who sows the good seed is the Son of man; the field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; the enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers...

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: ...are the angels. As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world. The Son of man shall send forth His angels, and they shall gather out of His kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; and shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth. Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He that has ears to hear, let him hear."

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Communion Verse [Kinonikon]: Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire. Alleluia (LXX Ps. 103:4).*[^266]

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *On Monday Evening, Stichera at "Lord, I have cried", Tone 2.*

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Lament bitterly, O my soul, and repent of the many sins which thou hast committed in life; and implore the multitude of the heavenly [powers] with sighing and tears, that time for repentance may be granted thee, lest like the barren fig tree thou be cut down into the fire of Gehenna, O all-wretched one!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* I have not kept even a single commandment of Thine on earth; how shall I appear before Thee seated upon the throne, and give an account concerning all things which I have done in knowledge and in ignorance, O my Christ? Therefore I cry unto Thee: by the prayers of Thy ministers, save me, the prodigal!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* A morning ray running before the sun, thou didst appear as a luminary, O Baptist, enlightening the universe, healing infirmities, and driving away demons; therefore I pray thee: enlighten me also, the wretched one, with radiant beams, and disperse the mist of sin; for after God I have thee as a fervent protector and good refuge, O Baptist!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou art swift to help, and strong in tribulations, and a fervent protector, O all-pure Baptist, consolation of the sorrowful: deliver me who am held fast by many passions; for I have thee as hope and refuge; therefore enlighten me who am grievously darkened, and by thy prayers stir me up unto God!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* A tempest of sins evilly and the waves of life submerge me, tribulations and passions drown me; but by thy prayers guide me unto a calm haven, I pray thee, onto the path of repentance; deliver me from eternal fire and torment; when the Judge shall sit upon the judgment seat, pray unto Him, O holy one, that He may deliver me from all evils!

items.slavonic_text: идоша въспѣвающе хвалами · ѡц҃ь наших б҃е блг[ословен еси] : ~
items.english_text: *Glory, to the Forerunner, Tone 2, the same:* Be ever a protection and defense unto the sorrowful, O Forerunner of Christ, driving away tribulations and passionate sicknesses; therefore with compunction I cry unto thee, asking cleansing for mine innumerable offenses, whereby I have estranged myself from God; but by thy prayers, O holy Forerunner, reconcile me, asking forgiveness, and direct me onto the path of repentance!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal, O pure Mother of God, the sicknesses and wounds of my soul; for thou hast given birth to the Physician of passions and the Healer of our souls: pray Him to grant me remission of sins!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* I was conceived in iniquities, O Lord, as David I cry unto Thee; I lived upon earth and as a servant provoked the good God unto anger: leave me not to perish, O Savior, according to Thy love for mankind!

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having acquired Thee, O Christ Savior, as our fervent intercessor and mediator before all, we are saved from all tribulations, crying unto Thee in faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Cherubim glorify thee and the Seraphim sing praises unto thee; the Thrones, Dominions, and Powers ever extol thee, O Mary all-hymned; for thou alone hast given birth to God in the flesh: pray Him, O pure one, to save those who in love call thee blessed!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its actions by divine command, scorching the Chaldeans but refreshing the faithful: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Most radiant beam of the spiritual Sun, O herald and Forerunner of Christ, preaching repentance unto all the people, saying: Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens is at hand! Him all the works of the Lord hymn and supremely exalt!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With most radiant rays enlighten my darkened soul by thy prayer, O Forerunner of Christ; with prophets and apostles, pray unceasingly for us, that we may be delivered from sins and perils!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* My wretched soul has grown weak through the many assaults of the wicked adversary: heal it with remedies, O Virgin, and make me whole, that supremely exalting thee, I may hymn thee unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having become incarnate for the sake of tender mercy, Thou didst deify those bereft of understanding and enslaved by pleasures; but by Thy goodness, O Christ, turn and save all!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thou art the Good Shepherd, O Word: having sought and found the sheep that went astray upon the mountains through transgression, turn and save my wretched soul, and let not the deceitful enemy devour me,

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: woe is me, who have wrought much evil! Woe is me, who have provoked the all-good God to anger! O Baptist of Christ, help me; grant remission of my sins and release from my debts through thine intercession![^276]

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* That He might deify us, the Word became incarnate of thy pure blood, O Maiden, and became visible, O Mother of God: pray Him ever for those who honor thee!

items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Light-bearing in soul, shining brighter than snow, the holy youths were not burned in the midst of the flame, but calling all creation together with themselves unto the divine song, rejoicing they sang: All ye works of the Lord, sing ye!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* What are thy wonders and glorious mystery! Daughter of Adam and Mother of the Most High, who alone hast boldness toward God: thee do we worthily magnify!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* What are thy fearsome and glorious wonders, O Forerunner, heavenly citizen and angel in the flesh! Deliver my soul which is beset with sins, and enlighten it, that I thy servant may unceasingly praise thee, rejoicing!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Who can tell of thy marvelous greatness, that with thy hand thou didst touch the crown of the head of the Master of all, Who desired to wash away the defilements of all! Therefore now I pray thee: fervently intercede for us, and cleanse my defilements!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Great refuge of Christians and holy covering of thy protection, gladden us and fill us with joy, O pure one, that with unceasing praises

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* How fearsome is Thy judgment, O Lord, before which all must appear! In heedlessness, O Master, I have spent all my years; but turn me, O Christ, only Creator, even as Thou didst turn Manasseh who had sinned!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Ye were revealed as God-illumined stars, spiritually enlightening the whole inhabited earth, O prophets with the martyrs and hierarchs: therefore enlighten my soul, darkened by passions and afflictions, by your prayers!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Steadfast victors and chosen host, the sacred assembly of holy martyrs and blessed company with the choirs of bodiless angels: by their prayers, O Christ, make us partakers of Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With radiant rays from Him Who shone forth from thy womb upon us, Who dispersed the deep night of godlessness, O Virgin Mother Mary, enlighten those who honor thee in faith, and deliver us from the gloomy darkness, for we worthily magnify thee as the shrine of the God of Jacob, more honorable than the Cherubim!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Great is the glory which ye acquired through faith, O holy ones; for not only during your sufferings did ye conquer the enemy, but even after death ye drive away evil spirits and heal the sick, physicians of souls and bodies: pray unto the Lord that our souls may find mercy!

items.slavonic_text: тою оукрашена · и сп҃саєши вѣрою призывающаꙗ тѧ

items.english_text: *Epistle from the Acts of the Apostles [Acts 13:25–33]:* In those days, when John was finishing his course, he said: Whom think ye that I am? I am not He; but behold, there comes One after me, the strap of Whose sandals I am not worthy to unloose. Men, brethren, sons of the family of Abraham, and whosoever among you fears God, unto you is the word of this salvation sent. For they who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, having not understood Him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath day, have fulfilled them by condemning Him. And having found no cause of death in Him, they desired of Pilate that He should be slain. And when they had fulfilled all that was written of Him, they crucified Him; and taking Him down from the Tree, they laid Him in a tomb. But God raised Him from the dead; Who was seen for many days by those who came up with Him from Galilee unto Jerusalem, who are His witnesses unto the people. And we declare unto you the good tidings of the promise which was made unto the fathers, that God hath fulfilled the same unto their children, having raised up Jesus for us.

items.slavonic_text: каваꙗ бо дѣла стажахъ · мꙋже неискоуснаа
items.english_text: Brethren, Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman. But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise. Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from Mount Sinai, which genders to bondage, which is Hagar. For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children. But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all. For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.[^295] Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise. But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now. Nevertheless what saith

items.slavonic_text: каваꙗ бо дѣла стажахъ · мꙋже неискоуснаа
items.english_text: At that time, Jesus entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received Him into her house. And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard His word. But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to Him, and said, Lord, dost Thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me. And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: but one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her. And it came to pass, as He spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto Him, Blessed is the womb that bare Thee, and the paps which Thou hast sucked. But He said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
