items.english_text: *On Thursday, Canon to the Apostles on 4, and to Saint Nicholas on 4. Canon of the Apostles, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: пиюще: ты еси гора, от неяже неизреченно отсѣчеся
items.english_text: The choirs of Israel with unwet feet, traversing the deep of the Red Sea, and beholding the three-tiered captains, their enemies, drowned, sang with gladness: Let us sing unto our God, for He hath been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: камень, и врата адова съкруши:~ По .в. стїхолѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* By communion of the light of the immaterial Mind, O all-glorious fathers, spiritually enlightened, bright disciples, ye also enlighten the whole universe without deceit, destroying the deceptive darkness by the radiance of your preaching, O glorious Apostles!

items.slavonic_text: гїи сѣдаленъ гла[съ] .д. Вѣрѣ проповѣдникы, оученикы твоя,
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Having chosen for yourselves the fairest of all, the obedience of Christ, ye follow after Him in greatness of soul, pouring forth rays of light from Him most radiantly; by goodness have ye enlightened the world, O holy Apostles!

items.slavonic_text: Х[рист]е, всему мироу явилъ еси, наставляющи язы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He that is uncircumscribed in the bosom of the Father is bodily nourished in the bosom of a Mother; and after childbirth having preserved the pure Virgin beyond understanding, unto Him let us sing in harmony, unto our God, for He hath been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: кы къ б[о]горазумию твоему, лоучами б[о]гослове
items.english_text: *Another Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 1. Heirmos:* The mighty captains...[^300]

items.slavonic_text: сныими просвѣтившася, и тму невѣдѣнїя прогна
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Having inherited the sorrowless life, O blessed one, and ever enjoying spiritual joy, drive away all sorrow, I pray thee, from my soul, that with rejoicing I may glorify thee, O holy Father Nicholas!

items.slavonic_text: вше вѣрою, мл҃твами ихъ спаси душа наша:~ Свѣти
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* When the deep of corruptible life and every tribulation overflows, O father, those who ever run unto thee find a pilot; unto calm dost thou turn them, I see, O blessed one, by thy prayers!

items.slavonic_text: ла въ концы ученикы твоя, Х[рист]е, явилъ еси, сїяюще
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* With halting tongue and lips, I have come to offer small praise and supplication unto thy godlike greatness, O Nicholas; now, as a godlike giver, grant that the Savior and God be merciful unto me!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїе, просвѣщающе душа наша, и лесть и
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Possessing unsleeping prayer, O Pure One, lull to sleep our soulish passions by thy holy intercessions, and grant divine vigilance for the crushing of the devil!

items.slavonic_text: дольскоутѣлино потребивъ, оученїе бл҃гочестна
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* O Thou Who wast born of the Virgin, drown the three parts of my soul, I pray Thee, in the depth of dispassion, as of old the mighty captains, that in the mortification of the body, as upon a timbrel, I may sing unto Thee a triumphal song!

items.slavonic_text: просвѣтивше всего мира, тѣхъ мл҃твами спаси душа на
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: For the barren Church of the Gentiles hath borne many children, and the assembly of seven is grown feeble; let us sing unto our marvelous God: Holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Come, let us honor in songs and bless as disciples of Christ the stewards of understanding, who established the Church upon the faithful Rock!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Appearing as lightning unto the universe, O most glorious disciples, ye made it radiant, and drove away the deceitful darkness[^301]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: by the divine command!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Human minds cannot declare thy childbirth that is beyond understanding, O Virgin; for ineffably in thy womb hast thou conceived the Word of the primal Mind, O pure Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 3. Heirmos:* Not in wisdom...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Manifest a weapon cutting down adversary foes, and preserve us unharmed from their temptations, doing the will of God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* Heal the contriteness of my soul, O Hierarch Nicholas, and deliver me from the enemy's temptations and assaults, as the protector and defender of those who faithfully glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* Appearing visibly in dream, thou dost most gloriously deliver the youths from death, crying unto the emperor: Do not wrong the three men falsely accused through bitter envy!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee as protectress, O all-pure Virgin, have I acquired; deliver us from tribulation that brings forth death!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* Not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in riches do we boast, but in Thine hypostatic Wisdom, O Father, for there is none holy beyond Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: For the sake of the love of Thine image, O Merciful One, Thou didst stand upon Thy Cross, and the nations melted away; for Thou art our God, our strength and our praise!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Let us bless the all-wise Apostles, who instructed earthly men unto divine understanding, O divinely wise teachers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Lawgivers of piety, ye instruct men with understanding through faith; innocent disciples, ye were shown forth as all-praised; therefore we bless you!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Undefiled Virgin[^302]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: glory of Apostles, adornment of passion-bearers, with them pray that He may save us who faithfully praise thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 4. Heirmos:* He that sits in glory...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Thy glorious name everywhere we glorify through glorious divine miracles, O adornment and praise of hierarchs, who honor thee with joyful songs!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* O thou who dwellest in the heavens, rejoice, Nicholas! Invisibly in the midst of all that call upon thee, come and lighten the afflictions of our souls, and grant us calm!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* Everywhere thou gushest forth healings unto those running with faith to thee, and deliverest from plagues; therefore turn our sorrow into joy for thy servants, by thine acceptable prayers, O most glorious Nicholas!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic hosts marvel, O Pure One, at thy divine childbirth, and hymn and magnify it; with them, O Virgin, save those who magnify thee in faith!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* He that sits in glory...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: Send down enlightenment upon us, O Lord, and loose the vapour of sinful gloom, O Good One, and grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Branches of the living vine, mystically offering unto the faithful the clusters of divine sweetness: let us praise the Apostles, truly of God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Ever contending against the night of ignorance that envelopes all creation, O wise ones, bearing the radiant word, ye enlighten it and drive away the darkness!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unwedded Virgin, joy of angels, gladness of martyrs and apostles, unceasingly pray for us all, to save those who sing unto Christ[^303]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: our God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 5. Heirmos:* The ungodly shall not see Thy glory...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Having set like the sun, thou didst shine forth with the radiant rays of thy miracles, enlightening the whole world under the sun with wonders![^304]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* O Hierarch Nicholas, come unto us in the day of the onset of trials and sorrow, and comfort all our sufferings by the grace of the Spirit that dwells in thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* Nourisher of widows, and father of orphans, most excellent helper in afflictions, comfort of them that weep, shepherd and guide unto all that wander: O Nicholas, deliver us from tribulations by thy prayers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With noetic eyes the choir of the prophets, seeing the spiritual vision, cried unto us: Behold, Jesus God is about to be born of the Virgin Bride of God, for the renewal of men!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* The ungodly shall not see Thy glory, O Christ; but we, rising early at night, sing of Thee, the Only-Begotten, the Father's radiance of God's glory, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: Prefiguring the three-day burial, the Prophet Jonah prayed in the whale: Deliver me from corruption, O Jesus, King of powers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Having received in your hands the commandments of Christ, O all-wise ones, ye uprooted the thorns of unbelief and planted steadfast faith in the souls of the faithful!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* The Lord sends you forth in the midst of wolves as lambs, and thereby subjecting blasphemous deceit unto sheep-like meekness, O glorious Apostles

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Most Holy Mother of God, praise of Apostles and Martyrs, ineffable adornment of Prophets, with them pray, to deliver us from all affliction!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 6. Heirmos:* I came into the depths...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Strengthen us by thy power, O divinely wise one, that we may be able to destroy the visible enemy, from whose grievous harm deliver us by thy prayers, O Nicholas!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* From all oppression and violence and harm of evil men deliver us, by thy holy prayers, O most glorious Nicholas, deliver us!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* With noetic eye foreseeing things to come, thou fillest all ends of the earth with teachings; thou didst announce unto us the Son consubstantial with the Father, and didst abolish the fury of Arius, establishing thy venerable achievements as a pillar of the Orthodox faith!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thy people and city entreat thee, O Mother of God: deliver us from every temptation, O common Mother, all-pure Lady, and from eternal condemnation!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* I came into the depths of the sea, and a storm of many transgressions hath overwhelmed me; but descending as God, Thou hast brought up my soul, O Most Merciful One!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Apostles, Tone 2:* The steadfast and divinely-speaking preachers, the summit of Thy disciples, O Lord, Thou hast received into the enjoyment of Thy good things and repose; for Thou didst accept their labors and death above every whole burnt-offering, O Thou Who alone knowest the secrets of the heart!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: The children of Abraham of old in Babylon, trampling upon the flame of the furnace, rejoiced, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^305]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Having humbled the pride of the haughty enemy, ye cast it down, O Apostles of the Lord, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Instructed by Christ through the words of dispensation unto the holy mystery, ye taught the nations of grace, singing, O Apostles: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art the Orient of the noetic Sun, having appeared as Mother, and thou enlightenest all, O all-glorious Virgin Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 7. Heirmos:* Unto the youths...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Entreat the Creator of all, Who alone rests in the Saints, to cleanse us and to send forth His rich mercies!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* Righteous and meek, gentle and humble wast thou, O Father; and unto height wast thou most gloriously exalted, O Hierarch, working healings and miracles!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* Having delivered of old the military commanders from death, thou didst raise up their groaning to sing and glorify Christ the Savior with fervent faith, who cried aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having calmed the turmoil and passions of my soul by thy vigilant prayer, O Virgin, grant me peace, that I may glorify thee, O Lady!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* The three youths in Babylon, turning the tyrant's command into foolishness, standing in the midst of the flames, sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: Bless the Lord, all ye works of God and all creation; ye holy and humble of heart, sing and highly exalt Him!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* Appointed by God as teachers throughout the whole universe, O holy Apostles, ye utterly destroyed the prince of darkness and guided the people unto knowledge of God!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Mystically sounding as pipes the songs of the Lord, O wise ones, ye were revealed, sweetening the hearts of the faithful[^306]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: by the Spirit, highly exalting Christ unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O urn that contained the divine manna, O pure one, in songs we faithful cry: Rejoice, thou full of grace, Mother, praise of Apostles and Martyrs!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Unto the Redeemer...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Eloquently proclaiming divine things, O Nicholas, thou didst gloriously stop the mouths of the lawless, and deliver from the grievous malice of Arius, singing gloriously: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and sing!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* The order of Patriarchs and Apostles, the assembly of Hieromartyrs, and the choir of Prophets, the whole Christian multitude, bless thy divine life; therefore we also cry aloud with thee, praising: Bless the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion (Holy Trinity):* In Orthodox manner let us worship the undivided Trinity, crying unto the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and highly exalt Him!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Make me worthy of thy mercy, O Mother that didst bear God, blessed and pure one, in the day of judgment; protect and deliver me from condemnation, O most holy protectress, that we may praise and bless thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* O almighty Redeemer of all, having descended into the midst of the flame, Thou didst refresh them that believed, and taught them to sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and highly exalt Him!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Canon of the Apostles. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: Thy childbirth was revealed as incorrupt: God came forth from thy womb, appearing in the flesh, and dwelt on earth with men; therefore, O Mother of God, we all magnify thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Apostles):* In the midst of the judgment-seat ye boldly proclaimed God, O wise Apostles, trampling down godless deception; and as gracious victors, ye were revealed glorious upon earth[^307]

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Truly beautiful were the feet of the holy Apostles, scribes of peace unto all the world, richly proclaiming good tidings, whom unceasingly we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having come forth from the Father's bosom, the Word was received in thy womb without seed, O Virgin; Him the assembly of Apostles and Martyrs sing, and in the Spirit unceasingly we magnify thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 9. Heirmos:* Eve indeed by the disease of disobedience...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Saint Nicholas):* Ever doth the shrine of thy grace, O venerable one, pour forth healings unto the faithful who come with love; O Nicholas, thou deliverest from every disease and temptation; therefore we all bless thee!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Saint Nicholas):* Meditating upon the dread day and hour, O my soul, when thou must come unto the judgment to be judged according to secret deeds, cry unto the Savior: Save me by the prayers of Nicholas, Thy favored servant!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Saint Nicholas):* Let all the ends of the earth unceasingly sing in hymns, adorning the head of Nicholas with crowns of praise, as the favored servant of Christ our God, by whose prayers we are delivered from afflictions!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Bringing unto thee the divine voice, Gabriel joyfully cries aloud with it unto thee: Rejoice, thou that hast in the midst the paradise Tree of Life! Rejoice, noetic palace! Rejoice, O undefiled Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* It is truly meet... More honorable than the Cherubim...

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Exaposteilarion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Women, give ear" (Жены услышите):*

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: Peter and Paul, Andrew and James, Bartholomew and Matthew, James and Philip, and Thomas, and Simon, Luke, John, and Mark, all the Apostles of the Lord, let us praise in faith!

items.slavonic_text: ша:~ М[уче]ници твои, Г[оспод]и, въ страданїи своемъ вѣнца прїя
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Unwedded Virgin, unceasingly entreat Christ with them[^308]

items.slavonic_text: и мѫдрыи апли· не сь единожествꙋ дтинкъ· ис нико
items.english_text: ...and the wise Apostles, together with the choir of the disciples, and with wise Nicholas, to deliver from all tribulations those who have placed their hope in thee, O Maiden!

items.slavonic_text: лою мѫдры· въ сѣкых бѣдъ избавити· иже на тѧ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: тиль еси· и пѫть скврънꙋ грѣховнѫ ѿбѣдно мын
items.english_text: *Tone 4. Aposticha Sticheron 1 (Apostles):* The apostolic choir Thou hast enlightened by the Holy Spirit; and having [cleansed] the sinful defilement... grant [merciful healing], O Good One!

items.slavonic_text: х҃е· ꙗко свѣтлїи облаци· и звѣзды неблазньнїи·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Apostles):* The apostolic choir, Thy disciples, O Christ, like radiant clouds and unbeguiled stars, enlightened the universe with teaching and proclaimed the Trinity, teaching the faith of Paul: having lived soberly and godly of old, let us cast away all deceit of idols and ungodliness, as it is written!

items.slavonic_text: вселенѫ просвѣтиша оученїемь· трцу пропо
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord; for by sword and fire, and with contrite soul, they poured forth their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; they endured and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: вѣдаша· оучаще павлози вѣрѣ· давни поживше
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O rekindling of the extinguished, O righteous throne, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, merciful salvation of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: цѣломѫдрено и блговѣрно· ѡвръземь вськыѧ
items.english_text: *On Thursday at the Liturgy, the Beatitudes, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: льсти їдолскыѧ, и нечтьстна· ꙗкоже ес писано:~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Beatitudes):* Because of the tree Adam was banished from Paradise, but through the tree of the Cross the thief took up his dwelling in Paradise. For the one, having tasted, [transgressed] the commandment of Him that made him; while the other, crucified together with Thee, confessed Thee, the hidden God: Remember me, O Savior![^309]

items.slavonic_text: Чт҃на ес съмрть стых твоих гн, мечемь бо и ѡгнемь·
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Apostles):* Being spiritual sheep of the Shepherd and the Lamb, sent forth in the midst of wolves, ye were wise messengers by divine preaching, turning their fierceness into meekness...

items.slavonic_text: идшею съкрꙋшенном· пролиѧша кровь свою· оу
items.english_text: ...calling out with unswerving mind: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: пованіемь маще на тѧ, приꙗти трꙋдомь мьздꙋ·
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Apostles):* Having traversed the ends of the earth, O disciples of the Savior, like radiant stars ye dispersed the gloom of deceit, and enlightened with the light of the universe those that were deceived; therefore we call you blessed, praying, O preachers of Christ: Entreat the Lord in our behalf!

items.slavonic_text: притръпѣша и приꙗша ѿ тебе спсе велиѧ млть:~
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Crushed by torments and scorched by material fire, ye burned up bitter, skin-flaying deceit, O blessed ones; and now ye pour forth streams of healings unto those who approach you with faith, warmly crying and shouting unto Christ: Remember us!

items.slavonic_text: Свѣщенїе оугасшаѧ· прѣстоле праведныи· прѣ
items.english_text: *Trinity:* The Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit in one accord let us glorify, worthily praying unto the Unity of the Godhead in three Persons, abiding unconfused, simple, undivided, and unapproachable, through Whom we have been delivered from torment!

items.slavonic_text: чистаѧ влчце млноспсенїи д҃шь наших:~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Joy of the Angels and unfading crown of the passion-bearers, in truth thou art the Mother of God, only undefiled one; on these days ask for us deliverance from sins, who in faith sing to thee and cry aloud: Rejoice, O Mother of our Life!

items.slavonic_text: Дрѣва ради адамь· раꙗ выинъ селень· дрѣвом же крⷭ҇тны<sup>м</sup>
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon: Their proclamation hath gone out into all the earth (LXX Ps. 18:5). Verse: The heavens declare the glory of God (LXX Ps. 18:2).*

items.slavonic_text: разбоиникь в раи всели сѧ· ѡвь оубо вкꙋшь заповѣд
items.english_text: Brethren: God hath displayed us, the apostles, last, as it were appointed unto death; for we have been made a spectacle unto the world, both to angels and to men. We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak,[^310]

items.slavonic_text: непрестꙋпне сътворьшаго и· а дрꙋгыи не съраспинаемь
items.english_text: ...but ye are strong; ye are honorable, but we are despised. Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwelling-place; and labor, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we endure it; being defamed, we entreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day. I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved children I warn you. For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the Gospel. Therefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.

items.slavonic_text: б҃а тѧ жь щаи сповѣдатаѧща· помѣни мѧ спсе:~
items.english_text: *Alleluia: The heavens declare the glory of God (LXX Ps. 18:2). Verse: Into all the earth (LXX Ps. 18:5).*

items.slavonic_text: Пастырѧ и агньца· словесныѧ жь щи ѡвца· посредѣ
items.english_text: At that time: Jesus called unto Him His disciples, and gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease. These Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying: Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. And as ye go, preach, saying: The kingdom of heaven is at hand. Heal the sick, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

items.slavonic_text: влъкъв ѿ пето· ꙗко мѫдрїи посланникы бысте· бжтвны
items.english_text: *Kinonikon: Their proclamation hath gone out into all the earth (LXX Ps. 18:5).*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *On Thursday evening, suppliant Stichera: 3 to the Cross, and 3 to the Theotokos, Tone 6.*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...whereby corruption was abolished and brought to naught, and the power of death was swallowed up, and we were raised from earth unto heaven; invincible weapon, adversary of demons, glory of Martyrs, truly fair confirmation of the Monastics, haven of salvation, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Cross):* Rejoice, O Cross of the Lord, whereby the curse of mankind was loosed, sign of joy unto them that exist, driving away foes by thine elevation, O all-honored helper unto us, might of kings, helper of the righteous, beauty of priests, delivering from severe misfortunes; rod wherewith we are shepherded, weapon of defense in fear, about which the Angels stand: divine glory of the Cross, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Cross):* Rejoice, O Cross of Christ, guide of the blind, and physician of the infirm, resurrection of all the dead, who hast raised us up who fell into corruption; O precious Cross, whereby the curse was destroyed and incorruption blossomed, whereby we mortals were deified and the devil was utterly cast down! Today beholding thee lifted up on high by the hands of the hierarch, we exalt Him that was lifted up upon thee, and Him we worship, drawing forth rich and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Theotokos):* Burdened with transgressions and tempest-tossed by thoughts, we fall down before thy love for mankind, O Sovereign Lady,[^312]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...receive the genuflection, the uplifting of hands, the cries and sobbing of the heart, and tears from our eyes; have mercy, as Mother of the Merciful One, and grant help, O Mother of God, all-undefiled Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Theotokos):* Turn not away from my mouth, cast me not away from thy face, who hope in thee, O all-pure Mother of God! Whither shall I go except unto thee to find salvation? Or who will deliver me from eternal fire except thee, O Sovereign Lady? Pray therefore unto thy Son, O all-undefiled helper!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3 (Theotokos):* The deep of thy love for mankind, the abyss of goodness of thy compassions, and thine innumerable bounties, show forth, O All-pure One, upon me, the wretched; quell the sinful passions, grant me chastity, and keep me unharmed in soul and body, O all-undefiled Sovereign Lady!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee hanged upon the Tree, O Christ, She that gave Thee birth cried aloud: What strange mystery is this which I behold, O Son? How dost Thou die upon the Tree, hanged in the flesh, O Life of all?

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *At the Stichologia, Prokeimenon: My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth (LXX Ps. 120:2). Verse: I lifted up mine eyes unto the hills (LXX Ps. 120:1).*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1 (Cross):* Thy Cross, O Lord, hath become life and protection unto Thy people; trusting in it, we sing unto Thee, our crucified God: Have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2 (Cross):* Sheltered by the Cross, we set ourselves against the enemy, not fearing his wiles and assaults; for his pride was abolished, and he was trampled down by the power of Christ crucified upon the Tree!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Thy Martyrs, O Lord, denied Thee not, nor departed from...[^313]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...Thy commandments; by their prayers have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* And no one that runs unto thee goes away from thee confounded, O most holy Mother of God; but whoever asks for grace receives gifts profitable unto his petition!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion (Cross):* Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance, granting victories unto our princes over the barbarians, and by Thy Cross preserving Thy people!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Glory, both now, Stavrotheotokion:* Having acquired thy protection, O All-pure One, and being delivered from tribulations by thy prayers, preserved everywhere by the Cross of thy Son, as is due we all piously magnify thee!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *After the First Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, 3, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1 (Cross):* Today the prophetic word is fulfilled; for behold, we worship in the place where Thy feet stood, O Lord; and having received the Tree of salvation, we obtained freedom from sinful death, by the prayers of the Mother of God, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2 (Cross):* Thy Cross, O Lord, was made radiant; for by it healings are bestowed upon them that revere Thee; therefore we fall down before Thee: Have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, the all-pure Maiden who bore Thee was pierced through the soul with the sword of sorrow, and wept, sobbing maternally; by her prayers have mercy on us, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *After the Second Stichology, Sessional Hymns, 3, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 1 (Cross):* Barely was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, and the foundation of death was shaken, O Lord; for whom hades had swallowed with longing, it released trembling, and revealed unto us His salvation, O Holy One; we glorify Thee,[^314]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...O Son of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn 2 (Cross):* The Jews condemned Thee unto death, O Lord, the Life of all; they that crossed the Red Sea with the rod nailed Thee upon the Cross, and they that sucked honey from the rock brought Thee gall; but of Thine own will Thou didst endure, that Thou mightest free us from the slavery of the enemy: O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* In the memory of Thy saints, O Lord, all creation keeps festival; the heavens with the Angels rejoice, and the earth makes glad with men; by their prayers have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee hanged, O Christ, She that bore Thee cried aloud: What is this strange mystery which in mind I behold, O Son? How dost Thou die in the flesh upon the Tree, hanged, O Life of all?

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *On Friday, Canon to the Cross and to the Mother of God, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* He Who of old covered the pursuing tyrant with the surge of the sea, the children of the saved buried beneath the earth; but let us, as the handmaidens, sing unto the Lord, for gloriously hath He been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* By Thy Passion Thou hast honored dishonored human nature; therefore with fear we honor Thee, and we magnify Thy dominion, for gloriously hath He been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* By Thy blood, O Christ, Thou hast stayed deceitful and unjust blood, and hast cleansed human nature from all malice; therefore, O Savior, we glorify Thy Sufferings, for gloriously hath He been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* The blood-drinking beasts ye truly conquered, O all-praised Martyrs, and the threatening of the fire ye quenched by the dew of God's grace![^315]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos: A helper and protector...*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* The overshadowed mountain, the Prophet Habakkuk foresaw in the Spirit; praying, O pure one, visit me shaken by passions, and from the net of death and troubling evils deliver me!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* By the sprinkling of the divine blood poured forth from Thy Son, wash away my heart's wounds, that I may magnify thee, and as is due glorify thee, the ever-blessed and undefiled one!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Equal in action to Him that begot Him, thou didst bear the Word Who deified human essence; pray unto Him for me who fall through lack of understanding and grow faint through the enemy's wiles, granting me divine comfort!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* He that of old fashioned our foremother from the rib, clothed Himself in flesh from thine all-pure womb, whereby He destroyed the might of death!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* A helper and protector was He unto me for salvation: this is my God, and I will glorify Him; the God of my father, and I will exalt Him, for gloriously hath He been glorified!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Thee, Who didst hang the whole earth unheld upon the waters, the creation beholding suspended upon Calvary was seized with terror, crying: There is none holy save Thee, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Thee, Who didst hang the whole earth unheld upon the waters, raised upon the Tree and having Thy side pierced, the sun beholding was darkened, knowing Thee as enlightenment unto all the ends of the earth, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* Thou wast pierced in the side, O Lord, and by nails...[^316]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...transfixed, O Long-suffering One; and Adam, wounded of old, was healed by Thy being wounded; therefore we faithful found healing for our wounds!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* When the angelic hosts beheld the Martyrs slain for the Lamb and being cut limb from limb, they marveled how, being in the body, they conquered the incorporeal foes; and the passion-bearers received the crowns of victory!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 3. Heirmos: By Thee, O Christ, the heavens are established...*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* Him Who is infinite in mercy and rich in bounties, God Who is merciful, O All-pure One, beseech to have mercy upon us afflicted!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* Being the house of the Creator of the ages, make glad to pray in intercession unto the Comforter for him that was in the cave of soul-destroying passions, O pure Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Bearing in thine arms, O Mother of God, Him that fed the people of God with manna, by His nod deliver me, who have nodded towards evil passions!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* Beholding God incarnate of thee, O Mother of God, the angelic ranks marveled with fear; as Mother of God unceasingly we glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* By Thee, O Christ, all the heavens are established, O Word of God and Power: they declare Thine ineffable glory, the work of Thine all-creating hand; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Foreseeing Thy divine dispensation upon the Cross, Habakkuk cried out in terror: Thou, O Good One, hast cut down the might of the strong, promising to hades as Almighty!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Having stretched out Thy hands, O Lord, the net of the enemy did not hold...[^317]

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: ...unto the tree of food; Thou didst stretch out Thy hands upon the Tree, and from Thy side Thou didst gush forth forgiveness unto all!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* Thou didst endure suffering, O Blessed One, and hast freed us from shameful passions; Thou didst taste gall, O sweetness of the Church, and hast given life unto the dead!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Having received the beloved divine fire in your rational soul, O wise ones, ye quenched the fire of godlessness; shining forth as Christ's archers, ye were shown forth radiant!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Mother of God. Ode 4. Heirmos: The Prophet having heard...*

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* Beyond word thou didst bear the Word of the Father, Who looses the irrationality of men; entreat Him diligently, O only Virgin, to set free him that is enslaved to irrational passions!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* Thou gushest forth healings unto us from thy palms, sanctifying the temples unto all men, shining and filling them with sweet-smelling myrrh, O all-pure Bride of God!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* We sing of thee, O all-pure and undefiled Virgin, for through thee we found salvation; singing, we cry aloud: Blessed art thou, who didst bear God in the flesh for us!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* Thou didst bear for us the unwaning Light, O Virgin, shining in the flesh upon them that are in darkness, O pure one; singing to thee, [we cry]: Rejoice, O ever-virgin!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* The Prophet, having heard of Thy coming, O Lord, was afraid that Thou shouldst be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I have heard Thy report, and was afraid; glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: проповѣданїемь· тѣ претварающе скверѣпьство на кротовы
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Thy manifestation, O Christ, which mercifully came to pass toward us, Isaiah beholding as the unwaning Light, rising early from the night [cried aloud]...[^318]

items.slavonic_text: ваше· въскрсноутъ мртвїи· и въстаноутъ иже въ
items.english_text: ...[cried aloud]: The dead shall rise, and they that are in the tombs shall stand up, and all they that are upon the earth shall rejoice!

items.slavonic_text: гробѣхъ, и вси иже на земли възрадоуют сѧ:~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Dead didst Thou appear on Calvary, free among the dead wast Thou seen; and through Thy bodily Passion, Thou hadst neither form nor beauty seen upon the Tree, O Christ, desiring to adorn mankind, O Thou Who art abundantly merciful!

items.slavonic_text: Мртвъ ꙗви сѧ на краніевѣ· въ мртвы свободь ꙗ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* To deliver first-fashioned Adam from condemnation, O Lord, Thou wast nailed to the Cross with nails, and pierced in the side with a spear: Thou didst forbid the flaming weapon to bar the gates of Eden!

items.slavonic_text: ви сѧ· и стрⷭ҇тью плътьскою· ни зрака х҃е ни доброты
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Following the Passion of the Master, the choirs of martyrs, being nailed upon the tree, lift up their hands together; and their feet are stretched out for torments, guided along divine paths!

items.slavonic_text: ймаши видѣлъ на дрѣвѣ, оудобрити хотѧ чл҃чь
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Ode 5. Heirmos: Rising early from the night...*

items.slavonic_text: вити ѡсоуженїа гн, гвоздьми на крⷭ҇тѣ пригвозди
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* Shining brightly in purity, thou becamest the receptacle of God, O all-hymned one; for thou alone wast shown forth unto the Merciful One, bearing Him in thine arms as an Infant!

items.slavonic_text: сѧ· и в ребра прободенъ быⷭ҇ копїемь· пламенномꙋ
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* Thou bearest noetic beauty, all-comely in soul; thou becamest the Bride of God, sealed with pure virginity, and enlightened with divine light!

items.slavonic_text: ѡроужїю запрѣтилъ еси· не бранити врать едемь
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Transform my bodily sicknesses and the diseases of my soul, and drive away the clouds of sloth, O Virgin, robe of Light, granting health and healing unto me who sing, who faithfully glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: Послѣдоующе страсти владычнѣи· мч҃нч
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* Enlighten my darkened mind and soul, O Virgin, and make me a partaker of divine understanding; for behold, I am filled with evils, and have become enslaved unto passions of every kind...[^319]

items.slavonic_text: стии лицїи· на дрѣвѣ пригвождаеми· и роукы
items.english_text: ...and bring unto thee an undefiled bride!

items.slavonic_text: коупно въздежть· ногы же на ꙗсть за мꙋченїа
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* Rising early from the night, enlighten us, we pray, and guide us in Thy commandments, and teach us, O Savior, to do Thy will!

items.slavonic_text: В чистотѣ сиѧюще свѣтло· бж҃їе прїателище бы
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Jonah was seized, but not held fast in the belly of the whale; bearing the image of Thee Who didst suffer and wast given over to burial, he came forth from the monster as from a bridal chamber, and cried out unto the watch: Ye that observe vanity and lies have forsaken your own mercy!

items.slavonic_text: прѣпѣтаа· ты бо едина ꙗви сѧ мл҃тнеоу· на роукоу
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Stretching out Thy hands of old in the image of the Cross, as on a pillar the Most High appeared unto us, delivering mankind from the ancient curse; Thou didst pour forth life and incorruption: Thee, O Savior, the only Creator, we glorify!

items.slavonic_text: тꙋ мысленую· прѣкрасна дшею· невѣста бы бж҃їа
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* Great Moses prefigured Thy Passion, lifting up the brazen serpent of old; and they that looked upon the sign of the venomous foe [bitten] by wounding gnawings, because the Master was crucified voluntarily, Thou by Thy goodness hast delivered us from the wounded harm!

items.slavonic_text: запечатлѣнна чисты дв҃ьство· и свѣто бж҃твъ
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Sheltered by the Cross, O archers, ye pulled down the deceitful walls, and removed unto the city on high, adorned with a victorious crown; therefore we call you blessed!

items.slavonic_text: ша моѧ недꙋгы прѣтвори· и лѣностныѧ ѡбла
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Ode 6. Heirmos: The lowest abyss...*

items.slavonic_text: кы прожени д҃во· свѣта ѡблаченїе зравїе вѣ· и зцѣ
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* Great Moses among the Prophets prefigured thee: ark and table, lampstand and vessel of manna, symbolically revealing the incarnation of the Most High Who is of thee, O Virgin Mother!

items.slavonic_text: лоу подающи ми поюще· вѣрно тѧ славящомоу:~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* The law grew weak and the shadow passed away...[^320]

items.slavonic_text: Остноу мысль мои и дш҃ю д҃во просвѣтиствоуи· бж҃е
items.english_text: ...beyond mind and thought; the revealed grace prefigured thy childbearing, O Virgin, of God the Savior, O all-hymned Bride!

items.slavonic_text: ствьнаго разоума причастника сътвори· се бо зо
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* I surpassed the proud, exalted mind of the Pharisee, ever rushing into the valleys of countless falls; do thou alone, O pure one, have compassion on me!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* O marvelous conception and maidenly birth-giving, show forth thy mercy unto me in a strange land, conceived in iniquities and born into slavery to passions!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* The lowest abyss of sins hath surrounded me, and unable to endure its billows, like Jonah I cry aloud unto the Master: Lead me up from corruption!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* An ineffable wonder: He that delivered the holy children from the flame in the furnace, is laid breathless in a new tomb, for the salvation of us who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* When the Hebrew council condemned Thee upon the Cross, the earth, beholding Thee, was terrified; the sun hid its light, and the saints in darkness, seeing it, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* Enduring reviling, O Savior, beaten with a reed and crowned with thorns like a king of Thine own will, O Christ God...[^321]

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: ...for the salvation of us who sing to Thee: Blessed art Thou, O our Deliverer!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Binding all day long the malice [of the tyrants], O all-lauded ones, ye endured rivers of wounds and unjust deaths, desiring the life on high, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God our Deliverer!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Ode 7. Heirmos: Destructive darkness...*

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* Thou wast shown forth as the resting place of the divine nature, thou alone blessed one; for God Who sits upon the shoulders of the Cherubim, thou didst bear in thine arms, crying: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* The judgment is at the doors, ready for the judge; be ready, O my wretched soul! Cry aloud when He judges: Condemn me not, for the sake of her that bare Thee!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Encompassed by the fruits of sin, I have been deadened; bringing a barren soul, I cry unto thee: Show me fruitful, who have destroyed the fruit of my prayer!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* Having heard the song of the holy children in the fiery furnace, Thou didst cool the flame, O Savior: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Heirmos:* Be astonished and fear, O heaven, and let the foundations of the earth be shaken! For behold, He Who dwells in the highest is numbered among the dead, and takes up His abode in a small tomb: ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Thou drinkest the cup, O Christ, which in gall [Thou wast offered] in the Passion on the Cross; Thou pourest forth forgiveness from Thy life-bearing side unto those deadened through the rib [of Adam], crying and singing: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* When the lawless people condemned Thee unto crucifixion in the midst of the tribunal, O Jesus, then the earth was shaken, and all creation cried aloud with fear: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing; and supremely exalt Him...[^322]

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: ...throughout all ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Precious before the Lord was your death shown forth, O martyrs of Christ; partakers of many sufferings were ye, and partakers of the passionless counsel were ye shown to be: pray for us who faithfully sing of you!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Ode 8. Heirmos: Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify...*

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* By the union of the Word with the clay of man, a divine resting place wast thou shown forth, O all-pure one, making radiant the brightness of the Godhead unto me, Christ Whom we supremely exalt unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* The golden-beaming lampstand prefigured thee; having received the ineffable, unapproachable Light, with light thou dost illuminate all things, Christ Whom we supremely exalt unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Being full of every good, and near unto the King, O Mother of God, fill me with good deeds, who have lived with malice and corrupted my whole life with sloth, that I may glorify thee unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* Thou wast found clothed in a comely robe through bearing God, O Mother of God; but I, working malice, am stripped of it; but do thou thyself enlighten me with divine vestments through repentance, by thine intercessions, O Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* We praise, we bless, and we worship the Lord. Him Whom the heavenly hosts glorify, and before Whom the Cherubim and Seraphim tremble, let every breath and all creation sing, bless, and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Weep not for Me, O Mother, beholding in the tomb...*[^323]

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: ...the Son Whom thou didst conceive in the flesh without seed; for I shall arise and be glorified, and as God I shall unceasingly exalt in glory them that magnify thee with faith and love!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Cross):* Through corruptible food and ancient pleasure, O only Savior, as Good One and Deliverer Thou didst heal us: Thou wast crucified voluntarily and didst deign to be dead; unceasingly we sing, O Christ, of Thy great compassion!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Cross):* How didst Thou endure pains upon the Cross when Thou wast crucified, and hast delivered us from grievous pains, O Christ! How wast Thou crowned with thorns, rooting out all the thorns of passions! Having tasted vinegar and gall, Thou hast filled for us the cup of sweetness!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Martyricon:* Being bound, O holy ones, and cast into prison, and cruelly dismembered limb by limb, bound unto wheels, and given as food unto wild beasts, ye did not deny Christ, the Master of all!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Ode 9. Heirmos: He that [bore] joy...*

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 1 (Theotokos):* The Star shining with rays of the Godhead out of Jacob shone forth upon them that were held in darkness, through thee now, O all-pure one: Christ God, the incarnate Word, by Whom being enlightened, with songs we unceasingly magnify thee!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 2 (Theotokos):* Strengthened by thy power and goodness, unto thee we send up song without ceasing; do thou accept this, O pure one, repaying with thy radiant grace from incorruptible treasures, O full of the grace of God!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 3 (Theotokos):* Corrupted by fornication, and corrupted in soul, a bride defiled by malice, and stripped of all good things, shown forth, O incorrupt Virgin: O undefiled one, despise me not, but adorn me...[^324]

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: ...with good deeds!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Troparion 4 (Theotokos):* May I be delivered by thine intercessions, O undefiled Virgin, from every wrath, and death-bearing passions, and the cruel race of fire, and from unrighteous men, and from cruel enemies: fleeing under thy shelter, I call upon thee for help!

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: *Katavasia: That which was from Jacob... More honorable than the Cherubim.*

items.english_text: *Epistle to the Corinthians (1 Cor. 1:18–24):*

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: Brethren: The preaching of the Cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God. For it is written: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent. Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the disputer of this world? Hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world? For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe. For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom: but we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness; but unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.[^326]

items.slavonic_text: лѣ исплъних сѧ· и сластемь поработих сѧ· вся
items.english_text: The Lord said: No man hath ascended up to heaven, but He that came down from heaven, even the Son of Man which is in heaven. And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up: that whosoever believs in Him should not perish, but have eternal life. For God so loved the world, that He gave His only-begotten Son, that whosoever believs in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life. For God sent not His Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through Him might be saved.

And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun. And they said among themselves: Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre? And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great. And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted. And he says unto them: Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, Who was crucified: He is risen; He is not here: behold the place where they laid Him. But go your way, tell His disciples and Peter that He goes before you into Galilee: there shall ye see Him, as He said unto you. items.english_text: *Fifth Matins Resurrection Gospel, from Luke [Luke 24:12–35]:* At that time, then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass. And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. And they talked together of all these things which had happened. And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus Himself drew near, and went with them. But their eyes were holden that they should not know Him. And He said unto them: What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad? And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto Him: Art Thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days? And He said unto them: What things? And they said unto Him: Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, Which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and have crucified Him. But we trusted that it had been He which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done. Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre; and when they found not His body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels...[^348]

items.english_text: ...which said that He was alive. And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but Him they saw not. And He said unto them: O foolish men, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken! Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into His glory? And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning Himself. And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and He made as though He would go further. But they constrained Him, saying: Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is already far spent. And He went in to tarry with them. And it came to pass, as He sat at meat with them, He took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him; and He became invisible unto them. And they said one to another: Did not our heart burn within us, while He talked with us by the way, and while He expounded unto us the scriptures? And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them, saying: The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon! And they told what things were done in the way, and how He was known of them in breaking of bread.

items.english_text: *Eighth Matins Resurrection Gospel, from John [John 20:11–18]:* At that time, Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre, and saw two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain. And they said unto her: Woman, why weepest thou? and whom seekest thou? She said unto them: Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid Him. And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus. Jesus said unto her: Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said unto Him: Sir, if Thou have borne Him hence, tell me where Thou hast laid Him, and I will take Him away. Jesus said unto her: Mary. She turned herself, and said unto Him: Rabboni; which is to say, Master. Jesus said unto her: Touch Me not; for I am not yet ascended to My Father: but go to My brethren, and say unto them: I ascend unto My Father, and your Father; and to My God, and your God. Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that He had spoken these things unto her.

items.english_text: Consider, brethren, and shudder in fear, O men! For we are about to give an accounting at the last, on the dreadful Day of Judgment. We shall stand compunctious and downcast, condemned by our evil deeds which we committed in this life, which it befits not Christians to commit—these evil deeds from which we renounced ourselves at baptism, saying: "We renounce Satan and all his works." Therefore let us abide in God and before the angels of God, having cast away from ourselves all evil and unfitting things, and acting in fear, in meekness, and in divine love. Yea, brethren, let us all weep for ourselves, and mourn, and sigh deeply, that we may be preserved from the burning river of fire!
