items.english_text: O woe unto those that are sluggish to go into the holy church on the holy Sunday of the Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto those that mock church ministers and customs!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto the disobedient and wrathful, for he is as one possessed, and a ruined dwelling!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto those that swear by the hierarchs or monks, for he that swears by the saints swears by the church of God!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto the priest that eats and drinks early, before the sixth hour!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto him that judges another, whatsoever it may be, and cares not for his own sins!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto those that shut their gates against the poor!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto those that despise the poor, and strangers, and the destitute, and, to speak plainly:

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto those that have not mercy and have not the fear of God in their heart!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto that priest who cares not for his spiritual children and concerning their sins: a grievous accounting awaits him at the Dread Judgment!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: O woe unto every Christian that gets drunk, for he is not worthy before God and men, but only for the devil!...[^367]

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: ...O woe unto every man who in his life cares not for his soul! Yea, brethren, with sighing and from the heart let us weep over our perdition and our weakness: alas for wretched me, how shall I not weep over it with my defiled lips!

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: *Woe is me!* Woe is me, a sinner and wretched! What awaitest thou, O accursed soul, full of all filth? How wilt thou answer the Judge? Where wilt thou hide thine iniquitous deeds?

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: *Woe is me, a sinner and wretched!* How am I humble in opinion, but always there is boldness, and there is no submission, but always pride; and there is no fasting, neither prostrations; unmerciful, unclean, having neither faith nor uprightness, neither mercy nor love! How then, O soul, dost thou desire to obtain mercy, seeing that thou art full of all evil?

items.slavonic_text: прослави б҃а • и сиа рече • гла емоу иди по мнѣ • ѡбращь
items.english_text: Woe is me! what I shall do, I know not. Seeing men fasting unto God and bowing down, and doing works of mercy, and walking in meekness and knowingly in the fear of God—I did not perceive, and through my weakness saw not; and seeing their self-restraint, I did not emulate them, but turned away from them unto evil and destruction, and reviled all the servants of God with a deceitful tongue and an evil heart! How then do I desire to be saved? Seeing men who are weak, I lent an ear to them, and loved them with my heart...[^368]

items.slavonic_text: и пристахъ к нимь на злое и на пагоубоу доуши моеи •
items.english_text: ...and I joined myself unto them unto evil and unto the perdition of my soul!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡхъ мнѣ небогоу • да тѣлоу оугодное сътворихъ •
items.english_text: Oh, woe is me, wretched one! for I did what was pleasing to the flesh by mine evil deeds, by unfaithfulness and greediness, and I myself drown my soul in eternal torment! Oh, woe is me, O soul: amend thyself at least from henceforth! Oh, woe is me, wretched one: how was I deprived of honor, and of what kind of glory, what brightness was I willing to lose through mine own lack of fear! Why, O soul, dost thou not give ear to the instruction of the Lord and of the holy venerable fathers, but ever turnest aside unto evil? Oh, O soul, hast thou heard the bitter answer, saying: "It is not good with others"? Fear that answer!

items.slavonic_text: злыми дѣлы своими • невѣрными и лакостию •
items.english_text: Do thou therefore tremble, O accursed and defiled soul, that art defiled at all hours! Why weepest thou not, O man? Think upon the life of this deceitful world: today thou livest and makest merry, and tomorrow thou shalt die, and rot, and be dust! From earth, into earth shalt thou go. O wretched man, [destroying] through thine own weakness even thy priceless soul, O wretched man! Hast thou not heard the Lord God calling the righteous, and the meek, and the merciful: "Blessed are the poor in spirit; they that weep for My sake; blessed are they that hunger; blessed are the merciful; blessed are the pure; blessed are ye when they shall say all manner of evil word against you; endure for My sake; rejoice and be glad; come, ye blessed...[^369]

items.slavonic_text: А доушю самъ потапляю оу моуцѣ вѣчнѣи • Ѡхъ
items.english_text: ...even as ye suffered, so come ye!" Have ye heard, dear brethren? What again shall the glorious and sluggish receive regarding Christ's commandments? Those indeed shall enter into eternal torments; then shall the righteous, the meek, and the obedient to Christ's commandments receive, entering into eternal life. Therefore, knowing this, brethren, let us not give ourselves over to worldly joys through our lusts, but unto ascetic struggles for the sake of our salvation, glorifying unceasingly the Trinity: Father, and Son, and Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.slavonic_text: мнѣ доуше поне ѡ селѣ ѡуправися • Ѡхъ мнѣ небо-
items.english_text: *Discourse on How It Behoves Parents to Instruct Their Children:*

items.slavonic_text: гоу • како азъ чьсти лишихся • и каковыꙗ славы • ка-
items.english_text: Chastise thy son in his youth, and he shall give thee rest in thine old age, and shall give beauty unto thy soul. Relax not over a child; for even if thou strike him with a rod, he shall not die, but shall be healthier; for striking him in body, thou shalt deliver his soul from death. Hast thou daughters? place thy strictness upon them; if thou preserve them not in bodily purity, thou mayest bring shame upon thy face. For if thou give a daughter in marriage without blemish, thou shalt have accomplished a great work, and in the midst of the assembly...[^370]

items.slavonic_text: ковоу свѣтлотоу хотѧ погубити • своимь безстра-
items.english_text: ...thou shalt be praised, and at her end thou shalt not groan over her. For he that loves his son causes him frequent blows, that he may afterwards rejoice over him. Chastise thy son from his youth, and thou shalt rejoice in him in his manhood, and in the midst of the assembly thou shalt boast of him, and envy shall seize thine enemies. And rear a child with discipline, and thou shalt find rest and blessing in him. Laugh not, playing with him, for in a little matter thou wilt smile, but in a great matter thou wilt grieve, gnashing thy teeth, and at the last it shall set thy soul's teeth on edge. Give him not authority in his youth, and crush not his ribs while he is growing up, lest becoming hardened he disobey thee, and thou have vexation from him, and grief of soul, and loss to thy household, and ruin of possessions, and reproach from neighbors, and mockery before enemies and before magistrates, fines and sore grief.

items.slavonic_text: шиемь • Чемоу доуше непослоушаеши пооучениꙗ гн҃а •
items.english_text: *Discourse of Saint John Chrysostom. Lord, bless, father, to read:*

items.slavonic_text: и с͠тыхъ приподобныхъ ѡц҃ь • но оукланꙗешися
items.english_text: Consider, brethren, what fear we ought to have in that world, on the Day of Judgment! For we shall stand compunctious because of our evil deeds which we did in this life: weeping, playing, acting foolishly, and making merry, which it behoves not Christians to do. First of all, be not deceived, saying: "If God had commanded neither to drink nor to eat...[^371]

items.slavonic_text: всегда на зло • Ѡхъ доуше слышалали еси ѡт҃вѣтъ гор-
items.english_text: ...nor to make merry, then why did He create the world upon the earth?" Give ear unto me, what I say unto you: The Prophet Elijah saw neither bread, nor wine, nor human joy; he left all and went unto the mountain, and went unto the mountain, and fasted forty days; and was he not taken up into heaven by these deeds? And the other Prophet, Daniel, had no portion in his own house; having the king's dreams in his hands, much gold, and all manner of goods, walrus tusks, and precious stones—and leaving all these things, he filled the depth of his heart, and opened the earthly life; and when the rulers grew angry with him and cast him unto the lions, the lions ran with haste and licked his feet; and when he was in distress, the Holy Spirit came and snatched him thence!

items.slavonic_text: кыи • ркыи • нѣ бл҃го съ дроугимися • того боисѧ ѡт҃вѣта •
items.english_text: O ye senseless men, in what do ye trust, and repent not, and walk with pride and with smallness of soul, being burdened with gorging, casting down your soul with haughtiness? Why hast thou no mercy on thyself? Why dost thou not sigh unto the Heavenly King, Who is the Dominion of all creation, and the Creator of heaven and earth?

items.slavonic_text: ты оубо оустрепещи доуше ѡкаяньнаꙗ • и сквръ-
items.english_text: O accursed man, how dost thou not remember, and tremblest not with thy foot [before God]... saying: "Now we live, but [tomorrow] into earth goest thou..."[^372]

items.slavonic_text: ньнаꙗ ѡсквернꙗющеся повсѧ часы • Чемоу непо-
items.english_text: ...dost thou nourish [the flesh] for such deeds, that it might fill the earth with its strength, but forfeitest thy soul?

items.slavonic_text: плачеши человѣче • помысли ѡ житии свѣта сего
items.english_text: Understand, O brethren: he that thirsts here, drinks there; he that eats not here, shall be filled there; he that is compunctious here, shall be joyful there; he that is of a contrite heart here, shall there be established in glorious praise.

items.slavonic_text: льстиваго • дн҃ь живешь и веселишися • а оутро
items.english_text: O my brethren, restrain your tongue from much speaking; restrain your eyes from much gazing; strengthen your ears from much listening. Oh, woe is me, brethren! [I lament] over the tormented soul which weeps as in a deep well within its body, which is fattened by mine evil deeds!

items.slavonic_text: оумрешь • и съгниешь и прахъ боудешь • Ѿземлꙗ-
items.english_text: O my brethren, let us cry aloud with tears and with heavy sighing unto Jesus Christ the Savior of God: He is able to heal the possessed, and the blind, and the sick, and He raised him that was dead four days! For He is able to renew heaven and earth, and to set men in their proper orders.

items.slavonic_text: лѧ оу землю поидешь • Оубогии человѣче слабо-
items.english_text: O my brethren, see and understand what things the Master endured from mankind: mockery and crucifixion! Like senseless men, know ye not that in sins were we conceived, and in sins were we born? Give ear unto me, and answer, saying: "We have spent our years and days, and have had our fill"; and be not able to say: "We cannot bend the knee", for answers are prepared for you...[^373]

items.slavonic_text: стию своею • и бесцѣнноую свою доушю • оубогии
items.english_text: ...O senseless men: "Where wast thou when I made the angelic ranks and all the earth? Where wast thou when He planted His vineyard?"

items.slavonic_text: человѣче • нѣсили слышалъ г҃а б҃а призывающа
items.english_text: O brethren, be not deceived, saying: "Now we are despondent, let us rejoice and make merry, and tomorrow we shall repent!" Know ye not, brethren, that as the dew is dried up from the face [of the earth], so also your youth is dried up by evil deeds?

items.slavonic_text: праведники • и кроткиꙗ • и милостивыꙗ • блаже-
items.english_text: Lo, I say unto you now: When thou sleepest, if a thief should come upon thy house, if one stood by, he would not suffer him to approach it. Even so I say unto you, brethren: Watch with fear, lest when the angel comes, he snatch away your soul, and your haste be in vain, so that it cannot look back to repent!

items.slavonic_text: нни нищии дх҃омъ • плачющеисѧ мене ради • блаже-
items.english_text: Therefore now I say unto you: Receive this instruction, write it in the depth of your hearts, meditate upon it all days and nights, and call upon the Lord at all hours, saying: "O Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, draw near Thy mercy, and fence my soul as with a strong wall of iron, that mine enemy snatch me not away like a roaring lion!"

items.slavonic_text: нни алчющеи • блаженни милостивии • блаженни
items.english_text: And thou, O Lady Mary, I pray thee, hear me, wretched one, and cover me with thy prayers: for thou didst bear the awesome salvation, the cleansing of our sins; for Thou, [O Christ], didst formidably lead forth the first man from the kingdom of hades, and led everyone that had died into paradise!

items.slavonic_text: чистии • блаженни егда рекоутъ всѧкъ золъ гл҃ъ на
items.english_text: For unto Him is due all glory, honor, and worship: to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now [and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.]:—[^374]

Flanking behind the shield flutter two ornate banderoles (scrolls): on the left scroll, the Gothic majuscule letter S at the top and the date 1491 in Arabic numerals below; on the right scroll, the Gothic majuscule letter V at the top and the printer's name FIOŁ in capital letters below. The initials S. V. designate the printer Schweipolt Veyl (Fiol).]
